BuildingBlueprint_CopyDevice.desc: Point this tool at an existing base to store a blueprint copy. Use again to place a projection of the saved base in a different location. You can then use a Construction Tool to rebuild the base.

BaseBackupTool.desc: This tool can be used to save and restore structures, allowing for long term storage. Based on the miniaturization technologies of House Richese, this tool allows the owner of a sub-fief to remove and restore structures.  The technology it uses is a closely guarded secret, but detractors claim it used forbidden pre-butlerian nanotech.

HarkonnenSet.desc: A set of building pieces to create bases in the Harkonnen style, to use with the Construction Tool.

AtreidesSet.desc: A set of building pieces to create bases in the Atreides style, to use with the Construction Tool.

ChoamLevel2Set.desc: A set of building pieces to create bases in the CHOAM style, to use with the Construction Tool.

BasicLighting_Patent.desc: A set of basic lights for illuminating and decorating a base. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

D_BasicFurniture_Patent.desc: A set of basic furniture for decorating a base. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

D_SmallCistern_Patent.desc: Fragile container for storing water that can be utilized in the operation of multiple base production units. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

D_ModStation_Patent.desc: Machine that allows modification of items that have available attachment slots. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

RepairStation_Patent.desc: Machine that can restore lost durability in items. Each time an item is repaired its maximum durability decreases. Repairs require appropriate materials and schematics. Placed with the Construction Tool.

BloodWaterExtraction_Patent.desc: A filtration system capable of extracting water from blood collected in a Blood Sack. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Requires power from a base power generator to operate.

D_StartingSet.desc: A patent that allows basic base building using the Construction Tool.

D_WaterStorageSet_Patent.desc: A patent for use with the Solido Construction Projector (SCP) tool

D_AdvFabricationSet_Patent.desc: A patent placing advance fabricators with the Construction Tool.

D_BannerSet_Patent.desc: A patent that allows placement of decorative banners with the Construction Tool.

D_AdvFurnitureSet_Patent.desc: A patent that allows the placement of advanced furniture pieces with the Construction Tool.

D_DecorSet_Patent.desc: A patent for use with the Construction Tool.

D_AdvLightingSet_Patent.desc: A patent that allows the placement of advanced lighting features with the Construction Tool.

ChoamShelterSet.desc: A construction set for building a basic shelter in the CHOAM style. Select with the Construction Tool.

D_Pentashield_Patent.desc: A transparent energy field that can only be passed with the correct base permissions. Edges must be attached to existing base structures utilizing the Construction Tool.

D_AdvStructureSet_Patent.desc: A patent that allows for building of advanced structural elements utilizing the Construction Tool.

SmallChemicalRefinery.desc: Refinery capable of processing raw resources into Cobalt Ingots, Silicone Blocks, and Fuel Cell Packs. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Requires power from a base power generator to operate.

SmallSpiceRefinery.desc: Processes Spice Sand into valuable Spice Melange. Can be sold or used in further crafting. Must be powered through additional base power installations.

SurvivalFabricator_Patent.desc: Machine that can craft specialized products for survival, exploration, mining. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Needs power.

VehicleFabricator_Patent.desc: Machine that can craft advanced vehicles like the Buggy or Ornithopter. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Must be powered through additional base power installations to function.

WeaponsFabricator_Patent.desc: Machine that can craft advanced weaponry. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Must be powered through additional base power installations to function.

WearablesFabricator_Patent.desc: Machine that can craft advanced attire, from stillsuits to powerful armor. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Must be powered through additional base power installations to function.

Windtrap_Patent.desc: Machine that collects water from the environment over time, re-routable between base production and storage structures. Requires a Filter for operation. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

MediumWaterCistern_Patent.desc: Fragile container for storing water that can be utilized in the operation of multiple base production units. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

D_MediumInsulatedCistern_Patent.desc: Robust container that stores a medium amount of water that can be utilized in the operation of multiple base production units. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

WindturbineDirectional_Patent.desc: A wind-driven turbine that generates a large amount of re-routable power for base production structures. Requires Lubricant for operation. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

SpiceSilo_Patent.desc: A small external storage container. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Its contents can be accessed throughout a base via the included storage circuits.

MediumOreRefinery_Patent.desc: A refinery capable of producing Aluminum and Duraluminum ingots from raw Aluminum and Jasmium ore.

MediumStorageContainer_Patent.desc: A medium external storage container. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Its contents can be accessed by devices throughout a base via the included storage circuits.

ChoamPentashieldSurfaceHorizontal_Patent.desc: A transparent energy field that can only be passed with the correct base permissions. Edges must be attached to existing base structures utilizing the Construction Tool.

ChoamPentashieldSurfaceVertical_Patent.desc: A transparent energy field that can only be passed with the correct base permissions. Edges must be attached to existing base structures utilizing the Construction Tool.

MediumChemicalRefinery_Patent.desc: A medium-sized Chemical Refinery. Can be used to refine resources with better efficiency. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

MediumSpiceRefinery_Patent.desc: Processes Spice Sand into Spice Melange more efficiently than the Small Spice Refinery. Requires power from a base power generator to operate.

WaterCistern_Patent.desc: Fragile container for storing water that can be utilized in the operation of multiple base production units. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

LargeWaterCistern_Patent.desc: Fragile container for storing a large quantity of water that can be utilized in the operation of multiple base production units. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

D_SmallInsulatedCistern_Patent.desc: Fragile container for storing a small amount of water that can be utilized in the operation of multiple base production units. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

LargeWindTrap_Patent.desc: Machine that collects a lot of water from the environment over time, re-routable between base production and storage structures. Requires a Filter for operation. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

BasicFabricator_Patent.desc: A fabrication unit capable of producing complex items. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Requires power from a base power generator to operate.

WindTurbineOmni_Patent.desc: A wind-driven turbine that generates a large amount of re-routable power for base production units. Requires Lubricant for operation. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

Totem_Patent.desc: This console claims a large piece of land to build on, which can be further expanded with staking units. Land claimed with this device is subject to a recurring Solari tax which can be paid in cities.

BasicContainer_Patent.desc: An external storage container. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Its contents can be accessed by devices throughout a base via the included storage circuits.

SmallOreRefinery_Patent.desc: Processes raw Copper ore, Carbon ore, and Iron ore into Refined Resources. Can also create Steel ingots from Iron and Carbon.

Recycler_Patent.desc: Machine that disassembles an item, returning a portion of its component materials. The quantity of returned materials is dependent on the condition of the recycled item. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

D_Carpets_Patent.desc: A set of decorative carpets that can to add a touch of comfort and style to any base. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

PowerGenerator_Patent.desc: A fuel-powered generator that provides power to a base when supplied with Fuel Cells. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

Deathstill_Patent.desc: A complex device capable of extracting water from a corpse. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Requires power from a base power generator to operate.

BloodWaterExtractionAdvanced_Patent.desc: A filtration system capable of extracting water from blood collected in a Blood Sack. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Requires power from a base power generator to operate.

AdvancedWeaponsFabricator_Patent.desc: A fabrication unit capable of producing advanced weaponry. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Requires power from a base power generator to operate.

AdvancedWearablesFabricator_Patent.desc: A fabrication unit capable of producing advanced attire, from stillsuits to powerful armor. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Requires power from a base power generator to operate.

AdvancedVehiclesFabricator_Patent.desc: A fabrication unit capable of producing components for advanced vehicles like the Buggy or Ornithopter. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Requires power from a base power generator to operate.

AdvancedSurvivalFabricator_Patent.desc: A fabrication unit capable of producing specialized products for survival, exploration, and mining. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Requires power from a base power generator to operate.

LargeOreRefinery_Patent.desc: A refinery capable of producing high-end ingots and resources from raw materials. This ultra-efficient unit will produce higher yields from smaller quantities of raw materials.

LargeSpiceRefinery_Patent.desc: Processes Spice Sand into Spice Melange more efficiently than other spice refineries. Requires power from a base power generator to operate.

StorageContainer_Patent.desc: An enlarged external storage container. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Its contents can be accessed by devices throughout a base via the included storage circuits.

SpiceGenerator_Patent.desc: A spice fuel-powered generator that provides power to a base by processing Spice-Infused Fuel Cells. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool.

Totem_Small_Patent.desc: Essential device that claims a piece of land to build on. Place with the Construction Tool. The console can generate a shield that will protect a base from damage when powered by a generator placed nearby.

MTX_Neut_DesertMechanicSet_SandbikePaint.desc: Engineered for the harsh environments of Arrakis, the CHOAM one man ground car, known also as the Sandbike, is respected for its durability and reliability. This engraved set of technical specifications for the 1MGC was probably the work of a respectful engineer.

MTX_Neut_DesertMechanicSet_Sign_Patent.desc: This sign can be attached to various walls in order to proclaim that a sandbike can be found within. Or nearby. Or potentially to show that this is a place to park a sandbike. This is a sign of at least three uses.

MTX_Neut_DesertMechanic_StorageContainer.desc: This container, full of scrapped odds and ends, is what passes for decoration among the scavengers of Hagga Basin.

Fremen_Deathstill_Patent.desc: A complex device capable of extracting water from a corpse. Place close to a Sub-Fief Console with the Construction Tool. Requires power from a base power generator to operate.

MTX_Neut_DesertMechanic_DismantledSandbi.desc: Once the pride and joy of a scavenger, now just a pile of junk, this dismantled sandbike is beyond repair. Instead it serves only as a decoration.

MTX_Neut_DesertMechanic_SpareWheel_Paten.desc: The lines of this shattered tread tell a story about the harsh conditions and ever present threats that lie beyond the safety of the villages and cities of Arrakis. Useful as a decoration, or a reminder.

MTX_Neut_HarvesterCaptainChair_Placeable.desc: A memento from the doomed spice harvester, Mithra, this chair was once at the center of a large-scale spice harvesting operation. Now it can be used to sit comfortably, without the need to constantly scan the horizon for wormsign.

MTX_B1C3_RoofToppers_01_Placeables_Paten.desc: Sitting atop a roof like a helm upon a formidable warrior’s head, these spires offer both a sense of ornamentation and intimidation.

MTX_B1C3_RoofToppers_02_Placeables_Paten.desc: In a universe of competition and dominance, simply adding height to a structure can lend a sense of superiority and awe. These towering spires help any structure reach a little closer to the heavens.

AluminiumBar.desc: An Aluminum ingot, refined from Aluminum Ore at a Medium Ore Refinery. Used to create products that require Aluminum. Can also be further processed into Duraluminum with Jasmium Crystals.

AzuriteOre.desc: Copper ore, mined from a Copper deposit. Can be refined into Copper Ingots at any Ore Refinery to create new products that require it.

BauxiteOre.desc: Aluminum ore, mined from an Aluminum deposit. Can be refined into Aluminum Ingots at a Medium Ore Refinery to create new products that require it.

D_Carbon.desc: Essential to all living things, carbon has a great number of applications across its various forms. Obtain it by refining dolomite ore

CopperBar.desc: A Copper ingot, refined from Copper Ore at any Ore Refinery. Used to create products that require Copper.

DolomiteRock.desc: Carbon ore, mined from a Carbon deposit. Can be processed with Iron Ingots together to create refined Steel Ingots at any Ore Refinery to create new products that require it.

FlourSand.desc: Found in flour sand drifts on the open sands, predominantly in the Vermillius Gap. Can be harvested by hand or with a Static Compactor. Can be refined into Silicone Blocks in a Chemical Refinery.

FuelCanister.desc: Vehicle Fuel Cell with low capacity. Refined from Fuel Cells at a Chemical Refinery. Used to power vehicles.

IronBar.desc: An Iron ingot, refined from Iron Ore at any Ore Refinery. Used to create products that require Iron. Can also be further processed into Steel with Carbon Ore.

FuelCanister_Medium.desc: Vehicle Fuel Cell with average capacity. Refined from Fuel Cells at a Chemical Refinery. Used to power vehicles.

FuelCanister_Large.desc: Vehicle Fuel Cell with high capacity. Refined from Fuel Cells at a Chemical Refinery. Used to power vehicles.

MagnetiteOre.desc: Iron ore, mined from an Iron deposit. Can be refined into Iron Ingots at any Ore Refinery to create new products that require it.

D_MechanicalParts.desc: Mechanical parts are used to make up the workings of many machines and devices and CHOAM manufactures one for every purpose imaginable

D_MissionariaProtectivaDoc1.desc:
"The Lisan al-Gaib defies opposites.
He may be as a stranger to you and as one who has always lived among you.
He may see the future whilst gazing into the past.
He may be both dead and alive."

D_MissionariaProtectivaDoc2.desc:
"The blade of the Mahdi is slow, but immutable.
Like a doctor's knife, it cuts to heal.
What his blade takes from you:
Rejoice, for he has relieved you of a burden."

MissionariaProtectivaDoc3.desc:
"It is written: Suffer not a witch to live among us.
Who is this witch?
Not one who knows the weirding way, but one who is warped by weirding.
Where demons make their home, a witch must die."

PlantFiber.desc: Resource that can be picked everywhere in the world where there is solid land for it to take root. Woven to fibers used in armor and bandages.

ScrapMetal.desc: This metal has been salvaged from wreckage left on Arrakis. Can be recovered with a Cutteray. Used for crafting rudimentary metal items.

Silicone.desc: A block of plastic refined from Flour Sand in a Chemical Refinery. Can be used to create new products that require it.

SolarisCoin.desc: Solaris are the currency of the Imperium. Use it to buy goods from vendors. Upon defeat you will drop your Solaris, so be sure to visit a banker in villages to deposit them for safekeeping.

MelangeSpice.desc: Made from Spice Sand at a Spice Refinery. The most sought-after resource in the universe. Enables intergalactic travel and extends life. Addictive. Withdrawal leads to death.

SpiceSand.desc: Can be harvested by hand or with a Static Compactor at Spice Blow sites before the Worm arrives. Can be refined into valuable Spice Melange at a Spice Refinery.

Stone.desc: Stronger than the sandstones that crumble in the storms that sweep across Arrakis, granite stone is widely used a basic building material. It is found almost everywhere there is dirt.

WeldingMaterial.desc: Welding material is required when using the welding torch to repair vehicle parts. Crafted from salvaged metal parts.

D_WeldingMaterial2.desc: Welding material is required when using the welding torch to repair vehicle parts. Crafted from salvaged metal parts.

JasmiumCrystal.desc: Jasmium Crystal, mined from a Jasmium deposit. Can be refined together with Aluminum Ingots into Duraluminum Ingots at a Medium Ore Refinery to create new products that require it.

WeldingMaterial3.desc: Welding material is required when using the welding torch to repair vehicle parts. Crafted from Steel and reduces the rate of durability loss from repairs.

Basalt.desc: Stone which can be refined for usage in construction.

D_WeldingMaterial4.desc: Welding material is required when using the welding torch to repair vehicle parts. Crafted from salvaged metal parts.

WeldingMaterial5.desc: Welding material is required when using the welding torch to repair vehicle parts. Crafted from Duraluminum and greatly reduces the rate of durability loss from repairs.

SteelBar.desc: A Steel ingot refined from Carbon Ore and Iron Ingot at any Ore Refinery. Used to create products that require Steel.

DuraluminumRod.desc: A Duraluminum ingot, refined from Aluminum Ingots and Jasmium Crystals at a Medium Ore Refinery. Used to create products that require Duraluminum.

ErythriteCrystal.desc: Erythrite Crystal, mined from an Erythrite deposit in the Hagga Rift. Can be refined into Cobalt Paste at a Chemical Refinery to create new products that require it.

CobaltBar.desc: A dissolution of Cobalt, refined from Erythrite Crystal from the Hagga Rift at a Chemical Refinery. Used to create products that require Cobalt.

SpiceResidue.desc: Residue left from spice refining, useful in crafting.

SaguaroResourceRaw.desc: In common with its distant ancestors, the fruits of the Arrakeen Agave contain a large mass of seeds, which are put to many uses by those who have ready access to them.

FremenComponent1.desc: A fabrication component found in <Fremen>Fremen</> areas, such as caves. Used in Cutterays.

FremenComponent2.desc: The Micro-Sandwich Fabric is a shorthand for the multi-layered water recycling component used in <Fremen>Fremen</> equipment such as stillsuits. Look for these in caves.

OldImperialComponent1.desc: A fabrication component used in vehicles such as Sandbikes. Found in <OldImperial>Old Imperial</> remnants, such as Imperial Testing Stations.

OldImperialComponent2.desc: A fabrication component found in <OldImperial>Old Imperial</> remnants, such as Imperial Testing Stations. Used in Holtzman tech or special constructions, such as Boost modules for vehicles.

GreatHouseComponent1.desc: A fabrication component used in armor. Found in <GreatHouse>Great House</> ruins, such as Shipwrecks.

GreatHouseComponent2.desc: A fabrication component used in firearms. Found in <GreatHouse>Great House</> ruins, such as Shipwrecks.

Corpse.desc: Dead body that can be processed into water using a Deathstill.

Plastone.desc: An artificial composite of Silicone and Basalt used in sandstorm-resistant construction.

T6ResourceA.desc: Titanium ore is found in the deep desert, and most commonly utilized in the production of plastanium, an alloy of titanium and stravidium.

T6ResourceB.desc: Raw stravidium mass can be found in the deep desert, and refined into fibers.

D_FremenComponent3.desc: A fabrication component found in <Fremen>Fremen</> areas, such as caves in the Vermilius Gap. Used in Cutterays.

T2HeavyComponent.desc: Strengthened plating can be liberated from those who make use of them in their heavy armor, and repurposed to other ends.

D_T3HeavyComponent.desc: A looted component used in crafting. Found on Heavy enemies in the Jabal Eifrit & The Hagga Rift

T1RusherComponent.desc: Even the wide variety of melee weapons tend to use standardized parts for their handful of complex elements. These can often be found on the bodies of those who favor the blade, or in their storage lockers

D_T4RusherComponent.desc: A fabrication component found in loot

D_T5RusherComponent.desc: A fabrication component found in loot

D_T6RusherComponent.desc: A fabrication component found in loot

T1AssaultComponent.desc: Key components for a wide variety of standard ranged weapons, often salvaged from the bodies of those who no longer have need for them.

D_T2AssaultComponent.desc: A fabrication component found in loot

D_T3AssaultComponent.desc: A fabrication component found in loot

D_T4AssaultComponent.desc: A looted component used in crafting. Found on Assault and Marksmen enemies in the Shield Wall & the O'odham

D_T6AssaultComponent.desc: A looted component used in crafting. Found on Assault and Marksmen enemies  in the Deep Desert

T3MarksmanComponent.desc: Unsurprisingly, if you want to acquire a range-finder, look for sharpshooters. But remember, if you can see them, they can probably see you.

T2MachineComponent.desc: Ironically, these components are found in many older fabricators and refineries, but cannot themselves be easily fabricated.

T2MuaddibComponent.desc: Being cute and being a local delicacy are not mutually exclusive. Canny hunters can find Muad'Dib on the open sands; foolish ones look to the moon.

T1ExplorationComponent.desc: Those who make regular use of suspensor belts and similar technology often leave caches of these replacement parts in places only they can reach.

T3MiningGalleryComponent1.desc: These specialist servoks are commonly repurposed from heavy-duty equipment. This type of equipment was used extensively in Jabal Eifrit.

T3MiningGalleryComponent2.desc: Industrial production of bulk ores still commonly relies on drilling, but for mining more delicate materials such as crystals, a sophisticated cutteray is worth the investment. This type of equipment was used extensively to mine large parts of the Hagga Rift.

T5RadiatedCoreComponent.desc: A looted component used in crafting. Found in Radiated Core in the Sheol.

T4ShieldWallComponent.desc: A looted component used in crafting. High-up bases in Shield Wall.

T4HarkSpiceSiloComponent1.desc: There are few uses for industrial-strength pumps on a planet as dry as Arrakis, but the Sandflies do utilize them in their operations in Sentinel City.

T4HarkSpiceSiloComponent2.desc: The Sandflies often keep stashes of these components in their outposts, as they can be turned to various useful purposes.

T4HarkSpiceSiloComponent3.desc: The Sandflies often keep stashes of these components in their outposts, as they can be turned to various useful purposes.

T4PyonVillageComponent.desc: Insulated fabric was one of the cottage industries of the O'odham, before the pyons were displaced from their old villages.

T4MysaTarilComponent1.desc: This industrial byproduct is closely guarded by the Maas Kharet in their most sacred site. Nobody is entirely sure why.

T4MysaTarilComponent2.desc: This industrial byproduct is closely guarded by the Maas Kharet in their most sacred site. Nobody is entirely sure why.

T4MaasKharetComponent1.desc: The Maas Kharet have a particular affinity with this type of leather, and often make use of it in their clothing.

T4MaasKharetComponent2.desc: The best tubing of course comes from the Fremen, but they do not share. The Maas Kharet are seen by many as a cheap imitation of the Fremen, and they produce a cheap imitation of Fremen stillsuit tubing.

T3VendorComponent1.desc: Fremen medical tradition relies on only what the desert provides. Everyone else uses off-world pharmaceuticals, if they can get them.

D_T5SheolComponent1.desc: A looted component used in crafting. Can be foun in the Sheol

T1UniqueComponent.desc: Truly <Unique>Unique</> items often rely on spice-infused metal to enhance their qualities. Such metals are jealously horded by the most powerful groups, locked away in their most secure containers.

T2UniqueComponent.desc: Truly <Unique>Unique</> items often rely on spice-infused metal to enhance their qualities. Such metals are jealously horded by the most powerful groups, locked away in their most secure containers.

T6RefinedResourceA.desc: Pure titanium is extracted from its ore, heated until liquid, and then carefully threaded with stravidium fibers to enhance its strength.

T6RefinedResourceB.desc: These fibers are carefully drawn from a chemically-treated stravidium mass, and used in the production of plastanium.

WindTurbineLubricant1.desc: A low-grade lubricant required for omnidirectional wind turbines to function. Can be refined in a chemical refinery.

WindTurbineLubricant2.desc: An industrial quality lubricant required for directional wind turbines to function. Can be refined in a chemical refinery.

WindTrapFilter1.desc: A filter with simple functionality to keep Windtraps running and clear of sand. Fitted for smaller Windtraps. Can be crafted in a Survival Fabricator.

WindTrapFilter2.desc: A CHOAM-patented filter with improved protection against the harsh winds of Arakkis. Needed to keep Windtraps running and clear of sand. Fitted for smaller Windtraps. Can be crafted in a Survival Fabricator.

WindTrapFilter3.desc: A thorough filter to catch any unwanted particles, dust and sand. Needed to keep Windtraps running and clear of sand. Fitted for Larger Windtraps. Can be crafted in a Survival Fabricator.

WindTrapFilter4.desc: An advanced filter for catching any unwanted particles, dust and sand. Needed to keep Windtraps running and clear of sand. Fitted for Larger Windtraps. Can be crafted in an Advanced Survival Fabricator.

SpicedFuelCell.desc: A fuel cell for spice-powered generators. Made from fuel cells and spice residue. Can be refined in a Medium Chemical Refinery.

T5FactionBaseComponent1.desc: A component used to craft vehicle power units. The Great Houses have a stranglehold on this type of component on Arrakis and any who possess them must have forcibly wrested them from their control.

T5FactionBaseComponent2.desc: A component used to craft vehicle engines. The Great Houses have a stranglehold on this type of component on Arrakis and any who possess them must have forcibly wrested them from their control.

T5DeepDesertShieldWallComponent.desc: A crafting component used to cool down Harvesting tools used in the Deep Desert. Spare parts are usually found in the Deep Desert on the Shield Wall.

BlankSinkChart.desc:
A blank sinkchart that can be populated with survey data. Open the Map and select a surveyed area to populate it.

Requires the Cartographer passive from the Planetologist Skill tree.

T6ArmorPlating.desc: An Armor crafting component used in plastanium tier crafting. Can be found in the Deep Desert, obtained from Landsraad rewards, or crafted in an Advanced Survival Fabricator.

T6HydraulicPiston.desc: A vehicle module crafting component used in plastanium tier crafting. Can be found in the Deep Desert, obtained from Landsraad rewards, or crafted in an Advanced Survival Fabricator.

T6PlasteelComponent.desc: A crafting component for crafting plasteel crafting components. Can be found in the Deep Desert, or obtained from Landsraad rewards.

WormTooth.desc: A crafting component obtained from dying to the sandworm. Can be used to craft an unfixed crysknife.

LandsraadTreasureComponent1.desc: One of the rare opaline jewels of Hagal. They shimmer with a captivating blend of fiery reds and cool iridescent hues.

LandsraadShipwreckComponent1.desc: Detailed records of cargo, crew, and routes. Useful for monitoring covert trade routes and spice shipments.

D_NPEDesertHandbook.desc: A useful manual for surviving on Arrakis.

LandsraadComponent.desc: An offworld compound that can be requisitioned via the Landsraad. Used to fabricate high quality gear and augmentations. Must be adapted to local environments via an Advanced Survival Fabricator before usage.

T6LandsraadCraftedComponent.desc: Used to fabricate high quality gear and augmentations. This component has been adapted to the environment of Arrakis in an Advanced Survival Fabricator.

T6SchematicFragmentQL1.desc: A component used to craft augmentations. Can be found in graded loot, or via recycling schematics of a certain grade.

T6SchematicFragmentQL2.desc: A component used to craft augmentations. Can be found in graded loot, or via recycling schematics of a certain grade.

T6SchematicFragmentQL5.desc: A component used to craft augmentations. Can be found in graded loot, or via recycling schematics of a certain grade.

ExperimentalWindTurbineComponent.desc: A component needed to craft the Experimental Wind Turbine.

WaterItem.desc: PH_Water extracted from Ice in an Ice Processor

Oil.desc: Found throughout the world, fuel cells can generate power for bases directly when loaded into a Fuel Generator. They can be refined at a Chemical Refinery into Vehicle Fuel Cells to power vehicles.

D_TestEmote.desc: An emote added to test the emote system.

Emote_Follow_01.desc: Beckoning arm gesture, urging others to follow

Emote_AdjustStillsuit.desc: Check the fitting of your stillsuit

Emote_ShakeOffSand_01.desc: Clean your clothes from the dust

Emote_BetaReward.desc: Legends come and go. A regiment long lost to the sands of Arrakis – none remember their names, their faces, their ranks or their mission. But their salute lives on, forever preserved in this legendary emote.

Emote_ThumperBack.desc: Call for a thumper behind your position

Emote_ThumperLeft.desc: Call for a thumper to the left of your position

Emote_ThumperRight.desc: Call for a thumper to the right of your position

Emote_ThumperForward.desc: Call for a thumper ahead of your position

Emote_ScanHorizon.desc: Look ahead with a hand above the eyes

Emote_ExamineGround.desc: Inspect a fistful of dust from the ground

Emote_WatershipperSalute.desc: A standard emote used by Water Shippers to acknowledge rank and authority.

Emote_SlaveWarning.desc: A warning gesture used by the unfortunate souls slaving away in the polar quarries.

Emote_WatershipperFreeze.desc: A raised fist to stop allies in their tracks

Emote_Chestpump.desc: The rhythmic chest thump sets a mantra and a tempo, synchronizing hearts for battle.

Emote_Sardaukar_Kneel.desc: Kneel in ritual deference to a superior.

Emote_Sardaukar_BloodWipe.desc: Wipe the blood off your blade with your elbow crease.

D_BannerAtreides.desc: Hang this attractive banner to display appreciation for the Atreides

D_BannerHarkonnen.desc: Hang this attractive banner to display appreciation for the Harkonnen

D_BannerSmuggler.desc: Hang this attractive banner to display appreciation for the smugglers

D_BunkBed.desc: Better than the cold, ground this bed can be a welcome comfort at the end of a trying day

D_CamouflagedStilltent.desc: This stilltent will retain some lost moisture while sheltering from the elements in the desert

D_CeilingGlowglobe.desc: Place this lamp on the ceiling to provide lighting for a temporary shelter

D_Chair1.desc: The development of the chair dates back to antiquity. Initially available only to nobility, their utility was soon recognized by commoners and they began to use simple versions. It is notable that a great many cultures did not adopt the practice of using chairs

D_Chair2.desc: Not well known for its comfort, the use of plasteel in the construction of furniture is widespread mainly due to its low cost

D_Chair3.desc: Despite being stiff-backed and rigidly upright, this chair can be a great comfort after a long day of scrounging resources and battling those who would take your life and belongings

D_Chest.desc: This container can be used to store and organize items

D_ChoamOutpostCeilingLamp_1.desc: Place this CHOAM style of wall lamp to produce interior lighting

D_ChoamOutpostFloorLamp_1.desc: Place this CHOAM style of wall lamp to produce interior lighting

D_ChoamOutpostWallLamp_1.desc: Place this CHOAM style of wall lamp to produce interior lighting

D_CompactSeismicProbe.desc: Will notify through the communinet when a sandworm enters or exits its search range

D_CompactThumper.desc: Activating this device in the desert will cause vibrations that summon sandworms

D_ConstructionFabricator.desc: Use this workstation to craft buildings, placeables, deployables, and construction elements

D_Generator.desc: You can purchase fuel but sometimes you're just not near the shop. Use this device to generate fuel

D_Glowglobe.desc: Place this lamp on the floor to provide lighting for a temporary shelter

D_HarkonnenOutpostWallLamp_1.desc: The Harkonnens may be savage and brutal but they are not gloomy. Use this Harkonnen suspensor light to illuminate your base

D_HarkonnenOutpostWallLamp_2.desc: Place this Harkonnen style wall lamp to produce interior lighting

D_LongDurationThumper.desc: Activating this device in the desert will cause vibrations that summon sandworms

D_LongRangeSeismicProbe.desc: Will notify through the communinet when a sandworm enters or exits its search range

D_MediumOreRefinery.desc: Place raw ore in this device to produce refined components for crafting

D_MediumStorageContainer.desc: This container can be used to store and organize items

D_ModdingStation.desc: Sometimes what you have can be made better than new. Use this workstation to modify weapons

D_OutpostChair_1.desc: CHOAM offers a wide selection of chairs to outfit any home and the company employs some of the Imperium's most notable industrial designers to improve their stock

D_OutpostTable_1.desc: More than a level surface for eating or working at, a table is a statement of style and a place where people can come together to plan, share, and discuss

D_OutpostTable_2.desc: Early examples of tables were constructed out of stone and though durable they were difficult to place. Soon lighter weight materials began to take over

D_PentashieldCeiling.desc: Place this energy ceiling to use as a barrier

D_PentashieldWall.desc: Place this energy wall to use as a barrier

D_PlantPot_Medium.desc: This pot can be used to hold medium-sized plants

D_PlantPot_Small.desc: This pot can be used to hold small plants

D_PortableFabricator.desc: This is a portable device for crafting some items

D_ProtectiveStilltent.desc: This stilltent will retain some lost moisture while sheltering from the elements in the desert

RespawnBeacon.desc: Placing this device in an appropriate place adds a site at which your character can be respawned. Only one beacon can be active at a time. Placing a new beacon will replace the existing one.

D_SeismicProbe.desc: After being placed, the probe will notify through the communinet when a sandworm enters or exits its search range. <Fremen>Fremen</> considers this to be most likely used by off-worlders.

D_SmallChemicalRefinery.desc: Place chemicals in this device to produce refined components for crafting

D_SmallOreRefinery.desc: Place raw ore in this device to produce refined components for crafting

D_SpiceBarrel.desc: This barrel can be used to store spice

D_SpiceCoffeeSet.desc: Use this set to serve spice coffee to guests or display it as a demonstration of good taste

D_SpiceRefinery.desc: Place raw spice in this device to produce refined spice

Stilltent.desc: Equip and place down to make a temporary <Fremen>Fremen</> shelter from the heat of day and mild sandstorms when entered. Drink from the tent to regain lost moisture that has been retained.

D_SurvivalFabricator.desc: Surviving on Arrakis requires more than a little ingenuity. Use this workstation to craft survival equipment

D_Table.desc: From the nobility to the common pyon, all gather at the table to share in both life's struggles and its bounty

Thumper.desc: Placing this <Fremen>Fremen</> device in the open desert will cause vibrations that will summon any nearby sandworm.

D_Totem.desc: Building your own place starts with the land. Placing this device in an appropriate place signals claim to the designated site

D_TotemTemporary.desc: Building your own place starts with the land. Placing this device in an appropriate place signals claim to the designated site

D_Turret.desc: This turret can be loaded with heavy darts for use in defensive strategies

UniqueThumper.desc: Modified to follow the Fremen design, this <Unique>Unique</> thumper generates a large amount of threat with the sandworm in a short amount of time. Just be sure to place it on open sand.

UniqueThumper_02.desc: First discovered in Windsong in the O'odham, this modified <Unique>Unique</> thumper generates a large amount of threat with the sandworm in a short amount of time. Just be sure to place it on open sand.

UniqueThumper_03.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> thumper generates a large amount of threat with the sandworm in a short amount of time. It has been tuned — through careful experimentation — to the exact vibration frequency that attracts worms. Just be sure to place it on open sand.

D_VehiclesFabricator.desc: Buying new is never as satisfying as making them yourself. Use this workstation to craft vehicle parts

D_WallGlowglobe.desc: Place this lamp on the wall to provide lighting for a temporary shelter

D_WaterCistern.desc: Use this container to store small amounts of water

D_WeaponsFabricator.desc: From makeshift knives to battle rifles, use this workstation to craft weapons

D_WearablesFabricator.desc: Make sure you've got all your kit from top to toe. Use this workstation to craft garments

D_Windtrap.desc: Use this device to collect ambient moisture from the air coming from one direction

D_WindTurbineDirectional.desc: Placing this device in an appropriate spot will generate power from wind coming from one direction

D_WindTurbineOmnidirectional.desc: Placing this device in an appropriate spot will generate power from wind coming from any direction

Stilltent_Unique_01.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> creation. This stilltent utilizes extra seals in order to trap more moisture over time.

HeatSource.desc: A portable heat source, deploy to protect against the cold

HarkSandbike_MeshCustomization.desc: A Harkonnen-style customization that can be applied to Sandbikes. Applied via Welding Tool.

AtreSandbike_MeshCustomization.desc: An Atreides-style customization that can be applied to Sandbikes. Applied via Welding Tool.

MTX_HeavyRacerBuggy_MeshCustomization.desc: A Harkonnen-style customization that can be applied to Sandbikes. Applied via Welding Tool.

MTX_DesertMechanicBike_Variant.desc: A sandbike variant that recaptures that do-it-yourself feeling of creating a sandbike for the very first time. A well-used and well-loved aesthetic that speaks to would-be mechanics everywhere.

MTX_B1C3_Minotaur_Memento_Variant.desc:
A dense, razor-edged <Unique>Unique</> weapon built to shear through armored flesh by force alone.

Tauromachy, the brutal Old Terran contest of man against beast, endured as a defining Atreides rite until Old Duke Paulus fell beneath Salusan horns. Asterion’s End lingers as a ghost of the arena, whispered as though the Minotaur’s curse still coils within it, binding valor and doom in equal measure.

B1C3_Smuggler_Buggy_Variant.desc: A Contraband-themed variant of the Buggy.

B1C3_Smuggler_Drillshot_Variant.desc: A Contraband-themed variant of the Drillshot.

B1C3_Smuggler_Snubnose_Variant.desc: A Contraband-themed variant of the Snubnose, used to customize heavy pistols.

B1C3_Smuggler_Fireballer_Variant.desc: A Contraband-themed variant, used to customize Pyrockets.

MTX_B1C3_DualBlades_Memento_Variant.desc: Feyd-Rautha is known to favor his own custom sets of Kindjal and Slip-tip dual blades, making deadly use of their combination. It would be a rare privileged to own such a set. How many lives have these razor edges claimed?

B1C3_Specializaton_Helmet_Crafting.desc:
Headgear commemorating those who craft, create, and build. Such artisans shape the world around them by the sheer force of their artifice. 

Used to customize helmets.

B1C3_Specializaton_Helmet_Gathering.desc:
Headgear for those who know how to acquire that which is needed. No matter how powerful they are, the most affluent people in the universe cannot escape their dependence on such agents.

Used to customize helmets.

B1C3_Specializaton_Helmet_Exploration.desc:
Headgear celebrating those who excel at discovery. That illimitable curiosity, stronger than the fear of death, has brought humanity across vast swaths of the universe, further than their biology had any right to take them.

Used to customize helmets.

B1C3_Specializaton_Helmet_Combat.desc:
Headgear for those who practice one of the oldest professions. Those who live by the weapon often die by the weapon, but they will never be lacking in work in the time that they have.

Used to customize helmets.

B1C3_Specializaton_Helmet_Sabotage.desc:
Headgear for those expert in the nefarious enterprise of undoing. Such devious souls can see a seemingly impenetrable wall, and know which single brick to remove in order to cause the whole thing to come tumbling down.

Used to customize helmets.

B1C3_GSuit.desc: She likes to fly. Fast. Storms, worms or static - nothing stops her from getting where she needs to go. But you know what she doesn't like much? Talking.

B1C3_Shaman_Raider.desc: Nervous is the knowing mouth that whispers “the Hands of Tareel” in the dark byways of the underworld and halls of power. Frightful is the knowing eye that spots the habiliments that subtly mark one of those Hands.

B1C3_LaborerLight.desc: There is labor of all kinds on Arrakis, but none so well-known or so vital to the Empire as that of the spice worker. Their toil keeps universe in motion, as far as humans are concerned.

One must be just a hair faster than one’s opponent. Protection that offers the least encumbrance becomes attractive to smugglers who follow this philosophy.

The Tharnox takes its name from the six-limbed predator native to the ice world Lankiveil, known for its mass and ability to move through deep ice without losing momentum. TheQuarry_Armor_Heavy_Variant.desc: A variant set for heavy armors. Built for the cold, forged for punishment, this formidable armor marks one as prepared to survive the rigors of the Polar Sink.

MTX_B1C4_WaterS_Drillshot_Variant.desc: On Lankiveil, hunters modified early drillshot designs to penetrate the dense dermal layers of the famed Bjondax whales, prized for their brilliant furs. Those alterations favored persistence over force, allowing the dart to bite deep and continue working long after impact.

MTX_B1C4_WaterS_Rapier_Variant.desc: This rapier is treated with a cryotempered alloy finish, preventing frost buildup and reducing adhesion on impact. In polar conditions where lesser blades can seize, drag, or bind—the cryotempered blade maintains a clean withdrawal, allowing for repeated, efficient strikes.

MTX_B1C4_WaterS_Light_Orni_Variant.desc: This scout ornithopter is designed for patrol, interception, and aerial response. Named for the Mistral—a cold, cutting wind—it is built to arrive without warning, act decisively, and leave little behind but silence.

MTX_Fremen_FedaykinArmor_SetVariant.desc: A heavily armored stillsuit ensemble resembling wargear glimpsed only in spice visions and unrealized futures. Its imposing silhouette reflects a harsher path for Arrakis and the fighters forged by it.

MTX_Fremen_Stillsuit_Movie3_SetVariant.desc: An elegant stillsuit design resembling garments glimpsed only in spice dreams and forgotten histories. Its unusual construction evokes another vision of Arrakis and the people shaped by it.

MTX_Fremen_Spitdart_Variant.desc: A masterfully crafted spitdart rifle delivering deadly darts with near-silent precision across vast distances. Among desert fighters, its arrival is often the only warning a target receives.

MTX_Atre_CaladanTrenchcoat_SetVariant.desc: An austere field ensemble inspired by the storm-worn nobility of Caladan. Combining tailored military lines with weatherproof construction, the Caladan Stormcoat set reflects the disciplined restraint and quiet authority associated with House Atreides.

MTX_SmugFormalSetVariant_Goggles.desc: Few livable planets are as dangerous as Arrakis. The climate and the sandworms are only the beginning of its perils. Anyone who survives the underworlds and courts of Dune for long earns the grudging respect of all — from the lowliest cutthroat to the most paranoid of emperors.

Taligari_Pistol.desc: A pistol quite popular with Taligari nobility.

AgentX_Stillsuit.desc: This stillsuit variant is in the style of the mysterious figure known as the Sleeper.

Maas_Kharet_Heavy.desc: The Maas Kharet refer to their more venerable fighters as the Worm-Eaten or the Vermiculated. Scars often adorn the the flesh and armor of these fanatics. They often add to these marks through ritual scarification.

Jackal_Blindfold.desc: This strap of cloth hid the eyes of the mystery-shrouded figure known as the Jackal.

SardaukarCaptain_Sword.desc: In the hands of an experienced swordmaster, the perfect balance of this customized Sardaukar blade tells a grim story. The equilibrium of the sword allows the wielder to expend very little energy with each swing, suggesting a weapon designed less for single combat and more for sustained slaughter over a long period of time.

MinotaurSword_Variant.desc: Tauromachy, the brutal Old Terran contest of man against beast, endured as a defining Atreides rite until Old Duke Paulus fell beneath Salusan horns. This blade lingers as a ghost of the arena, whispered as though the Minotaur’s curse still coils within it, binding valor and doom in equal measure.

GluttonsMeatHook_Variant.desc: A Special sharpened hook that's been used on all manner of meats.

Sietch_Dyepack.desc: A swatch of colors often found in the Fremen Sietches hidden throughout the sands of Arrakis.

StoryContent_Ixian_Garment_Swatch.desc: A palette of colors popular in the clothing and fashion of the technologically advanced people of Ix.

StoryContent_Sinnu_Helmet_Variant.desc: This headpiece marks one as truly devoted to the fanatical worm-worshipping cult of the Maas Kharet.

MTX_Wiki_Contributor_Swatch.desc: This palette of colors is popular among scribes, chroniclers, and those of erudition.

TMobile_Social_Variant.desc: This uniform designates a particular class of communications specialists.

Combat_Hark_MedUnique01_Boots.desc: The Syndicate is a large offworld criminal organization that has never been able to get a foothold on Arrakis — due to the tireless efforts of Esmar Tuek and the smugglers to keep them out. Nobody knows why their mercenaries have begun to arrive in the Hagga Basin, nor what their interest is in the radiated wrecks of the Sheol. This <Unique>Unique</> armor is designed to keep environmental hazards at bay.

Combat_Hark_MedUnique02_Boots.desc: Stock armor is made of hardened plasmeld. This <Unique>Unique</> armor set is reinforced during the fabrication process - attaching minor heat dissipating components to every molecule within the plasmeld mass. This delivers increased heat resistance and a hard armor.

D_Combat_Hark_Scout05_Boots.desc: Armor issued to <GreatHouse>Great House</> Harkonnen troop scouts.

Combat_Nati_SandtroutLeathers01_Boots.desc: A crude pair of shoes made from plant fiber, used as a last resort by explorers.

Combat_Nati_ScavengerRags02_Boots.desc: Threadbare apparel. Those scrounging for salvage in the open desert can often afford little else.

D_Combat_Nati_WovenFiber01_Shoes.desc: Woven fiber garment for the feet.

D_Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserter02_Boots.desc: Smuggler design with a pattern based on <GreatHouse>Great House</> origin.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique01_Boo.desc: Aren was a disgraced Kirab warlord who fled south to live amongst the scavengers. He developed this <Unique>Unique</> scavenger armor - but it did not save him when the Kirab sent a squad south to eliminate him.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique02_Boo.desc: The story of the warlord Mendia is well known among the Kirab. How she escaped slavery in the north, abandoning her former life. How she gained a reputation for brutality by executing any slavers they captured. How she defeated their former leader, Aren, in a duel and drove him into hiding in the Southern Hagga Basin. This <Unique>Unique</> armor is modelled after her own - reinforced to keep her enemies at bay.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique03_Boo.desc: Inkvine was a creeping plant native to Giedi Prime, used as a material by slavers for generations. Inkvine whips were the most common - particularly for the slow burning beet colored scars that they left on their victims. This <Unique>Unique</> light armor is dyed to look almost like inkvine, despite being made from lesser materials.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique04_Boo.desc: Denira Quirth never intended to fight a war - she just wanted to survive it. When the Sandflies defected she swore not to shed the blood of her former colleagues - despite believing that the Sandflies cause was just. Her <Unique>Unique</> armor is built to withstand the ordeals of Arrakis - but not the darts of her enemies.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique05_Boo.desc: The Chosen are the elite warriors of the Maas Kharet cult, which makes its home at the old power station of Mysa Tarill. There are always four Chosen - Fire, Body, Tooth and Breath. Each is a symbolic part of the great sandworm, though this <Unique>Unique</> armor is probably just something looted from the station.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique06_Boo.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> armor set uses an experimental plasmeld layer to absorb dart impacts. In the earliest versions, the darts would stick in the gel-like outer layer, leaving the wearer bristling with darts like a pincushion. Though that flaw has been perfected, the name persists.

D_Combat_Smug_Scout05_Boots.desc: Armor of <GreatHouse>Great House</> design commonly worn by smugglers on Arrakis when scouting.

Nobody knows why their mercenaries have begun to arrive in the Hagga Basin, nor what their interest is in the radiated wrecks of the Sheol. This <Unique>Unique</> armor is designed to keep environmental hazards at bay.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique02_Hel.desc: The story of the warlord Mendia is well known among the Kirab. How she escaped slavery in the north, abandoning her former life. This <Unique>Unique</> armor is modelled after her own - reinforced to keep her enemies at bay.

This <Unique>Unique</> light armor is dyed to look almost like inkvine, despite being made from lesser materials.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique04_Hel.desc: Denira Quirth never intended to fight a war - she just wanted to survive it. When the Sandflies defected she swore not to shed the blood of her former colleagues - despite believing that the Sandflies cause was just. Her <Unique>Unique</> armor is built to withstand the ordeals of Arrakis - but not the darts of her enemies.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique05_Hel.desc: The Chosen are the elite warriors of the Maas Kharet cult, which makes its home at the old power station of Mysa Tarill. Combat_Light_Unique_BiomeHeat_Top_03.desc: When they were establishing their presence in the Hagga Basin, the Slavers noticed that their slaves were often dying of heatstroke. They could not have their stock dying, so they developed this <Unique>Unique</> jacket to protect their slaves from the worst of the elements. Sometimes even the worst of people have good ideas. Just don't look too closely at the leather.

Combat_Light_Unique_BiomeHeat_Top_04.desc: Once in a while, there is a glitch in the gigantic entity that is CHOAM and the supply chains get crossed and something is sent to the place it was never meant to be. These <Unique>Unique</> jackets, which arrived on Arrakis in very limited supply, are made of a much lighter material than the standard, which means they are cooler and more protective.

Combat_Light_Unique_BiomeHeat_Top_05.desc: These <Unique>Unique</> jackets were designed for the workers and guard from the Mysa Tarill power station. They are a cut above the usual supplies given out to pyons — probably because the power station was manned by a crew of highly trained engineers. Like the station, these jackets have mostly been long since abandoned.

Combat_Light_Unique_BiomeHeat_Top_06.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> light chest armor is made with breathable material which allows House forces to better survive harsh desert climates.

Combat_Neut_AtreidesDeserterUnique01_Boo.desc: Amongst the Kirab there is a common expression "there is only the final oath". The Kirab know how close they are to the edge, to becoming what they despise, scavengers without friend or family, consigned to the southern reaches of Hagga Basin. This <Unique>Unique</> armor is a remnant of those who have forsaken their final oath - their oath to the Kirab themselves.

Combat_Neut_AtreidesDeserterUnique02_Boo.desc: Zaal Karak is a ruthless slavelord who runs his operation with an iron fist. This intimidating <Unique>Unique</> heavy armor was commissioned as a present for him from the na-baron of the Harkonnen, Feyd-Rautha. It is Zaal Karak and his men who supply the bulk of slaves for the building of Neo-Carthag.

Combat_Neut_AtreidesDeserterUnique03_Boo.desc: Though the Sandflies have long since broken ties with the Miner's Guild, they still maintain the gear and traditions of their former life. These <Unique>Unique</> boots are modified duneman boots - built for long hours in the mines.

Combat_Neut_AtreidesDeserterUnique04_Boo.desc: In ancient mythology, Acheron was said to be the entrance to hell. This <Unique>Unique</> armor was retrieved from a shipwreck in the Sheol and became sought after due to its thick protective layer. Not that it helped those who died of radiation in the Sheol.

Combat_Neut_AtreidesDeserterUnique05_Boo.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> heavy armor has internal layers of reinforced metal to protect House troops from darts, however the bulk of this armor greatly increases stamina costs.

Combat_Heavy_Unique_Reinforced_Boots_05.desc: General Mendek of the Harkonnen famously led a battlegroup during the Battle of Arrakeen that used old-world artillery to seal Atreides forces in shield wall caves. Mendek had this <Unique>Unique</> armor conditioned as a reminder of the battle, sometimes wearing it to remind himself of what it must have felt like to be trapped in those caves, with no way to escape.

Combat_Heavy_Unique_Reinforced_Boots_06.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> armor is handed out to the legal representatives of CHOAM, such as lawyers and tax collectors. Unfortunately the bright orange CHOAM logo tends to make them more of a target, despite the reinforcement.

Combat_Light_Unique_Climbing_Gloves_06.desc: These <Unique>Unique</> light armor gloves assist House troops in climbing, making it less arduous and stamina draining.

Combat_Light_Unique_DewReap_Gloves_03.desc: Treated with a small amount of huf-huf oil, these <Unique>Unique</> gloves repel water and prevent any additional dew from escaping while harvesting.

Combat_Light_Unique_DewReap_Gloves_04.desc: Treated with a small amount of huf-huf oil, these <Unique>Unique</> gloves repel water and prevent any additional dew from escaping while harvesting.

Combat_Light_Unique_DewReap_Gloves_05.desc: Treated with a small amount of huf-huf oil, these <Unique>Unique</> gloves repel water and prevent any additional dew from escaping while harvesting.

Combat_Light_Unique_DewReap_Gloves_06.desc: The treatment for these gloves was designed by the traitor, Dr Yueh. Originally he was searching for a way to repel blood from gloves during surgeries, but the applications of his water repellant treatment were wider than he imagined. Treated with a small amount of huf-huf oil, these <Unique>Unique</> gloves repel water and prevent any additional dew from escaping while harvesting.

Combat_Light_Unique_MovingDmgReduction_B.desc: These {Unique} light armor boots use the wearers kinetic energy to stimulate additional adrenaline production.

Combat_Heavy_Unique_PowerEfficient_Glove.desc: Iri was a leader among the Kirab who became obsessed with finding a way to nullify the Holtzman effect. His tinkering led to the development of these <Unique>Unique</>  gauntlets that use a feedback loop to decrease power usage. Iri himself claimed that the gauntlets "spoke" to him and his state of mind deteriorated greatly until he threw himself from a cliff.

These <Unique>Unique</> gauntlets used to be attached to uncooperative slaves - shocking their palms as a punishment. One supervisor noticed that slaves equipped with the gauntlets needed to recharge their tools and power packs less frequently. The gauntlets were quickly modified to a low level current and given to all workers. Even slavers value efficiency.

These <Unique>Unique</> gauntlets were developed to help fatigued miners keep going when their tools were running low. Containing a series of capacitors within them, they help to even out the power flow and increase efficiency. The Sandflies have co-opted these gauntlets for use in their own operations.

HoltzmanShieldActiveDrain.desc:
An <OldImperial>Old Imperial</> personal shielding device that can be manually toggled on and off to deflect incoming darts and blades at the cost of power from a Power Pack. However, the slow blade penetrates the shield and melee combatants will take advantage of this.

The shield also prevents objects from exiting, thus it will automatically deactivate when firing darts or throwing objects. It will then automatically reactivate according to its refresh time. While active, the shield generates sounds and vibrations that drive sandworms mad. Usage on open sands is not recommended.
