ContractExperimentalMissileComponent.desc: The tangled remains of an experimental missile. While it’s unlikely you can reverse-engineer the missile, someone with more resources might manage it.

ContractHarkonnenCasualtyReport.desc: The combination of numbers and three-letter-acronyms makes very little sense to you. Someone with a better understanding of Harkonnen Battle language might be able to decipher it.

D_ContractWrappedPackage.desc: Wrapped in thick spice-cloth, the contents of this package are a mystery. It seems unlikely you could open it without leaving a trace.

ContractCrysknifeHilt.desc: Split lengthwise, it is unlikely this hilt will ever hold a blade again. Small shards of sandworm-tooth stuck in the hilt indicate that this was once a legendary crysknife. Someone in Harko Village would be very interested in this.

ContractCHOAMCommuninetTransceiver.desc: Aside from a label identifying this item as CHOAM company property, this appears to be a standard Communinet transceiver. A local CHOAM representative would probably like this back.

ContractCHOAMEmployeeRecords.desc: A long list of names and personal information that would be invaluable to anyone trying to impersonate a CHOAM employee. A local CHOAM representative might pay for its retrieval.

ContractBlightVials.desc: The sealed vials all appear empty. It seems like one of the vials is missing. Stark warning labels make it clear that opening these vials would be a bad idea. Someone probably wants this back.

ContractHarkonnenPhraseBook.desc: A detailed surveillance report mentioning several ships, passing or crashed, in the vicinity, with coordinates marked down. Several sightings match the Kytheria's description.

D_bcvvk.desc: A surprisingly short list of spice shipments to various locations. Whatever storage facility this refers to is clearly not seeing a lot of traffic.

k5ubg.desc: This Communinet transponder is tuned to secret Sandflies channels. It would be a major boon to anyone wanting to listen in on their communications.

nhbeu.desc: Wrapped in thick spice-cloth, the contents of this package are a mystery. It seems unlikely you could open it without leaving a trace.

deday.desc: This long list contains extensive descriptions and measurements of people, although the lack of names makes it of questionable utility if trying to find someone.

mspam.desc: This crude map shows some local landmarks and some vague hints that there might be spice fields nearby. It seems to be in a code you are unlikely to break before sandstorms makes this info obsolete.

czbpd.desc: This crude map shows some local landmarks and supposedly some other locations of interest. Being unfamiliar with the meaning of the markings, this map reveals no useful information to you.

D_ufphz.desc: This Dew Reaper is equipped with a tracking mechanism and some kind of utility lock. It can't be used by anyone who is not attuned with it. The original owner probably wants this back.

D_nh66q.desc: A list of short descriptions of people, followed by the amount of water extracted from their bodies. One entry reads Dew Collector Foreman - 6 literjons.

nlckv.desc: This book goes into great detail on how to grow Hufuf plants. Parts seem to have been added recently, noting the peculiarities of growing these plants on Arrakis, concluding that this is really only feasible in the confines of a biological testing station. Someone at the Anvil would probably be interested in this.

D_ytdqg.desc: We're late on our delivery to Crossroads, but unless the Harks and Atreides suddenly decided to have peace I think they'll buy the copper anyway.

xlkqy.desc: Alright, it's time we pack up all the scrap we've gathered so far and start hauling it over to Pinnacle Station. Let Traj worry about how he is going to get that stuff past the Harkonnens.

wy1ll.desc:
Once we are done sorting out the electronics we can move them over to Griffin's Reach and get paid. 

Make sure to remove any sign that we got this from an Atreides 'thopter, or we'll get another two-hour lecture from Charki.

lhi1g.desc:
Our equipment is breaking left, right, and center. We all know what needs to be done: one of you needs to go to Griffin's Reach, talk to Charki, restrain the urge to shoot him in the face, and get us a repair tool. 

Take some Trout Leather to barter with. Charki hates us, but he is also a businessman.

cto37.desc: We have a massive pile of stuff that the marks were carrying when we grabbed them. We should offload it before we move this herd to Harko. Traj at the trade post goes on and on about how he hates Slavers, but he buys our stuff all the same. Easy profit.

D_w6dn1.desc: This ash is all that remains from a pile of Elacca wood. It has little purpose beyond chemical analysis. Someone in Windsack might be interested in this.

D_rq8um.desc: This set of pages tells of desperate attempts to stretch the supply of Semuta further, including trying to mix in spice. Someone in Windsack might be interested in this.

yhxzy.desc: A document detailing the sale of munitions to both the Harkonnen and Atreides.

sftnj.desc: This long list contains a series of codes coupled with physical descriptions and vocational skills. Beside the code ALDAX804 is the notation  'Transferred to Neo-Carthag.'

ojwn1.desc: Wrapped in thick spice-cloth, the contents of this package are a mystery. It seems unlikely that you could open it without leaving a trace.

j78fc.desc: A CHOAM contract for mercenary service.

ogv8a.desc: A box marked as belonging to the record department of Imperial Testing Station No. 2. Someone interested in the history of this facility would probably pay for this.

moqep.desc: A folded page of spice paper bearing an indecipherable coded message.

ContractSlavers2FakedEvidence.desc:
To the Slaver Scum: Use any means necessary to enslave any Atreides troops you come across. House Harkonnen does not care about what caste they belong to — all will serve the Baron.

Signed, Gregory Harkonnen

ContractFactionMaximSemutaLogs.desc: Among the other Semuta buyers on the list, you find the name: Maxim Kazmir. Even better, the payment methods suggest he's using more than his own funds. Some of these resources were meant for House Harkonnen.

ContractFactionAntonFabricatedDocument.desc: A set of official-looking forged documents, describing the alleged wrongdoings of one Anton Tolliver. Only slightly exaggerated.

ContractFactionSpyEncryptedReport.desc: The dead spy's report is encrypted with expertise and tech far beyond your ability to decipher. It’s all rather suspicious for something found on such a low-ranking agent. Still, Tolliver or Kazmir may have the means of unlocking its secrets.

ContractMaasKharet3Amplifyer.desc: A technical component bearing multiple warning labels, among them is one reading 'FOR USE WITH AUTHORIZED EQUIPMENT ONLY'

ContractMaasKharet3Modulator.desc: A very visible warning label declares 'DO NOT USE WITH HANDHELD CUTTERAYS. INSTALLATION BY AUTHORIZED PERSONEL ONLY. KEEP AWAY FROM CHILDREN AND MAULA.'

ucoza.desc:
You ask 'who is the Red Scorpion?' But I say, don't ask 'who,' but 'what.' The Red Scorpion is an idea. A stinger in the flesh of the Atreides. A poison in the blood of the Harkonnen.

I am not a Duke or a Baron. I am just a man. But I am the Red Scorpion.

vjkv3.desc:
Strike with superior force where the enemy is weak.

Refuse to be pinned down by the enemy, always maintain a clear route of retreat.

A fair fight only benefits your opponent.

If you expend lives to hold territory, you will only lose both.

Be like water — hard to find and quick to disappear.

sjrlz.desc:
Worried about the Slavers? Run with Tarit, he knows their plans better than they do. 

Worried about the Sardaukar patrols? Run with Tarit, he knows how to avoid the ships.

Worried about the worms? Let Tarit show you how to avoid the open sand.

dfgsh.desc:
Drot's band always gets the best loot. Everybody knows this!

Are you tired of taking out scavengers for half a literjon of water and a handful of Solaris? Do you want to live like a Duke, even just for a day? Join Drot's band!

ContractRewardItem.desc: Proof of a contract fulfilled, to be handed in at any Tradepost Contracts Board for payment.

ContractFactionKytheriaSandfliesNote.desc: This letter, while blood-stained, is still legible: "Deliver the goods to the Sandflies, before we’re found out. They’ll pay handsomely. — Skorda”

ContractKirab2SpicePackage1.desc: A package containing a sizable amount of spice. It is hermetically sealed and marked with the Harkonnen crest. No legitimate spice dealer would buy this.

ContractKirab2SpicePackage2.desc: A package containing a sizable amount of spice. It is hermetically sealed and marked with the Harkonnen crest. No legitimate spice dealer would buy this.

ContractKirab2Contract5.desc:
House Harkonnen has identified the culprit behind the theft of several decagrams of Spice. Posing as a potential buyer, I have been in contact with the thief and duped them into a rendezvous — your team is to meet them there, kill them, and bring back the stolen goods.

Remember that I am paying extra for your discretion. Under NO CIRCUMSTANCES are you to bother any other representatives of House Harkonnen pertaining to this matter.

ContractKaraValkServoControl1.desc: A device for adjusting servo-stimulator output in the target's brain. Each is tuned to a specific range of servo-stimulators.

ContractKaraValkServoControl2.desc: A device for adjusting servo-stimulator output in the target's brain. Each is tuned to a specific range of servo-stimulators.

D_ContractSeronValkinSwordHilt.desc: A well-worn sword hilt. Close examination reveals that it is inlaid with traditional motifs of House Ginaz.

D_ContractSeronValkinTleilaxuEyes.desc: Insect-like compound eyes fashioned out of metal.

ContractYatesCarryallContract.desc: An agreement between the Sandflies and a carryall pilot named Tripp Yates, hiring him to transport a container from a shipwreck in the Hagga Rift. No mention is made of its contents.

ContractScorpionDeliveryReport.desc: A report on the successful delivery of several spice shipments to anonymized wealthy customers, several of them in Arrakeen. One shipping canister sent to Desert Testing Station 142 is described as being recovered from "the wreck".

ContractFactionTaintedSpiceContainer.desc: This is, without a doubt, one of the containers Skorda attempted to smuggle to Arrakis.

ContractSpiceResidueSample.desc: A spice sample taken from the canister recovered from the Kytheria wreck. It looks and smells like any other spice melange on Arrakis.

ContractAtreidesIDTag.desc: This Atreides House Trooper identification tag lists a serial number along with the name "Yang, Trenton A". Tiny instrumentation, built into the tag, notes the date and time when this device ceased detecting heartbeat and respiration data from its wearer.

ContractSeronVarlinSwordHilt.desc: A well-worn sword hilt. Close examination reveals that it is inlaid with traditional motifs of House Ginaz.

ContractSeronVarlinTleilaxuEyes.desc: Insect-like compound eyes fashioned out of metal.

D_WoHCaptainClearenceCard.desc: Ixian security clearance card found at the Captain's Chair, at the Wreck of The Hephaestus

WoHIxianDecoder.desc: Ixian minimic film decoder tool found at the Captain's Chair, at the Wreck of The Hephaestus

WoHBloodyEyeball.desc: Bloody eyeball taken from Ixian crewman, it could be used to gain access to pentashields locked behind retina scans

SietchMnemeticFilm.desc: Encoded minimic film found in the Safe inside the Sietch. It will require some sort of decoder to gain access to its information.

ContractBG2FremenFamilyRecords1.desc: A more or less complete listing of every Fremen who has ever passed the Trials of Aql, and who their offspring were.

ContractBG2FremenFamilyRecords2.desc: Long lists of Fremen names, with particular focus on the line of Naibs for every major sietch.

ContractBG2EcologicalLexicon.desc: A detailed account of how Kynes connected the Fremen's religious teachings with the science of ecology, in an attempt to turn Arrakis green.

ContractBG2SyndicateContract.desc: Kept deliberately away from the formal system of contracts, this note orders its bearer to find, apprehend, or kill 'the rogue Bene Gesserit'. The bearer is then ordered to report to Margot Fenring.

ContractSeronVarlinFenringChallenge.desc: Addressed to Count Hasimir Fenring, invoking the laws of Kanly.

ContractZaynDeWitteGangMinimicFilm.desc: This minimic film details the Mobula gang's deals related to slave trade in the Hagga Basin. It is damning evidence, for all parties involved.

ContractZaynDeWitteDeserterBloodSample.desc: The tissue sample was retrieved from a specific group of Atreides deserters in the Hagga Rift.

ContractZaynDeWitteDeserterMinimicFilm.desc: The film contains details of the deserters' operations in the Hagga Rift and is intended for Thufir Hawat's eyes only.

ContractZaynDeWitteTleilaxuDatapad.desc: If there is any information pertaining to the Bene Tleilax conditioning Zayn de Witte was subjected to, it will be on this datapad.

ContractKaraValkMedicine1.desc:
These stims are mostly reserved for use in palliative care, but they can also offset the worst episodes of withdrawal symptoms a person with an unreliable servo-stim implant might suffer.

Long-term usage is not recommended.

ContractKaraValkTransmitterFinal.desc: A master transmitter, able to access any servo-stimulator implant in its vicinity. Could be used to sever the link to the implant, allowing for non-lethal removal.

ContractSeronVarlinDamasteelSword.desc: Forged to Seron's specifications, it seems more a piece of art than a blade.

ContractPlanetologist1AReels.desc: A box marked as belonging to the record department of Imperial Testing Station No. 197. Someone interested in the history of this facility would probably pay for this.

ContractPlanetologist2AReels.desc: A box marked as belonging to the record department of Imperial Testing Station No. 76. Someone interested in the history of this facility would probably pay for this.

ContractPlanetologist3AReels.desc: A box marked as belonging to the record department of Imperial Testing Station No. 29. Someone interested in the history of this facility would probably pay for this.

ContractPlanetologist4AReels.desc: A box marked as belonging to the record department of Imperial Testing Station 071. Someone interested in the history of this facility would probably pay for this.

ContractPlanetologist5AReels.desc: A box marked as belonging to the record department of Imperial Testing Station No. 163. Someone interested in the history of this facility would probably pay for this.

ContractSlavers1DeserterArmors.desc: A tightly wrapped bundle of clothes, some with bloodstains. None of the clothes seem likely to fit you.

ContractScavengers1HoltzmanAmplifier.desc: The machine seems to be in a useable state, at least to your untrained eye. What exactly it does is a complete mystery to you.

ContractScavengers1AutomatedPoisonSniffe.desc: You are not overly familiar with this model, but it does not seem to have detected anything recently. Perhaps it is broken?

ContractFactionFalsifiedCommunicationsLo.desc: A falsified communication log, meant to incriminate someone at Helius Gate.

ContractFactionLetterFromAnton.desc: A personal letter from Anton Tolliver.

ContractFactionAlteredLetterFromAnton.desc: An altered version of Anton's letter, written by you and Maxim Kazmir.

D_ContractPlanetologist2Report.desc: A compiled and edited report on the records found inside Imperial Testing Station No. 197. Someone spent a lot of time on this.

ContractPlanetologist2ChanisNote.desc: A note written in Chakobsa. Derek Chinara might be able to decipher it.

ContractFactionPoisonVial.desc: A rare vial of poison, coveted by enthusiasts and assassins alike.

ContractFactionAtreidesInfoLog.desc: An Atreides information log, containing classified military secrets.

ContractFactionAlteredAtreidesInfoLog.desc: An altered version of the Atreides information log.

ContractFactionSpyDecryptedReport.desc: A decrypted report from a dead spy. It contains data unknown to you, but you recognize the words "Kytheria", "Chloros" and "Skorda". Anton Tolliver will be able to analyze this.

ContractKynesNotes.desc: Even with your considerable training, you are not able to make sense of these notes — it'd likely take a very experienced Planetologist to decipher the work.

HarkonnenSpyList.desc: A ledger with names and badly disguised symbols, clearly listing several Harkonnen undercover agents located in and around Helius Gate.

ZantaraSignetRing.desc: Zantara's Signet Ring acquired in the lab under Old Carthag.

ContractKaraValkCodedManifest.desc: A coded slaver servo-stim shipping manifest, seemingly neatly organized — more insight would require proper deciphering.

ContractBG1Doc1.desc:
"The Lisan al-Gaib defies opposites.
He may be as a stranger to you and as one who has always lived among you.
He may see the future whilst gazing into the past.
He may be both dead and alive."

ContractBG1Doc2.desc:
"The blade of the Mahdi is slow, but immutable.
Like a doctor's knife, it cuts to heal.
What his blade takes from you:
Rejoice, for he has relieved you of a burden."

ContractBG1Doc3.desc:
"It is written: Suffer not a witch to live among us.
Who is this witch?
Not one who knows the weirding way, but one who is warped by weirding.
Where demons make their home, a witch must die."

RecustomizationFunnelSparePartsContainer.desc: A container with thick walls to keep its contents cool. An animated display shows the internal temperature, which is slowly rising now that the container has been removed from its power supply.

EventChoamCargo.desc: A sealed container of importance to CHOAM

RecustomizationFunnelImportPermit.desc: This piece of densely-printed spice paper allows the holder to import a list of specific goods into Arrakeen.

JourneyCarthagSchematics.desc: Intricate schematics over Old Carthag with markings and scribblings on several points of interest. It's dated <imp>10194</> (10194).

JourneyBlackmailLetter.desc: A blackmail signed Phaedra Vye, laced with perfume. <i>"My dear, a reminder of the promise you made. Tell it all, or I tell the Harkonnens. The Wissova is waiting."</>

JourneyValetLocationNote.desc: Instructions from Phaedra to her valet to transport some boxes to Sector B-5 in the Deep Desert.

ContractScandalIntelPackage.desc: The package contains a wild array of things, including several items that seem to relate to Captain Stein and Lieutenant Inius.

JourneyBlackMarketTraderNote.desc: A trade receipt from Tidjii O'garee. The receipt doesn't disclose what items were traded.

JourneyManifestPiece1.desc: A sheet with lists of names, each stating a shared stock volume and total value. Some names have been struck through, and the total value adjusted on the remaining names. The sheet seems to be the second part of a longer document.

JourneyManifestPiece2.desc: A sheet with lists of names, seemingly the first page of the previous list. A name is scribbled on the top, "Overseer Mon Torsival"

JourneyBanquetGuestList.desc:
A guest list for a banquet. 13 names are on the list. Most names seem to be the same as from the manifest.

Phaedra Vye
Mon Torsival
Marara Torbin
Priorin Tannat
Len Artuni
Agade Yimari
Ogdan Barbalescu
Menoria Tamar
Roella Ramsby
Oona Byrn
Venesir Ask
Bianca Bagetti
Eulalia Harthorn
Hesperia Farani
Ansel Virro

JourneyValetCrypticNote.desc: The valet seems to have noted down instructions from Phaedra to remember a code; <i>"Picture me in my glorious days before the downfall of a once great city."</>

SheolScanLog.desc: Scan logs from the Sheol, supposedly containing information about dynamic fragmentation of microwave irradiated rock.

ScannerAnalysis.desc: Scan information from Shahbazi Hoon, supposedly containing detailed information about scrap, junk and other materials in areas of interest to someone at Pinnacle Station.

ShipmentofJunk.desc: A shipment of only the finest pieces of junk, curated by Shahbazi's Heritage Imports.

RadioactivecratePinnacleStation.desc: A crate of irradiated Sheol materials for shipment to Pinnacle Station. Thankfully, the crate shields from the radiation of its contents.

RadioactivecrateCrossroads.desc: A crate of irradiated Sheol materials for shipment to Crossroads. Thankfully, the crate shields from the radiation of its contents.

RadioactivecrateAnvil.desc: A crate of irradiated Sheol materials for shipment to the Anvil. Thankfully, the crate shields from the radiation of its contents.

ContractBanquetTailoringMaterials.desc: The package contains expensive fabrics and other materials needed to make a high-quality formal dress.

ContractBanquetFakeBrandyCrate.desc: While the labels on the crate claim that the contents are several bottles of caladanian brandy, but the discerning eye notices a few discrepancies between production date, import label, and the shipping ID number.

ContractBanquetCaladanianBrandyCrate.desc: A crate with intact seals and matching records, containing several bottles of the finest Caladanian Brandy. It must have cost a small fortune to get these to Arrakis.

JourneyPoisonSnooper.desc: A handheld contraption that allows for scanning objects in order to detect poison.

JourneyBarPoisonReport.desc: A slip from the poison snooper, confirming a strong poison trace from the book Osten Laithe was reading.

JourneyApartmentPoisonedMask.desc: A slip from the poison snooper, confirming a poison trace on a small, retractable needle inside the mask.

JourneyBanquetEarring.desc: A small earring found at the banquet.

JourneyBanquetMonogrammedHandkerchief.desc: A monogrammed handkerchief found near the dining table, bearing the initials M.T.

ContractMarketManipulationMessage.desc: The message makes it quite clear that the recipient is not welcome here. It would probably be best if they didn't see you place it.

ContractMarketManipulationParasites.desc: Whalefur, once on dry land, is quite susceptible to parasites. Any competent trader would go to great lengths to ensure their products are kept clean at all times. Placing these at the local supply of whalefur would certainly send a message.

ContractMarketManipulationMeatPoison.desc: This is not particularly sophisticated poison, but no one wants to buy from a merchant whose products trigger a poison snooper.

JourneyArchivesToken.desc: A token given to you by Ariste. It should grant access to the Arrakeen Palace.

JourneyRadiationCoreMap.desc:
This hastily drawn map shows the two possible locations of the radiation core:

<s>Wreck of the Delphis (aft)</>
Wreck of the Ourea

JourneyRadiationCore.desc: This radiation core appears stable. Still, the safest thing would be to avoid keeping it it in close proximity for long.

JourneyElaccaShipmentInfoMap.desc: The elacca shipment is located inside the Wreck of the Stasanor in the Deep Desert sector A-9

JourneyElaccaShipment.desc: A secure container of processed Elacca extract, the coveted drug derived from the poisonous Elacca wood found in the jungles of Ecaz.

JourneyUnconsciousSuboid.desc: This ghoulish creature is unconscious, but still alive. Best to deliver it before those terrible eyes open again.

JourneyUnconsciousGhola.desc: This failed Ghola abomination is dormant but breathes faintly. Best to handle this gently and deliver it to Maksim before it awakens.

LandsraadNavigationLog.desc: "The long list of coordinates and navigational short-hands makes little sense to you."

LandsraadEngineeringLog.desc: "You lack the necessary understanding of space travel to fully grasp what this book is telling you."

LandsraadRadiationSample1.desc: A sample gathered from the substance in the radioactive pools. The container feels warm to the touch.

LandsraadRadiationSample2.desc: A sample gathered from the substance in the radioactive pools. The container feels warm to the touch.

LandsraadRadiationSample3.desc: A sample gathered from the substance in the radioactive pools. The container feels warm to the touch.

LandsraadWaterContainer.desc: A container used to store and transport water, with a capacity of 1 liter.

LandsraadGeneratorComponent1.desc: The exact mechanism of this device eludes you, but you do know how it could be used to create a new power generator.

LandsraadGeneratorComponent2.desc: You are unsure whether the generator was ever designed to be taken apart like this, but think that you can put it back together again. Probably.

LandsraadSurveillanceSensor.desc: A common form of listening device with local recording and broadcasting functionality. Now that you know what they look like, you have started to notice these things everywhere.

LandsraadMiningLaser.desc: This component seems to have created a vacuum in the surrounding sand, causing oxygen to rush in and creating a form of tidal dust which sucked the vehicle in.

LandsraadSecretCargoContainer.desc: A small specialized cargo container coveted by the Syndicate

LandsraadPowerGenerator.desc: A functional power generator. It doesn't look like it would stand up to the climate of Arrakis for very long.

LandsraadSecretCargoManifest.desc: Cargo manifest from the Tyche containing a detailed list of all cargo on board. One entry is redacted.

LandsraadSecretPassengerManifest.desc: Passenger manifest from the Tyche containing a detailed list of all passengers on board.

LandsraadIrradiatedLiquid.desc: Liquid salvaged from broken vats in the the wreck of the Tyche, irradiated by the crash.

LandsraadPowerpackComponent.desc: Power pack utilizing new cutting-edge energy storage technology, assembled from irradiated materials found in the wreck of the Tyche. Highly volatile.

LandsraadPoisonResearchData1.desc: Research notes left behind by the scientists experimenting on elacca and fogwood combinations.

LandsraadPoisonResearchData2.desc: Research notes left behind by the scientists experimenting on elacca and fogwood combinations.

LandsraadPoisonResearchData3.desc: Research notes left behind by the scientists experimenting on elacca and fogwood combinations.

LandsraadPoisonSample.desc: A sample from a poisonous plant in Testing Station No. 195.

LandsraadDarknessAnalyzedBlood.desc: The test results from the suboid blood samples.

LandsraadElectricalExperimentalWindTurbi.desc: A generator for the experimental wind turbine.

LandsraadSealedRecorder.desc: A sealed recorder used for recording illicit track data. The recorder must be primed with a track data console.

LandsraadDeserterTrainingSword.desc: A training sword from the large deserter camp atop the Blushing Cavern.

LandsraadDeserterCutteray.desc: A Cutteray from the Deserter mining camp near the Blushing Cavern.

LandsraadMysteriousNote.desc:
Note found in an unearthed container.
<i>…the gambling debt has come due. I need to get to the meeting point, but I fear an ambush. I’ve hidden the jewels in the place we agreed on, Aisha. In the cavern, in the container. Harvest the crystals and behind them, you’ll find the hollow place.</>

LandsraadHagalCrystal.desc: A pristine Opafire gem with unrivaled prismatic qualities.

LandsraadSensorCalibrationPack.desc: A sensor calibration pack tuned specifically for use in the Blushing Cavern, an integral part of the Ixian Transeye.

LandsraadIxianSurveillanceDevice.desc: An Ixian Transeye equipped with automatic cloaking tuned to the Blushing Cavern frequencies, rendering it invisible and impossible to track.

LandsraadCactiResearch.desc:
Cacti in this area have undergone mutations. The regular cactus has already been sent for processing, but we need samples from the final three variants.
Blood Cacti are created when blood is spilled at the base of a cactus. Poison Cacti explode if approached, the theory is that the Maas Kharet altered them by injecting them with poison. 
And the glowing cacti - these might just be a lost cause and should be destroyed. They are most likely radioactive and thus entirely unfit for consumption. More data is needed to confirm this theory.

LandsraadRadiationSample4.desc: A sample gathered from the substance in the radioactive pools. The container feels warm to the touch.

LandsraadDarknessMedicalEquipment1.desc: Medical equipment found in Doctor Lemenger's laboratory. It can be used to extract and hold blood samples.

LandsraadDarknessExtractedBlood.desc: Blood extracted from a suboid in Doctor Lemenger's laboratory.

LandsraadMiningLaser2.desc: Field fluctuations in the area around this mining laser seem to indicate that it caused a localized Holtzman explosion – reversing gravity and depositing this groundcar high in the sky

LandsraadMiningLaser3.desc: Unclear why this one was destroyed – perhaps it was simply the bandits attacking it?

LandsraadMiningLaser4.desc: This one was being dismantled by the bandits, it is clear that they are very interested in the experimental technology here.

LandsraadMiningLaser5.desc: From the state of this component, it was destroyed before the bandits got their hands on it.

LandsraadMiningLaser6.desc: This one seems to the be the one they really wanted. Maybe it does something very special when it interacts with Erythrite.

LandsraadTreasureNote.desc: I dunno why this mentat was snooping around, but I don’t like it. I dragged his corpse out to the edge of the bled. Let the hawks and the storms take care of it.

LandsraadDeserterHead1.desc: Cassian’s personal Vulcan GAU-92, known as “Ironstorm". It spits a whirling storm of iron across the sands.

LandsraadDeserterHead2.desc: Leon's personal flamethrower. The chassis is etched with the name “Ifrit,” honoring the fabled desert spirits said to breathe living fire.

LandsraadFremenFindsArtifact1.desc: Piece of a door mechanism which seals the doors of a sietch.

LandsraadFremenFindsArtifact2.desc: Another piece of the door mechanism of a great sietch.

LandsraadFremenFindsArtifact3.desc: This third artifact is a mural clearly also taken from a door. Perhaps the museum these belong in does not have a door.

LandsraadElectricalExperimentalWindTurbi.desc: A component needed to craft the Experimental Wind Turbine.

LandsraadGhostsOfTsimpoCisternNote.desc: Our scouts report those damnable thieves are holed up near the old Cistern. Go kill them all, and if anyone else dares to utter another ghost story, I'll have their head!

LandsraadSurveyingTsimpoProbes.desc: Survey probes recovered from the fallen scout team. Modified to map local areas for spice concentrations. The staking units were driven into the ruins during the team’s first pass, meant to anchor the probes against the choking dust. If they can be found, the survey for the rumored spice cache may yet be completed.

LandsraadPhasedancersTriDProjectionLens.desc: A precision lens used in advanced solido projection and disruption systems.

LandsraadPhasedancersSolidoDissembler.desc: A pattern-interference module calibrated for solido lattices. When attached to a projection array, it collapses any constructs generated by the array.

LandsraadSurveyingTsimpoSpiceCache.desc: A spice cache recovered from the Ruins of Tsimpo. Once buried beneath debris, its presence was confirmed through your survey efforts.

LandsraadWatershipperlog1.desc: PH_Details of water yields and a redacted section

LandsraadWatershipperlog2.desc: PH_Details the findings of a dangerous cryogenically stable virus in the ice

LandsraadIceCoreSample.desc: PH_An ice core sample from the deepest caves in the ice cap containing a dangerous cryogenically stable virus

LandsraadTerrainRecorder.desc: PH_A terrain recorder that records the surroundings with timestamps

LandsraadMinefieldSurveyor.desc: PH_A device that scans terrain for subsurface hazards across a wide area

LandsraadBalanceofTradePuzzleSolution1.desc:
PH_To open the vault you need to input the following amount of Glacial Ice in each of the Ice processors
Para-North pipe requires 3 Glacial Ice
Para-South pipe require 4 Glacial Ice
Para-East pipe requires 1 Glacial Ice
Para-West pipe require 2 Glacial Ice

LandsraadBalanceofTradePuzzleSolution2.desc:
PH_To open the door you need the activate the ice melting process in this order.
Para-North, Para-West, Para-South and then Para-East. Once you have done this you can try to open the door.

LandsraadEnvironmentalControlStimCrate.desc: PH_Sealed crate containing experimental stims produced in a location called the Facility

LandsraadEnvironmentalControlStimBluepri.desc: PH_Top secret blueprint containing information about how to make the stims

LandsraadRareMetalsMineralExtractorFrame.desc: This frame is necessary in the construction of the Ore Extractor Prototype used to harvest rare minerals from asteroids.

LandsraadRareMetalsInductionCoils.desc: This coil is necessary in the construction of the Ore Extractor Prototype used to harvest rare minerals from asteroids.

LandsraadRareMetalsExtractor.desc: This prototype is designed to harvest rare minerals from asteroids.

LandsraadRareMetalsRareMinerals.desc: Rare minerals extracted from an asteroid by the Yafengs.

LandsraadIdentifyingTag.desc: A small tag containing the identity and location of its wearer.

LandsraadWatchingTheRunSurveillanceSenso.desc: A common listening device with local recording and broadcasting functionality. Now that you know what they look like, you've started to notice these things everywhere.

LandsraadTerminalVelocityExperimentalEng.desc: An experimental sandbike engine sporting a suspicious hole that appears to have been caused by a heavy dart, rendering it unusable.

LandsraadConvergenceTriangulator.desc: An Ixian Triangulator used to find the geographic center between three points.

LandsraadConvergenceRelic.desc: An intricately carved fremen relic depicting a sandworm coiled around twin moons. The artifact exudes the gravity of years beyond counting.

LandsraadSampleRecoveryFirstSample.desc: An intact sandworm scale capable of withstanding extreme heat, pressure, and penetration.

LandsraadSampleRecoverySecondSample.desc: A strand of internal tissue believed to relay impulses throughout the body of a sandworm.

LandsraadSampleRecoveryThirdSample.desc: A ligament from the inner maw of a sandworm, believed to be remarkably resistant to heat and pressure.

LandsraadSampleRecoveryFinalSample.desc: An internal sensory organ believed to allow sandworms to detect seismic vibrations across vast distances.

PlanetologistFunnelReport.desc: A detailed report, that you have made, on the recent activities of the Planetologist Derek Chinara.

ContractPaybackDrotsJournal.desc: This journal of a late Kirab leader contains notes and secrets regarding his criminal enterprises.

SuspensorGrenade_Reduction.desc:
This device, when thrown, uses a modified secondary phase Holtzman field to negate the effect of gravity in a spherical area. You can use the sphere to lift enemies or prevent fall damage during traversal.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

HunterSeeker.desc:
You have been trained in the use of the Hunter-Seeker, a specialized assassination device used to kill enemies without causing alarm. You pilot a thin sliver of metal that, when it strikes, burrows inside the arteries of the enemy and causes them incredible pain and often, instant death. You are vulnerable while piloting the device.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

SuspensorBlast.desc:
You manipulate the suspensor field generated by your suspensor belt - forcing it to explode around you with extreme force, pushing enemies back, damaging them, and impairing their movement for a short time. You can hold the ability to increase the damage dealt and time the blast release.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

SuspensorGrenade_Amplification.desc:
This device, when thrown, uses a modified secondary phase Holtzman field to amplify the effect of gravity in a spherical area. You can use the sphere to slow enemies and drain their power or decrease the speed of projectiles.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

SuspensorWall.desc:
You deploy a half-height holtzman shield that provides cover during combat for you and your allies. It will also slow enemies who attempt to pass through it - giving you time to take them down.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

D_PlaceableMine_Remote.desc: The Explosive Mine is triggered remotely at some distance from its placement. Level up this ability to increase damage.

MagneticAttractor.desc:
Originally used as a training device to offset poor aim, the Attractor Field uses a modified Holtzman field to draw attacks towards it’s center. Attach it to an enemy and any shot fired into the field will redirect into their center of mass.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

Riposte_Injure.desc:
You enter a heightened state of awareness and when next attacked in melee, you parry and counterattack with a savage riposte that bleeds and damages your enemy.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

Riposte_Break.desc:
You enter a heightened state of awareness and when next attacked in melee, you parry and counterattack with a precise strike that damages their arm and numbs them. For a short period of time, their damage output is reduced.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

PlaceableMine_Suspensor_Amplification.desc:
This mine, when triggered, uses a modified secondary phase Holtzman field to amplify the effect of gravity in a spherical area. You can use the sphere to slow enemies and drain their power or decrease the speed of projectiles.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

PlaceableMine_Suspensor_Reduction.desc:
This mine, when triggered, uses a modified secondary phase Holtzman field to negate the effect of gravity in a spherical area. You can use the sphere to lift enemies or prevent fall damage during traversal.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

KneeCharge_Starter.desc:
You propel yourself forward into battle with a terrific knee charge into the enemy. Deals damage and severely staggers your opponent, but costs stamina.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

Deflection_Slow.desc:
You enter a defensive stance, deflecting darts that are fired at you. This ability lasts as long as your stamina holds out.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

BattlefieldCalculation.desc: Use to scan of nearby characters and objects. Enemies will show their archetype and traps will show their damage type. Level up this ability to increase duration.

SardaukarPull_Short.desc:
You use a wrist-mounted launcher to fire off a claw attached to a cable of shigawire. The extreme tensile strength of shigawire launches you in the direction of the cable. It can also be used to stagger opponents during combat.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

CapsuleLauncher_Poison.desc:
You have a hidden dart dispenser that fires off a specially prepared capsule filled with poisonous spores. On impact, a cloud of poison spores appears, building poison on all who remain within.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

FragGrenade_TimedFuse.desc:
You throw a grenade with an explosive core that detonates in a spray of shrapnel, damaging anybody within the radius. Though the shrapnel is incapable of penetrating a shield, the shockwave of the blast can still damage a shielded enemy.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

Hypersprint_FastSpeed.desc:
You override your nervous system and musculature with an immense surge of activity, allowing you to run forward at an incredible speed.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

Compel_LongRange.desc:
You use the Voice to force a target to your position from afar. Voice abilities require a short period for you to "register" your opponent before they can be used.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

BlindSpot.desc:
You use the Voice to force your target to ignore you. For a short while, they will act as if you are completely invisible. Voice abilities require a short period for you to "register" your opponent before they can be used.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

WeirdingStep.desc: Combining the Voice and a limited form of Bindu Sprint - you stun a single enemy while moving with superhuman speed behind them.

HoltzmanCollapseGrenade.desc:
This device, when thrown, uses a modified secondary phase Holtzman field to attract anybody within a spherical area. Those inside the sphere are drawn together and temporarily stunned, leaving them open to your area of effect attacks.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

SolidoDecoyStationary.desc:
You use a miniature solido projector to project a near-perfect image of yourself onto the battlefield. Triggering it again will force the projection to move forward, fooling enemies into attacking.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

PoisonMine.desc:
You can place a remotely triggered mine that, once triggered, releases a cloud of poisonous spores - stacking poison on all who stand within.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

SuspensorDisc.desc:
Drop a suspensor device that launches yourself (and targets) into the air. Useful for navigation and traversal.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

LitanyAgainstFear.desc:
Reciting this litany aloud will instantly hearten any allies nearby, as well as providing you with the strength to push through almost any attacks. You and your allies will have boosted damage mitigation and stagger resistance for the duration.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

NerveStrike.desc:
You tap into your training to deliver a rapid series of powerful, painful strikes to enemies. This attack leaves them temporarily staggered.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

PortableGenerator.desc:
You place out a powerful generator that continuously regenerates power for nearby allies. Though the device uses a form of nuclear fission, it is small enough to be safe provided that it is given adequate time to cool between uses.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

EnergyCapsule.desc:
You pop an energy capsule, which fills you with a concoction of neurostimulants and pain dampeners. You become detached allowing better targeting and ranged damage.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

BattleCry.desc:
You inspire yourself and your companions to greater heights, increasing the damage of your melee attacks.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

StunnerDart.desc:
You have a hidden dart dispenser that fires off a specially prepared sedative tipped dart. On impact, this dart stuns the enemy, locking their muscles and rendering them unable to move or attack.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

D_GrenadePoison.desc: LOC_The grenade contains highly toxic chemicals that become aerosolized upon detonation.

VoiceStop.desc:
You use the Voice to stop enemies in a cone in front of you from performing any actions for a brief period. Voice abilities require a short period for you to "register" your opponent before they can be used.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

Whirlwind.desc:
You pirouette with your blade, becoming a whirlwind of piercing damage that cuts everything around you. While seemingly chaotic, the swordmaster maintains calm - the eye at the heart of the storm.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

CripplingStrike.desc:
You move in, striking at a low angle to cut your enemies below the knees. For a while after being hit, your enemies are slowed and their dashes require more stamina. While not the most honorable of attacks, the swordmaster understands that there is a difference between a duel and a war.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

D_TurretSeeker.desc: Place an inactive Sentry Turret. Trigger a second time to activate, causing the turret to automatically shoot anyone in its line of sight.

AssaultSeeker.desc:
A modified hunter seeker that will fly in a direct line and explode upon contact with anything. Can be triggered to explode with a second activation. Useful for situations where a thrown grenade is not precise enough.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

SuspensorPad.desc:
Drop a suspensor device that launches yourself (and targets) into the air. Useful for navigation and traversal.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

TurretMine.desc:
You deploy a suspensor buoyed dart projector that uses motion detection to cover a field of fire. Trigger a second time to activate.

Abilities must be equipped and activated from the ability bar.

D_SuspensorSeeker_Throw.desc: LOC_Throw a seeker with a suspensor wall attached.

D_AmmoPack_Dart_Light.desc: When Holtzman shields were introduced the use of lasguns became too dangerous and subsequently, the use of dart projectiles became the standard ammunition of House Troops and other military forces.

D_AmmoPack_Dart_Heavy.desc: For use in larger and more powerful weapons, Heavy Darts are standard ammunition and can pierce certain types of armor.

D_AmmoPack_Napalm.desc: Few weapons inspire the type of fear created by fire. Use this ammunition in conjunction with incendiary weapons to instill maximum terror in your adversaries.

D_RepairPack_WeldingMaterial.desc: Welding material required to use the Welding Tool to repair vehicle health. Crafted from Salvaged Metal parts.

SpiceAddictionConsumable_01.desc: The spice melange extends life, expands consciousness and allows the mysterious navigators of the spacing guild to guide heighliners safely between the stars. This food is seasoned with spice melange and will raise the amount of spice in your blood.

D_ContractSemutaNotes.desc: This set of pages tells of desperate attempts to stretch the supply of Semuta further, including trying to mix in spice. Someone in Windsack might be interested in this.

HighCapacityLiterjon.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> lightweight water container created by the Fremen for those going on a journey of seeking. Often carried by wali on their trial of aql, the contents were donated from the entire sietch as a sacrifice for good luck. Stores more water than ordinary literjons, and takes up less space.

AntiRadiationPill.desc: Shortens the time required for radiation breakdown within the body and further shields the body from exposure to radiological exposure when used with a radiation suit.

WaterPack_Consumable.desc: Purchase to immediately refill your hydration meter by 100mL.

SaphoJuice.desc: Drink to reduce the time it takes to activate mentat vision abilities.

Bloodsack_01.desc: An item that can store blood collected with a Blood Extraction Tool. Deposit in a Blood Purifier to make drinkable water. Can be drunk directly to rehydrate, but max health will suffer.

Decajon.desc: A <Fremen>Fremen</> item that can store water collected with a Dew Reaper or that has been transferred from other sources. Popularized by Dew Farmers due to its large capacity, but it's large size makes it difficult to carry arround.

Bloodsack_Unique_Durable_02.desc: Scipio was a Kirab Warlord who took over the Wreck of the Pallas when it fell during the War of Assassins. Over time, Scipio became known for his brutal torture of those who trespassed on his territory. He would extract most of the blood from their bodies, then abandon them near the leaking radiation core by the engines of the Pallas. This <Unique>Unique</>blood bag is able to tolerate large amounts of reuse - a reminder of its twisted legacy.

Bloodsack_Unique_Durable_03.desc: A whisper and a rumor, even among the slaver's themselves is the Slavelord known as the Glutton. His origins are clouded in mystery, but he has carved himself a space within the cutthroat world of the slavers - literally. His wake is littered with corpses and it is rumored that the Glutton is a cannibal. This <Unique>Unique</> bloodbag was apparently designed by him, but to what end, even the Slavers don't seem to know.

Bloodsack_Unique_Durable_04.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> bloodbag was symbolically named for the blood that the Sandflies shed when they rebelled against the Miner's Guild. Though the gesture is symbolic, the practicality of the blood bag is not.

Bloodsack_Unique_Durable_05.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> bloodbag is used by the Mass Kharet to gather large quantities of water for sacrifice to Shai-Hulud. Though others view the cults habits as wasteful, their leader knows that sacrificing something as precious as water is a mark of power.

Bloodsack_Unique_Durable_06.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> bloodbag is named for the Baron Harkonnen. During one of his infrequent visits to Arrakis, he had a group of Fremen sacrificed in Carthag, and then hung bags full of their blood in public places throughout the city - daring others to come and try to reclaim their water.

D_ArmorPack_Heavy_T5_RedScorpion.desc: Unpacks into a complete set of <Unique>Unique</> armor reminiscent of the infamous rebel's battle suit.

D_ArmorPack_Stillsuit_T5_MaasKharet.desc: Unpacks into a <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit reminiscent of those favored by the Maas Kharet.

ArmorPack_Swordmaster.desc: This container unpacks into a complete set of <Unique>Unique</> armor of the kind used by Swordmasters.

ArmorPack_BeneGeserit.desc: This container unpacks into a complete set of <Unique>Unique</> armor of the kind used by the Bene Gesserit.

ArmorPack_Mentat.desc: This container unpacks into a complete set of <Unique>Unique</> armor of the kind used by Mentats.

ArmorPack_Trooper.desc: This container unpacks into a complete set of <Unique>Unique</> armor of the kind used by Troopers.

ArmorPack_Planetologist.desc: This armor container unpacks into a complete set of <Unique>Unique</> stillsuits of the kind used by Planetologists.

BasePack_Copper.desc: A bundle containing the materials necessary to construct a basic base.

BasePack_Iron.desc: A bundle containing the materials necessary to construct a standard base.

BasePack_Steel.desc: A bundle containing the materials necessary to construct a specialized base.

Consumable_Buff_PoisonStackIncrease.desc: In a hidden Imperial Testing Station, experiments in hybridizing fogwood and elacca plants led to madness and death. A beneficial byproduct of these experiments, these <Unique>Unique</> pills utilize properties extracted from both plants. Said pills slows toxin absorption down to half its usual speed, allowing one to take on impressive amounts of poison before suffering ill effects.

HeatConsumable.desc: PH_Can be used to stay warm for a longer time in cold climates.

B1C4_Unique_Consumable_T2.desc: PH_Can be used to stay warm for a longer time in cold climates.

D_AssaultRifleBlueprint.desc: The standard assault rifle for more than a hundred years, the Karpov 38 shone due to its simple design and very low maintenance needs

D_AtreArmorHeavyGlovesSchematic.desc: Green, black, and red have been the colors of House Atreides going all the way back to the days of Atreus. In addition to its proud history, Atreides armor is reputed to be among the most efficient in the Imperium

D_AtreArmorHeavyHeadSchematic.desc: Green, black, and red have been the colors of House Atreides going all the way back to the days of Atreus. In addition to its proud history, Atreides armor is reputed to be among the most efficient in the Imperium

D_AtreArmorHeavyTorsoSchematic.desc: Green, black, and red have been the colors of House Atreides going all the way back to the days of Atreus. In addition to its proud history, Atreides armor is reputed to be among the most efficient in the Imperium

D_AtreidesScanner_Schematic.desc: The hawk-eyed Atreides' scanner has a particularly long range, perfect for reconnaissance

D_BloodSack_Schematic.desc: Used to store blood extracted via exsanguination

D_OrnithopterMediumLauncher_5_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an assault ornithopter rocket launcher

ChoamHeavyLasgunSchematic.desc:
When a lasgun contacted a hot shield in Carthag, it was a disaster. Thousands died in the ensuing nuclear blast and the city was leveled.

Due to the devastating loss of life and spice production capacity, all lasguns imported to Arrakis are now fitted with a safety mechanism that immediately shuts them off if they are targeting a Holtzman shield, including this <Unique>Unique</> model.

D_ChoamMaulaPistolSchematic.desc: Lightweight but with a short range, the Maula Pistol is a reliable sidearm

D_ChoamMaulaPistolUniqueSchematic.desc: Lightweight but with a short range, the Unique Maula Pistol is very shiny reliable sidearm

D_ChoamSda6_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> Maula pistol has a modified spring mechanism that automatically reloads darts without releasing trigger pressure. This model is older than any others, and seems to have been developed by the Fremen. It differs from the designs that integrate the modifications from Count Fenring.

ChoamStaticCompactorSchematic.desc: According to the Spice Miner's Guild Handbook, A static compacter is a miner's first and foremost tool and its care and use should be second nature to every miner.

D_ChoamTankBoostSchematic.desc: Although it's never going to set any land speed records, equipping the tank with a booster will add very handy, quick maneuverability

D_ChoamTankInventorySchematic.desc: Not primarily designed for cargo the tank can nevertheless be equipped with a storage unit. You may need to exit the tank to access it, however, and that isn't always advisable

D_DewReaper1Schematic.desc: Even from the humble weed can one sometimes find the sustenance needed to survive in the desert

Flamethrower1Schematic.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> item. Little known fact: Jared Garoti was a notorious pyromaniac in his early years and nearly burnt his ancestral home to the ground building one of his creations.

D_HandHeldTorch_Schematic.desc: Can be used to light up dark places

D_HarkAr3_Schematic.desc: Anton Karpov continued to make incremental improvements on what is widely considered a perfect design

D_HarkAr4_Schematic.desc: The new version came out in the 70s during a particularly garish fashion season and this model has since been tainted by a look that is now considered quite out-of-style

D_HarkAr5_Schematic.desc: State-of-the-art assault weapon and status notifier in mercenary and other parastate military circles

HealthPackSchematic.desc: Bodies are an engineering wonder but on Arrakis they often spring a leak. Use this kit to attend to desert and battlefield injuries

D_HeavyAmmoSchematic.desc: For use in larger and more powerful weapons, Heavy Darts are standard ammunition and can pierce certain types of armor

D_HoltzmanShieldBlueprint.desc: The beauty of the open desert has enchanted for millennia but it offers little in the way of cover should one require it. Equiped with a power pack the Holtzman provides just that

D_KindjalSchematic.desc: A common personal weapon popular among the family members of the great houses, the Atreides Kindjal is styled after the particular variety that Duke Leto Atreides himself carries

ManualOfTheFriendlyDesertSchematic.desc: A Fremen Handbook, with the ways of the desert.

NPE_ScrapMetalKnife_Schematic.desc: A Fremen Handbook, with the ways of the desert.

D_MiningTool_1h_HeavySchematic.desc: For those who can afford one, CHOAM's  largest and most powerful cutteray will make quick work of any mining job

D_MiningTool_1h_LightSchematic.desc: Planning to dabble in some mining? CHOAM offers a selection of cutterays in a range of power levels. This entry-level unit will suit the hobbyist

MiningTool_1h_StandardSchematic.desc: Harmless to humans, the laser from a cutteray is uniquely suited to extracting resources from stone and other formations. It is the tool from which all else follows

D_MiningTool_2h_StandardSchematic.desc: This is no archaic miner's pick, this cutteray is built to do the work with a minumum of effort

D_NapalmSchematic.desc: Few weapons inspire the type of fear created by fire. Use this ammunition in conjunction with incendiary weapons to instill maximum terror in your adversaries

D_OrnithopterEngine_Schematic.desc: Delivering over 1500 shaft horsepower to the wings, this engine packs an enormous amount of power into a compact assembly

D_OrnithopterInventoryModule_Schematic.desc: Early designs of the ornithopter made no allowance for cargo at all, making them useful only for short-haul personnel transport. This addition will earn its cost in no time

D_OrnithopterLightBodyBlueprint.desc: Designed by engineers working in isolation, its a wonder that the disparate parts of the ornithopter worked together so well in the end

D_OrnithopterLightChassisBlueprint.desc: Truly an example of excellence in design, the frame of the ornithopter has not changed in over nine models in the past twenty years

D_OrnithopterLightCockpitBlueprint.desc: The latest design for the cockpit has finally accounted for pilot comfort and includes a vibration dampening assembly for the seats

D_OrnithopterLightSet.desc: XX_Take to the sky and peer down on those scrambling across the burning sands, you used to be one of them but no longer

D_OrnithopterLightWingsBlueprint.desc: Constructed of tempered plasteel these wings are light, tough, and flexible enough to withstand hours of operation in the brutal heat of the desert

D_OrnithopterTransportSetSchematic.desc: This is not for those who need to overcompensate. Carrier ornithopters are just what is required if you need to carry multiple passengers or lift a sandcrawler

D_PortableFabricatorSchematic.desc: This is a portable device for crafting some items

D_PowerUnitLightBlueprint.desc: Absolutely of no use without one of these, don't let your ornithopter be grounded for lack of power

D_PowerUnitVeryLightBlueprint.desc: CHOAM is forever promising to improve the capacity of the sandbike PSU but critics say there is little financial advantage for them to do so

D_RadiationSuitSchematic.desc: The radiation suit is a personal protection garment that can shield the body from exposure to radiological exposure and allow the wearer to fight or otherwise function in a contaminated area.

D_RepairKitSchematic.desc: XX_A kit used to perform field repairs

D_RepairToolSchematic.desc: Things fall apart, the center does not hold. And for that reason, you will need to make the occasional repair

D_SandbikeChoamPassengerSeatSchematic.desc: Those who complain about the comfort  of the i90 sandbike passenger seat assembly have likely never sat on its predecessor, the i65

D_SandbikeEngine_Schematic.desc: Many a hobbyist has one of these in their shed for weekend tinkering, but when there's work to be done nothing beats an engine in working order

D_SandbikePassengerSeatSchematic.desc: XX_Those who complain about the comfort  of the i90 sandbike passenger seat assembly have likely never sat on its predecessor, the i65

D_SandcrawlerBodyBlueprint.desc: A relative newcomer to the industrial spice harvesting lineup, the sandcrawler quickly found its market among successful independent prospetors, a niche that CHOAM had previously underestimated

D_SandcrawlerCockpitBlueprint.desc: Boasting the most ergonomically designed cockpit of any harvester big or small, some old hands derided  owners of these vehicles for needing to be coddled in such upper-class luxury

D_SandcrawlerEngine_Schematic.desc: The sandcrawler engine, while delivering impressive torque, used to require bespoke valves available only from CHOAM. When third parties began to manufacture serviceable alternatives, CHOAM promptly changed the design

D_SandcrawlerHeaderBlueprint.desc: Revolutionary when it was first released, the scouring surface and primary filters of the sandcrawler are four times less likely to pick up rocks and other debris than many of the coarser units

D_SandcrawlerTreadsBlueprint.desc: Formed into a solid continuous strip of temperature and wear-resistant, vulcanized rubber, sandcrawler tracks have the advantage of being shielded by a plasteel cover which, if open, can pose a significant safety risk

D_Scanner_Schematic.desc: Base scanner that scans for everything

Schematic_UniqueBattleRifle.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> battle rifle has been modified with a mechanism that adds a touch of explosive powder to every dart that passes down the barrel. Though ranged weapons are uncommon elsewhere in the Imperium, on Arrakis they have become more prevalent due to the deemphasis on shields.

Schematic_UniqueBikeBoost.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> booster comes with an extra large air intake for better performance during the cool evening on Arrakis, though it helps very little during the superheated air of the day. Standard gear amongst the Dunemen who prefer to work by night.

Schematic_UniqueBuggyBoost.desc: Named for the cool-blooded snakes of old earth and the inevitable shaking and rattling that comes when it is engaged, this <Unique>Unique</> boost module generates less heat, but like the snake it is named for, is a little more sluggish when cool.

Schematic_UniqueChoamSword.desc: During the Butlerian Jihad, pulse-swords were used to cut through the thinking machines and damage their electronics with pulses of deadly electricity. It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries. This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when parrying an enemy - offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary swords of the Butlerian Jihad.

Schematic_UniqueCutteray2.desc: When the mining facilities were abandoned in the Vermillius Gap, Sim and his fellow miners decided to try their luck as scavengers. Sim 'borrowed' a <Unique>Unique</> cutteray from the ironworks, discovering too late that it was tuned for increased Granite, Copper and Salvage yields and only had basic Iron yields. 'Oh the iron-y' Sim was heard to exclaim.

Schematic_UniqueCutteray3.desc: When Olef was assigned to the great ironworks in Vermillius Gap, he didn't despair. He saw opportunity amongst the spires of stone — a lot of thirsty miners and nowhere to drink. He started stealing supplies and set up his own little after-hours establishment selling spice-laced moonshine. Before long, he was so busy he had no time to fill his mining quotas. He had a drunk engineer create this <Unique>Unique</> cutteray to help him stay afloat.

Schematic_UniqueCutteray4.desc: Callie worked the great galleries of the rift, until the Kytheria crashed and the war escalated into the caverns. She joined the deserters, carving tunnels through the old mining galleries using her trusty buggy and her favorite tool. Callie was lost when one of the tunnels she was opening collapsed beneath her, but her <Unique>Unique</>tool was retrieved.

Schematic_UniqueCutteray5.desc: When Pardot Kynes began his work with the Fremen, he brought them into the Imperial Testing Stations as laborers. He gave them access to the technology and science of the Imperium. Soon enough, cutterays began appearing in Sietchs, sculpting tunnels and windtraps to help with Pardot's long term plans. This <Unique>Unique</> cutteray has been optimized for the ores and rock deposits on the area around Sietch Tarl.

Schematic_UniqueCutteray6.desc: Optimized for the operations of the Sandflies, this <Unique>Unique</> cutteray lasts longer than a regular cutteray and delivers increased yields of aluminum.

Schematic_UniqueDewReaper.desc: Crafted to the same general standards of other Dew Reapers, this particular design was modified by Thufir Hawat to ease the lives of the Atreides pyons. This <Unique>Unique</> Dew Reaper siphons a portion of the Holtzman field that powers the collection of dew to lighten the Dew Reaper itself, allowing an easier swing, lighter load and more efficiency in the long run.

Schematic_UniqueDirk.desc: Once there was a slave called Fila. She was captured by slavers while very young and dragged to Arrakis to serve the Harkonnen as a slave. While she lay dreaming in a slaver camp in Jabal Eifrit, disturbed by the spice that she was ingesting from the air, she dreamed of a flaming dirk that could set her free. When she woke, this <Unique>Unique</> dirk was in her hand. Fila slew several of her captors, burning them with the knife, before she fled south and disappeared. Though some say, she changed her name to Mendia and her story continued.

Schematic_UniqueFlamethrower.desc:
If there was one weapon the Sardaukar used to inspire fear in the Fremen, it was the flamethrower. In the narrow corridors of the sietch warrens, a single Sardaukar could become a firestorm of death and destruction. Perhaps worse, for the Fremen, the corpses could not be recovered for their water.

This <Unique>Unique</> flamethrower has a higher gel capacity and more intense flame.

Schematic_UniqueForgeChest.desc: The Syndicate is a large offworld criminal organization that has never been able to get a foothold on Arrakis — due to the tireless efforts of Esmar Tuek and the smugglers to keep them out. Nobody knows why their mercenaries have begun to arrive in the Hagga Basin, nor what their interest is in the radiated wrecks of the Sheol. This <Unique>Unique</> armor is designed to keep environmental hazards at bay.

Schematic_UniqueLiterjon.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> lightweight water container created by the Fremen for those going on a journey of seeking. Often carried by wali on their trial of aql, the contents were donated from the entire sietch as a sacrifice for good luck. Stores more water than ordinary literjons, and takes up less space.

Schematic_UniqueMaulaPistol.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> Maula pistol has a modified spring mechanism that automatically reloads darts without releasing trigger pressure. Rumor has it that Count Hasimir Fenring designed this modification himself, admiring the design of the maula pistol while decrying the inefficiency of its firing mechanism.

Schematic_UniqueOathbreakerChest.desc: Amongst the Kirab there is a common expression "there is only the final oath". The Kirab know how close they are to the edge, to becoming what they despise, scavengers without friend or family, consigned to the southern reaches of Hagga Basin. This <Unique>Unique</> armor is a remnant of those who have forsaken their final oath - their oath to the Kirab themselves.

The Kirab know how close they are to the edge, to becoming what they despise, scavengers without friend or family, consigned to the southern reaches of Hagga Basin. This <Unique>Unique</> armor is a remnant of those who have forsaken their final oath - their oath to the Kirab themselves.
