The Kirab know how close they are to the edge, to becoming what they despise, scavengers without friend or family, consigned to the southern reaches of Hagga Basin. This <Unique>Unique</> armor is a remnant of those who have forsaken their final oath - their oath to the Kirab themselves.

Schematic_UniquePincushionChest.desc: Aren was a disgraced Kirab warlord who fled south to live amongst the scavengers. He developed this <Unique>Unique</> scavenger armor - but it did not save him when the Kirab sent a squad south to eliminate him.

Schematic_UniquePincushionFeet.desc: Aren was a disgraced Kirab warlord who fled south to live amongst the scavengers. He developed this <Unique>Unique</> scavenger armor - but it did not save him when the Kirab sent a squad south to eliminate him.

Schematic_UniquePincushionHands.desc: Aren was a disgraced Kirab warlord who fled south to live amongst the scavengers. He developed this <Unique>Unique</> scavenger armor - but it did not save him when the Kirab sent a squad south to eliminate him.

Schematic_UniquePincushionHead.desc: Aren was a disgraced Kirab warlord who fled south to live amongst the scavengers. He developed this <Unique>Unique</> scavenger armor - but it did not save him when the Kirab sent a squad south to eliminate him.

Schematic_UniquePincushionLegs.desc: Aren was a disgraced Kirab warlord who fled south to live amongst the scavengers. He developed this <Unique>Unique</> scavenger armor - but it did not save him when the Kirab sent a squad south to eliminate him.

Schematic_UniqueRapier.desc: A lethally modified version of a slaver weapon, this <Unique>Unique</> sword contains a series of toxin releasing nodules along the length of the blade. When struck with enough force, these nodules release a burst of poisonous gas - capable of passing through a shield. The slaver version of this weapon was used to release a sedative gas for capturing the unwilling.

Schematic_UniqueScattergun.desc: Thin spikes in the barrel mean that the darts fired from this <Unique>Unique</> scattergun will break into multiple shrapnel pieces on impact, causing a bleeding effect on enemies. It isn't known who created such a sadistic weapon - but it is commonly used by the Kirab of Hagga Basin.

Schematic_UniqueSMG.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> disruptor has been modified to spray doubleshots of heavy darts at a slower rate. The name is based on a popular joke that made the rounds on Arrakis a few years ago - a comment on the Baron's preferences and the virility of his younger brother, Abulurd. Anybody who was heard making the joke in Harkonnen territory was hanged, of course.

Schematic_UniqueSuspensor.desc: A prop from the famous play 'My Father's Shadow', this <Unique>Unique</> suspensor belt is used by Jongleurs for short, but effective bursts of floating during performances. Jump twice to activate and float upwards. Suspensor fields are notorious for preserving momentum, and they deplete power as long as they are kept activated.

Schematic_UniqueThopterBoost.desc: Though the sandstorms of Arrakis have been known to reach 700kms an hour and tear metal to shreds, still there are those who insist on trying to boost through them. This <Unique>Unique</> boost module has a larger air intake to avoid dust clogging - it keep the 'thopter cool but at a cost of overall boost speed.

Schematic_UniqueThumper.desc: Modified to follow the Fremen design, this <Unique>Unique</> thumper generates a large amount of threat with the sandworm in a short amount of time. Just be sure to place it on open sand.

D_ScrapMetalKnifeSchematic.desc: Designed by necessity using whatever is close at hand, nothing says I intend to survive like carrying your own scrap metal knife

D_SmugglerBuggyBody_Schematic.desc: XX_For a while it was easy to spot Marek Budaar speeding over the dunes due to his jury-rigged dune buggy. It looked like something out of a post-apocalyptic nightmare. The old thing ultimately fell apart and he had to replace it

D_SmugglerBuggyChassis_Schematic.desc: XX_The dune buggy experienced a short-lived fad on the planet Chusuk when it became popular for teenagers to order dune buggy kits and assemble the vehicles themselves

D_SmugglerBuggyCockpit_Schematic.desc: The dune buggy cockpit is a spartan affair with few instruments or dials. Many find that appealing and appreciate the relative lack of components likely to break down

D_SmugglerBuggyEngine_Schematic.desc: XX_Powerful for its size, the dune buggy engine does need careful maintenance and attention must be paid to its fluid levels

D_SmugglerBuggyInventory_Schematic.desc: The dune buggy may not be what you want cruising up to the royal palace, but have a look at the trunk space! More than adequate for your average spice prospector

D_SmugglerBuggyPSU_Schematic.desc: Early PSUs for the dune buggy were notoriously short of life and it was common to carry three at a time even for normal operation. Their staying power has been much improved since then

D_SmugglerBuggyTreads_Schematic.desc: XX_Development of the track wheels for the dune buggy was delayed as scientists struggled to keep them unclogged under wet conditions. Fortunately, that is never an issue on Arrakis

D_SolidoConstructionProjectorSchematic.desc: Orgon Valise once said Pre-visualization is in equal measure as important as the materials used in any project. Use this device to project the prospective placement of building parts

StilltentSchematic.desc: This stilltent will retain some lost moisture while sheltering from the elements in the desert.

D_SwordBlueprint.desc: A common personal weapon popular among the family members of the great houses, the Atreides Kindjal is styled after the particular variety that Duke Leto Atreides himself carries

D_T1_Armor_BanditLeathers_Schematic.desc: Tanning animal hides to obtain flexible and durable material for use in clothing has been practiced for millennia. Used more for its low cost and ease of production, it does not provide the same level of protection as ordinary armor

D_T1_Consumables_Dewpack_Schematic.desc: XX_A dewpack is a small container used to transport water. It can be filled by collecting dew from plants using a dewreaper

D_T1_HarkonnenHandScanner_Schematic.desc: Scan, and it will be revealed

D_T1_MeleeKindjal0_Schematic.desc: A common personal weapon popular among the family members of the great houses, the Atreides Kindjal is styled after the particular variety that Duke Leto Atreides himself carries

D_T1_MiscEquipment_PassiveReductionSuspe.desc: Automatically suspends to prevent fall damage

D_T1_SocialClothing_PrisonUniform_Schema.desc: The curtailing of freedom is just one of the difficulties encountered during incarceration. There is as well, the systematic stripping of one's unique identity as one is folded into the group. Chief among the methods to achieve this is the uniformity of dress. The prisoner becomes one's identity

D_T1_Structure_RespawnBeacon1_Schematic.desc: Placing this device in an appropriate place adds a site at which your character can be respawned. Only one beacon can be active at a time. Placing a new beacon will replace the existing one.

D_T1_Tool_MiningTool1hBasic_Schematic.desc: Harmless to humans, the laser from a cutteray is uniquely suited to extracting resources from stone and other formations. It is the tool from which all else follows

T1_UtilityClothing_LeakyStillsuit_Schema.desc: In the desert, any retained moisture can mean the difference between life and death. Though this stillsuit is damaged, it does still function well enough to preserve a minimal amount of the bodies moisture

D_T2_Consumables_Literjon_Schematic.desc: Larger than a dewpack, a literjon is a reusable water container. Although more cumbersome, it permits a larger range of exploration in the waterless desert

D_T2_MeleeWeapon_ChoamSword_Schematic.desc: The sword is longer and heavier than a kindjal, but utilizes sweeping attacks that can help deal with multiple foes. Can penetrate shields. A <GreatHouse>Great House</> item.

D_T2_MeleeWeapon_ShortSword_Schematic.desc: Slightly longer than the kindjal, the Atreides short sword is often used in concert with the Kindjal, one in each hand

D_T2_MiscEquipment_HoltzmanShield_Schema.desc: The beauty of the open desert has enchanted for millennia but it offers little in the way of cover should one require it. Equiped with a power pack the Holtzman provides just that

T2_MiscEquipment_PowerPack_Schematic.desc: The first generation of power packs were quite unstable and had a unfortunate habit of blowing its user to smithereens. The design has since been improved to ensure this happens quite rarely now

D_T2_MiscEquipment_SuspensorBelt_Schemat.desc: Another application of the Holtzman Effect, doctors threatened muscle atrophy would proceed from their use. In fact, this is a relatively rare consequence

D_T2_RangedWeapon_SMG_Schematic.desc: As the Holtzman Effect is impervious to fast moving ballistics, Disruptors instead fire darts of variable velocities in order to find penetration points on the shield. Once inside a Holtzman Shield they trigger a static pulse that impacts the power flow to the shield. If enough disruptor darts penetrate, a shield can be taken offline. A <GreatHouse>Great House</> item.

D_T2_SocialClothing_WindsackCommoner_Sch.desc: Loose fitting and comfortable, Windsack civilian garments are designed simply and with the harsh heat of the planet in mind. Not meant for combat, they offer little in the way of protection from small weapons fire

D_T2_UtilityClothing_PatchyStillsuit_Sch.desc: In rough shape, this stillsuit has seen better days. Its filters are ragged and clogged and its tubing is badly worn. There's a faint rancid odor to it emanating from the sweat of its previous owner. It won't win any beauty pageants, but it will keep you alive, for a while

D_T2_Vehicle(Air)_SandbikeEngine_Schemat.desc: XX_Many a hobbyist has one of these in their shed for weekend tinkering, but when there's work to be done nothing beats an engine in working order

D_T2_Vehicle(Ground)_SandBike_Set.desc: Walking in the desert is for Fremen and sandworm food. In order to get to the spice blows before there's nothing left, you're going to need motored transport.

D_T2_Vehicle(Ground)_SandBikeBodyHull_Sc.desc: Components for the sandbike were close to impossible to procure during the workers' strike on Naraj and scrap dealers made out like bandits. That is until CHOAM took over and through force of arms put everyone back to work

D_T2_Vehicle(Ground)_SandBikeChassis_Sch.desc: Termed a hollow-body construction, the sandbike frame is an ingenious balance of strength and lightweight design

D_T2_Vehicle(Ground)_SandBikeInventoryMo.desc: Many users complain that it is never the correct shape to make complete use of the space, the storage unit is the most criticized part of the current sandbike

D_T2_Vehicle(Ground)_SandBikeTreads_Sche.desc: Debate rages over the relative merits of track wheels and low-pressure tires. With no real science leaning one way or the other, it comes down to personal preference

D_T2_Vehicle_SandbikeChoamFuelEfficientP.desc: Components for the sandbike were close to impossible to procure during the workers' strike on Naraj and scrap dealers made out like bandits. That is until CHOAM took over and through force of arms put everyone back to work

D_T2_WeaponMod_BattleRifleCombatSights_S.desc: Precision is key when using the Karpov-38 Battle Rifle and this combat sight brings the target in closer

D_T2_WeaponMod_SMGCombatSights_Schematic.desc: A handy addition for the M11 Submachine Gun, simply spraying bullets wildly as one enters battle can be very intimidating

D_T2_WeaponMod_SmugShot1x5Scope2_Schemat.desc: There is an Elephant Gun sight in the planetary museum on Chusuk that mysteriously survived and now stands as a reminder of the destruction of Zanovar

D_T2_WeaponMod_SmugShotBarrelExplosive2_.desc: Covers darts fired by the Smuggler Elephant Gun with an explosive substance, altering their damage type. Use at Modding Station.

D_T2_WeaponMod_SmugShotQuickscope2_Schem.desc: There is an Elephant Gun sight in the planetary museum on Chusuk that mysteriously survived and now stands as a reminder of the destruction of Zanovar

D_T3_Armor_CHOAM_Assault_Schematic.desc: CHOAM's first line of armor drew wide criticism for being bulky, noisy, and weak. After much development and many iterations, their construction began to improve. Nowadays CHOAM armor is the standard for many of the Imperium's militaries

D_T3_MeleeWeapon_Kindjal2_Schematic.desc: Able to hold an edge through multiple encounters, the honed Kindjal can slice through skin as easily as through silk

D_T3_MeleeWeapon_Rapier_Schematic.desc: The Atreides Rapier is a longer sword used for self-defense. Can penetrate shields.

D_T3_MiscEquipment_FullStabilizationBelt.desc: For those with not enough verticality in their lives, a suspensor belt can bestow the lift that one needs

D_T3_MiscEquipment_HoltzmanShield2_Schem.desc: The beauty of the open desert has enchanted for millennia but it offers little in the way of cover should one require it. Equiped with a power pack the Holtzman provides just that

D_T3_MiscEquipment_PowerPack2_Schematic.desc: The first generation of power packs were quite unstable and had a unfortunate habit of blowing its user to smithereens. The design has since been improved to ensure this happens quite rarely now

D_T3_Mod_ScannerProbeLauncher_Schematic.desc: This mod allows scanners to fire survey probes, greatly reducing the time it takes to survey locations

D_T3_Placeable_CompactSesmicProbe_Schema.desc: Will notify through the communinet when a sandworm enters or exits its search range

D_T3_Placeable_CompactThumper_Schematic.desc: Activating this device in the desert will cause vibrations that summon sandworms

D_T3_RangedWeapon_HeavyPistol1_Schematic.desc: Synonymous with the ask questions later kind of macho that pervades popular entertainment, this pistol nevertheless delivers unrivalled power in its class

D_T3_RangedWeapon_MaulaPistol2_Schematic.desc: An improvement on its predecessor, the Maula Pistol MK l did not sell well at first owing to its high price relative to its improvements. The price was subsequently dropped and sales picked up

D_T3_RangedWeapon_Scattergun1_Schematic.desc: Heavy for its size, it is highly recommended to hold the GRDA 44 with both hands despite certain actors portraying its use with one in each hand

D_T3_RangedWeapon_SmugglerRifle1_Schemat.desc: Another workhorse of a weapon, the JABAL Spitdart is of simple construction and easy to clean, which makes it a favorite on dusty Arrakis

D_T3_Structure_Atreides_Banner_Wall_Sche.desc: Hang this attractive banner to display appreciation for the Atreides

D_T3_Structure_DirectionalWindTrap_Schem.desc: Use this device to collect ambient moisture from the air coming from one direction

D_T3_Structure_DirectionalWindTurbine_Sc.desc: Placing this device in an appropriate spot will generate power from wind coming from one direction

D_T3_Structure_Harkonnen_Banner_Wall_Sch.desc: Hang this attractive banner to display appreciation for the Harkonnen

D_T3_Structure_MediumStorageContainer_Sc.desc: This container can be used to store and organize items

D_T3_Structure_SmallSpiceRefinery_Schema.desc: Place raw spice in this device to produce refined spice

D_T3_Structure_Smuggler_Banner_Wall_Sche.desc: Hang this attractive banner to display appreciation for the smugglers

T3_Tool_ScannerEfficient_Schematic.desc: An <Unique>Unique</> improved power-driven handheld exploration scanner that allows the user to project a scan in front of them to mark information on their map.

D_T3_Tool_ScannerOmni_Schematic.desc: Scan, and it will be revealed

D_T3_ToolMod_MiningTool_Durability_Schem.desc: Cutterays don't grow on trees so it just makes sense to make the one you have last as long as possible

D_T3_ToolMod_MiningTool_Emission_Schemat.desc: The desert can make an enemy of time as the heat steals your water with every passing moment. Make the most of every minute spent with this efficiency modifier

D_T3_ToolMod_MiningTool_Ergonomy_Schemat.desc: Making those precision cuts is always difficult, particularly so when the desert air is full of spice. Use this modification to steady your hand

D_T3_ToolMod_MiningTool_Yield_Schematic.desc: Looking to improve the output of your mining but lack the funds to get the next model up? Why not improve the cutteray you have?

D_T3_ToolMod_ScannerBioAmmo_Schematic.desc: This mod allows a scanner to detect lifesigns, or extends the range at which it can detect them if already able to.

D_T3_ToolMod_ScannerBioBarrel_Schematic.desc: This mod allows a scanner to detect lifesigns, or extends the range at which it can detect them if already able to.

D_T3_ToolMod_ScannerBioScope_Schematic.desc: This mod allows a scanner to detect lifesigns, or extends the range at which it can detect them if already able to.

D_T3_ToolMod_ScannerChemAmmo_Schematic.desc: This mod allows a scanner to detect resources, or extends the range at which it can detect them if already able to.

D_T3_ToolMod_ScannerChemBarrel_Schematic.desc: This mod allows a scanner to detect resources, or extends the range at which it can detect them if already able to.

D_T3_ToolMod_ScannerChemScope_Schematic.desc: This mod allows a scanner to detect resources, or extends the range at which it can detect them if already able to.

D_T3_ToolMod_ScannerTechAmmo_Schematic.desc: This mod allows a scanner to detect devices, or extends the range at which it can detect them if already able to.

D_T3_ToolMod_ScannerTechBarrel_Schematic.desc: This mod allows a scanner to detect devices, or extends the range at which it can detect them if already able to.

D_T3_ToolMod_ScannerTechScope_Schematic.desc: This mod allows a scanner to detect devices, or extends the range at which it can detect them if already able to.

D_T3_UtilityClothing_CHOAM_Stillsuit_Sch.desc: Originally developed by the Fremen, the stillsuit is a full-body garment designed to capture and recycle bodily fluids that would otherwise be lost, filling built-in catch pockets for the user to drink and rehydrate. CHOAM now mass produces a high-quality version with few if any improvements on the original design

D_T3_Vehicle(Ground)_ChoamBuggy_Set_Sche.desc: Favored by smugglers throughout the desert, the dune buggy is too unstable at high speeds for those without much experience

D_T3_Vehicle(Ground)_SandBikeBoostModule.desc: It may not have the acceleration of the ornithopter, but when Shai-Hulud makes an appearance, you'll be grateful for the extra torque the booster provides

D_T3_Vehicle(Ground)_SmugglerBuggy_Set_S.desc: XX_Favored by smugglers throughout the desert, the dune buggy is too unstable at high speeds for those without much experience

D_T3_WeaponMod_ChoamMaula1x5Scope2_Schem.desc: The Maula Pistol 1.5x Sight was  given to Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen as a gift when he was a boy and he used it to look at the stars for years before discovering its intended use

D_T3_WeaponMod_ChoamMaulaBarrelFire1_Sch.desc: As an entry-level pistol the Maula has some shortcomings when it comes to power, but adding the fire igniter improves its lethality quite significantly

D_T3_WeaponMod_CombatSights_Schematic.desc: The Maula Pistol Combat Sight was  given to Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen as a gift when he was a boy and he used it to look at the stars for years before discovering its intended use

D_T3_WeaponMod_ExplosiveGel_Schematic.desc: The volatility of this gel took researchers many months to stabilize and more than a few lives were lost in the process

D_T3_WeaponMod_HarkAr1x5Scope2_Schematic.desc: Precision is key when using the Karpov-38 Battle Rifle and this 1.5x sight brings the target in closer

D_T3_WeaponMod_HarkHeavyPistolQuickScope.desc: Under-rated and under used this sight can add faster target acquisition to this powerful handgun

D_T3_WeaponMod_PoisonCoat_Schematic.desc: The poison for the GRDA 44 Scattergun was developed on Ecaz and spawned a new and lucrative industry on the planet

D_T3_WeaponMod_ScattergunBarrelFire1_Sch.desc: The flammable substance for the GRDA 44 Scattergun was developed on Ecaz and spawned a new and lucrative industry on the planet

D_T3_WeaponMod_SmugDMRQuickScope2_Schema.desc: There is a JABAL Spitdart sight in the planetary museum on Chusuk that mysteriously survived and now stands as a reminder of the destruction of Zanovar

D_T4_Armor_CHOAM_Heavy_Schematic.desc: CHOAM's first line of armor drew wide criticism for being bulky, noisy, and weak. After much development and many iterations, their construction began to improve. Nowadays CHOAM armor is the standard for many of the Imperium's militaries

D_T4_Decoration_BunkBed_Schematic.desc: Better than the cold, ground this bed can be a welcome comfort at the end of a trying day

D_T4_Decoration_OutpostChair_Schematic.desc: CHOAM offers a wide selection of chairs to outfit any home and the company employs some of the Imperium's most notable industrial designers to improve their stock

D_T4_MeleeWeapon_ChoamSword0_Schematic.desc: The sword is longer and heavier than a kindjal, but utilizes sweeping attacks that can help deal with multiple foes. Can penetrate shields. A <GreatHouse>Great House</> item.

D_T4_MeleeWeapon_ShortSword2_Schematic.desc: A little-known fact is that Atreides blades are often the weapon of choice for graduates of the Ginaz School

D_T4_MiscEquipment_FullSuspensorBelt_Sch.desc: For those with not enough verticality in their lives, a suspensor belt can bestow the lift that one needs

D_T4_MiscEquipment_HoltzmanShield3_Schem.desc: The beauty of the open desert has enchanted for millennia but it offers little in the way of cover should one require it. Equiped with a power pack the Holtzman provides just that

D_T4_Mod_ScannerAnalysisScope_Schematic.desc: This mod allows getting more detailed information about scanned entities

D_T4_RangedWeapon_SMG2_Schematic.desc: Although this second iteration improved on its progenitor both are popular, appealing to slightly different demographics

D_T4_Structure_PentashieldCeiling_Schema.desc: Place this energy ceiling to use as a barrier

D_T4_Structure_PentashieldWall_Schematic.desc: Place this energy wall to use as a barrier

D_T4_Structure_SpiceBarrel_Schematic.desc: This barrel can be used to store spice

D_T4_Structure_Stakingunit_Schematic.desc: Use this device to stake out sections of land

T4_Structure_Thumper1_Schematic.desc: Activating this device in the desert will cause vibrations that summon sandworms.

D_T4_Structure_Turret_Schematic.desc: This turret can be loaded with heavy darts for use in defensive strategies

D_T4_UtilityClothing_CHOAM_Stillsuit_Sch.desc: Originally developed by the Fremen, the stillsuit is a full-body garment designed to capture and recycle bodily fluids that would otherwise be lost, filling built-in catch pockets for the user to drink and rehydrate. CHOAM now mass produces a high-quality version with few if any improvements on the original design

D_T4_Vehicle(Air)_Ornithopter_Set.desc: Take to the sky and peer down on those scrambling across the burning sands, you used to be one of them but no longer

D_T4_Vehicle(Air)_OrnithopterInventory_S.desc: XX_Early designs of the ornithopter made no allowance for cargo at all, making them useful only for short-haul personnel transport. This addition will earn its cost in no time

D_T4_Vehicle(Air)_SandcrawlerPowerSupply.desc: XX_A beast of a power supply and somewhat tricky to install, the sandcrawler PSU delivers an impressive load for its size

D_T4_Vehicle(Ground)_Crawler_Set_Schemat.desc: If you're not ready for an industrial harvester you can do far worse than one of these. In addition to taking the toil out of hand compacting, it can be fitted for cargo or personnel transport

D_T4_WeaponMod_AtreLMGBarrelExplosive1_S.desc: Causes darts fired by the Atreides LMG to explode on impact

D_T4_WeaponMod_AtreLMGQuickScope1_Schema.desc: Attachment that increases the target acquisition speed for the Atreides LMG

D_T4_WeaponMod_AtreSMGBarrelFire2_Schema.desc: The exact makeup of the incendiary sustance used is a long-held secret guarded by Savoy & Mirt. Because it breaks down as it kills, post-mortem analysis is impossible

D_T4_WeaponMod_AtreSMGMagQuickLoader2_Sc.desc: Although the quick loader for the M11 Submachine Gun had been available for some time, due to a field modification developed by Garon Smyth, the bespoke unit has the advantage of not blowing up at the wrong time

D_T4_WeaponMod_HarkARBarrelFire2_Schemat.desc: Owing to a quirk of design the Karpov-38 Battle Rifle has been known to smoke from its barrel after prolonged full-auto use

D_T4_WeaponMod_SmugShotMagCharger2_Schem.desc: The firing charger for the Elephant Gun was made famous through its depiction in the epic, The Enemy, starring actress Moya Sleeter

D_T4_WeaponMod_SmugShotMagQuickLoader2_S.desc: The quick loader for the Elephant Gun was made famous through its depiction in the epic, The Enemy, starring actress Moya Sleeter

D_T5_Armor_AtreidesScout_Schematic.desc: Green, black, and red have been the colors of House Atreides going all the way back to the days of Atreus. In addition to its proud history, Atreides armor is reputed to be among the most efficient in the Imperium

D_T5_Clothing_AtreidesDressUniform_Schem.desc: Few uniforms command the respect for a proud and honorable tradition as the Atreides dress uniform. Bearing the mark of the red hawk, this Great House uniform testifies to the nobility of its heritage

D_T5_MeleeWeapon_Kindjal3_Schematic.desc: With enough thrusting power the hardened carbon blade of this kindjal can penetrate steel armor

D_T5_MiscEquipment_HoltzmanShield4_Schem.desc: The beauty of the open desert has enchanted for millennia but it offers little in the way of cover should one require it. Equiped with a power pack the Holtzman provides just that

D_T5_MiscEquipment_HighCapacityLiterjon_.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> lightweight water container created by the Fremen for those going on a journey of seeking. Often carried by wali on their trial of aql, the contents were donated from the entire sietch as a sacrifice for good luck. Stores more water than ordinary literjons, and takes up less space.

D_T5_MiscEquipment_PowerPack3_Schematic.desc: The first generation of power packs were quite unstable and had a unfortunate habit of blowing its user to smithereens. The design has since been improved to ensure this happens quite rarely now

D_T5_Placeable_LongDurationThumper_Schem.desc: Activating this device in the desert will cause vibrations that summon sandworms

D_T5_Placeable_LongRangeSesmicProbe_Sche.desc: Will notify through the communinet when a sandworm enters or exits its search range

D_T5_RangedWeapon_HeavyPistol2_Schematic.desc: There is a Rafiq Snubnose Pistol in the cabinet by the bed of Count Daran of Ishkal. His wife is unaware and would disapprove

D_T5_RangedWeapon_MaulaPistol3_Schematic.desc: Redesigned from the ground up, the MK ll is a must-have for successful underworld kingpins. Or so they are reputed to be. They've not been convicted of anything

D_T5_RangedWeapon_Scattergun2_Schematic.desc: Released with little fanfare, this update is well worth the extra cost and due to its under-the-radar status it's always in stock

D_T5_RangedWeapon_SmugglerRifle2_Schemat.desc: It's almost impossible to speak of hunting schlag on Tupali without mentioning the JABAL Spitdart. Its use is synonymous with the sport

D_T5_SocialClothing_AtreidesDressUniform.desc: Few uniforms command the respect for a proud and honorable tradition as the Atreides dress uniform. Bearing the mark of the red hawk, this Great House uniform testifies to the nobility of its heritage

D_T5_Structure_MediumOreRefinery_Schemat.desc: Place raw ore in this device to produce refined components for crafting

D_T5_Tool_HeavyStaticCompactor_Schematic.desc: Once called the Particle Agglomerator, this device was renamed and remarketed under its new name at twice the price and far outsold the original

D_T5_UtilityClothing_CHOAM_Stillsuit_Sch.desc: Originally developed by the Fremen, the stillsuit is a full-body garment designed to capture and recycle bodily fluids that would otherwise be lost, filling built-in catch pockets for the user to drink and rehydrate. CHOAM now mass produces a high-quality version with few if any improvements on the original design

D_T5_Vehicle(Air)_OrnithopterLasgun_Sche.desc: Don't be caught wishing you had lasgun mounted on your ornithopter. The time to have one is before you need it

D_T5_Vehicle(Air)_OrnithopterRocketLaunc.desc: Rarely has anyone referred to the friendly skies of Arrakis, and for good reason. Make sure your 'thopter has everything it needs to take care of any eventuality

D_T5_Vehicle(Air)_TankEngine_Schematic.desc: There is not much of a second-hand market for tank engines and working units are rare in the extreme. Workhorses, when they give up the ghost, there is little that can be done other than melting them down for other purposes

D_T5_Vehicle(Air)_TransportOrnithopterEn.desc: XX_Delivering nearly three times the horsepower of the scout ornithopter this engine has been known to overheat in the midday sun. Be sure to keep its fluids topped up

D_T5_Vehicle(Air)_TransportOrnithopterPo.desc: XX_the Carrier Ornithopter is a beast and it guzzles energy like one too. Luckily this PSU delivers the power you need

D_T5_Vehicle(Air)_TransportOrnithopterSi.desc: XX_A lack of competition in the aeronautics industry has led to price gouging on the part of manufacturers

D_T5_Vehicle(Air)_TransportOrnithopterTa.desc: XX_Supplied by the same company that also makes children's toys, many have wondered if there is a philosophical connection between these two industries

D_T5_Vehicle(Ground)_SandcrawlerHarvesti.desc: XX_Early designs for the main assembly caused the sandcrawler to overheat even on short hauls. CHOAM never recalled these hunks and care must be taken to purchase the newer models when sourcing from the second-hand market

D_T5_Vehicle(Ground)_TankShieldModule_Sc.desc: Protect your investment and yourself with this additional layer of security that adds a relatively small amount of extra weight

D_T5_WeaponMod_AtreLMGMagCharger1_Schema.desc: Attachment that increases the fire rate & power for the Atreides LMG, but adds a spinup effect

D_T5_WeaponMod_AtreLMGMagQuickLoader1_Sc.desc: Attachment that increases reload speed for the Atreides LMG

D_T5_WeaponMod_AutoMode_Schematic.desc: Some might question the utility of a full-auto attachment for the Maula Pistol but they've never been to Arrakis

D_T5_WeaponMod_BurstMode_Schematic.desc: The burst-fire module for the JABAL Spitdart was made famous through its depiction in the epic, The Enemy, starring actress Moya Sleeter

D_T5_WeaponMod_ChoamMaulaMagQuickloader1.desc: Some might question the utility of a quick loader for the Maula Pistol but they've never been to Arrakis

D_T5_WeaponMod_HarkARMagQuickLoader2_Sch.desc: Getting one shot off in the direction of your enemy is all well and good, but having the next clip locked in quickly can give you the speed advantage that can make the difference between life and death

D_T5_WeaponMod_HarkHeavyPistolMagQuickLo.desc: Given a Rafiq Snubnose Pistol with Quick Loader attachment for his eighth birthday, the son of Earl Montoya tried it out on the range and immediately broke his wrist

D_T5_WeaponMod_ScattergunMagQuickLoader1.desc: The quick loader-equipped GRDA 44 Scattergun is banned from practice ranges on nearly a thousand planets

D_T5_WeaponMod_SmugDMRMagQuickLoader2_Sc.desc: The quick loader for the JABAL Spitdart was made famous through its depiction in the epic, The Enemy, starring actress Moya Sleeter

T6_ChoamLg2_Schematic.desc:
Though the Imperium has forbidden the import of lasguns without a safety mechanism, there are other alternatives for bringing a lasgun to Arrakis. The smugglers have access to an entire offworld arsenal of lasguns that do not include the safety mechanisms put in place by the Landsraad council.
Unfortunately, this <Unique>Unique</> lasgun is not one of them. It's just a regular lasgun with the serial numbers filed off.

T6_UniqueFlamethrower_Prototype_2_Schema.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> item. Little known fact: Jared Garoti was a notorious pyromaniac in his early years and nearly burnt his ancestral home to the ground building one of his creations.

D_TableSchematic.desc: From the nobility to the common pyon, all gather at the table to share in both life's struggles and its bounty

D_TankChassisSchematic.desc: Employing solid plasteel rigging, while the tank frame is more resilient than any other vehicle on the market, what it gains in strength it also gains in weight. Expect only the most powerful air vehicles to attempt lifting it

D_TankPowerUnitSchematic.desc: Guzzling energy for its operation, the PSU for the tank is a monster and recharging it does take time

D_TankSetSchematic.desc: Whether you're on the offensive or just want to hold onto what you have, an armored combat tank poses a significant deterrent to anyone considering entering into a disagreement

D_TankTreadsSchematic.desc: Although not too dissimilar to the track-wheel assembly of the sandcrawler, where the former uses rubber, the tank opts for steel which is long wearing and resistant to small weapons fire

D_TEMP_BloodLoop_SchematicSet.desc: XX_Teaches exsanguinator tool, literjon, and purifier for testing blood loop

D_TEST_Phase3_CraftItem_Schematic.desc: Item to craft for Phase 3 of March playtest

D_VehiclesFabricator_Schematic.desc: Buying new is never as satisfying as making them yourself. Use this workstation to craft vehicle parts

D_WeaponMod_BattleRifle_PoisonBarrel_Sch.desc: Owing to a quirk of design the Karpov-38 Battle Rifle has been known to drip poison from its barrel after prolonged full-auto use

D_WeaponMod_BattleRifle_SemiAuto_Schemat.desc: Getting one shot off in the direction of your enemy is all well and good, but having the next round automatically available straight away can give you the speed advantage that can make the difference between life and death

D_WeaponMod_HeavyPistol_BurstMode_Schema.desc: Given a Rafiq Snubnose Pistol with Burst attachment for his eighth birthday, the son of Earl Montoya tried it out on the range and immediately broke his wrist

D_WeaponMod_HeavyPistol_Sights_Schematic.desc: Under-rated and under used this sight can add much accuracy to this powerful handgun

D_WeaponMod_Rifle_Sights_Schematic.desc: There is a JABAL Spitdart sight in the planetary museum on Chusuk that mysteriously survived and now stands as a reminder of the destruction of Zanovar

D_WeaponMod_ScatterGun_FullAuto_Schemati.desc: The fully automatic GRDA 44 Scattergun is banned from practice ranges on nearly a thousand planets

D_WeaponMod_ScatterGun_Sights_Schematic.desc: This combat sight is an exact copy of a model produced on Andioya. CHOAM is entirely unapologetic over this shameless infringement of copyright

D_WeaponMod_SMG_BurstMode_Schematic.desc: Although burst fire for the M11 Submachine Gun had been available for some time, due to a field modification developed by Garon Smyth, the bespoke unit has the advantage of not blowing up at the wrong time

D_WeaponMod_SMG_PoisonBarrel_Schematic.desc: The exact makeup of the poison used is a long-held secret guarded by Savoy & Mirt. Because the poison breaks down as it kills, post-mortem analysis is impossible

D_WeaponsFabricator_Schematic.desc: From makeshift knives to battle rifles, use this workstation to craft weapons

D_WearablesFabricator_Schematic.desc: Make sure you've got all your kit from top to toe. Use this workstation to craft garments

D_WeldingMaterialSchematic.desc: Welding is a common practice when bonding sections of metal permanently. Welding wire is melted at high temperature and bonds with the two surfaces creating a seamless connection

HoltzmanShieldActiveDrain_Unique_01_Sche.desc:
A <Unique>Unique</> personal shielding device that can be manually toggled on and off to deflect incoming darts and blades at the cost of power from a Power Pack. However, the slow blade penetrates the shield and melee combatants will take advantage of this.

The shield also prevents objects from exiting, thus it will automatically deactivate when firing darts or throwing objects. It will then automatically reactivate according to its refresh time. While active, the shield generates sounds and vibrations that drive sandworms mad. Usage on open sands is not recommended.

SandbikeEngine_Unique_Speed_1_Schematic.desc: The Mohandis family claim their ancestry as merchant-engineers and even claim that this model of engine was crafted by an ancestor known only as Slide Rule. A <Unique>Unique</> modification allows it be fitted into sandbikes - giving increased speed at the cost of additional heat.

PowerPack_Unique_Regen_01_Schematic.desc: Sim found that if he crossed the wires in his power pack just so, he could create a <Unique>Unique</> power pack that recharged quickly - but with a slightly reduced power pool. Sim's power pack became known as 'old sparky' for its constant discharge of electrical sparks - but his technique was copied widely by those who value speed over duration.

Stillsuit_Unique_Armored_01_Mask_Schemat.desc: The Hollower Clan is an inbred family of scavengers who inhabit the Hollow Arches of Southern Hagga Basin. This <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit was their invention - though rumor persists that it was a gift from Fremen that they hid during the Sardaukar pogrom.

Stillsuit_Unique_Armored_01_Boots_Schema.desc: The Hollower Clan is an inbred family of scavengers who inhabit the Hollow Arches of Southern Hagga Basin. This <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit was their invention - though rumor persists that it was a gift from Fremen that they hid during the Sardaukar pogrom.

Stillsuit_Unique_Armored_01_Gloves_Schem.desc: The Hollower Clan is an inbred family of scavengers who inhabit the Hollow Arches of Southern Hagga Basin. This <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit was their invention - though rumor persists that it was a gift from Fremen that they hid during the Sardaukar pogrom.

Stillsuit_Unique_Armored_01_Top_Schemati.desc: The Hollower Clan is an inbred family of scavengers who inhabit the Hollow Arches of Southern Hagga Basin. This <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit was their invention - though rumor persists that it was a gift from Fremen that they hid during the Sardaukar pogrom.

Kindjal_Unique_Blood_01_Schematic.desc: Cornered in a cave by Sardaukar forces, Kaleff managed to stay alive for weeks without a water source, only emerging to draw blood from his enemies. When he was finally killed, the Sardaukar discovered this <Unique>Unique</> kindjal modified to include an exsanguination apparatus.

UniqueAr_Burst_01_Schematic.desc: When Aren was ousted by the Kirab, he brought some of their technology with him into the Southern basin. This <Unique>Unique</> battle rifle is based on a similar Kirab model, with the final dart of its three-round burst dealing additional damage. Aren's intention was to eventually lead an army of scavengers north to take vengeance on his old comrades.

SandbikeEngine_Unique_Speed_2_Schematic.desc: The Mohandis family claim their ancestry as merchant-engineers and even claim that this model of engine was crafted by an ancestor known only as Slide Rule. A <Unique>Unique</> modification allows it be fitted into sandbikes - giving increased speed at the cost of additional heat.

SandbikeScanner_Unique_LongRange_02_Sche.desc: While CHOAM scanners are the standard on all worlds, their efficiency on Arrkais is inhibited by the static from the sandstorms and the nearby magnetic interference of the moons. The Miner's Guild have modified this <Unique>Unique</> scanner, giving it greater durability and range - more suited for the harsh conditions of Arrakis.

HighCapacityLiterjon_02_Schematic.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> lightweight water container created by the Fremen for those going on a journey of seeking. Often carried by wali on their trial of aql, the contents were donated from the entire sietch as a sacrifice for good luck. Stores more water than ordinary literjons, and takes up less space.

GlidePartialStabilizationBelt_02_Schemat.desc: <Unique>Unique</> Active Directional Suspensor for explorers. Activate to hover at the apex of a jump arc and drift in movement direction. Depletes power as long as it is kept activated.

PowerPack_Unique_Regen_02_Schematic.desc: Sim found that if he crossed the wires in his power pack just so, he could create a <Unique>Unique</> power pack that recharged quickly - but with a slightly reduced power pool. Sim's power pack became known as 'old sparky' for its constant discharge of electrical sparks - but his technique was copied widely by those who value speed over duration.

Bloodsack_Unique_Durable_02_Schematic.desc: Scipio was a Kirab Warlord who took over the Wreck of the Pallas when it fell during the War of Assassins. Over time, Scipio became known for his brutal torture of those who trespassed on his territory. He would extract most of the blood from their bodies, then abandon them near the leaking radiation core by the engines of the Pallas. This <Unique>Unique</>blood bag is able to tolerate large amounts of reuse - a reminder of its twisted legacy.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique02_Hel.desc: The story of the warlord Mendia is well known among the Kirab. How she escaped slavery in the north, abandoning her former life. How she gained a reputation for brutality by executing any slavers they captured. How she defeated their former leader, Aren, in a duel and drove him into hiding in the Southern Hagga Basin. This <Unique>Unique</> armor is modelled after her own - reinforced to keep her enemies at bay.

How she gained a reputation for brutality by executing any slavers they captured. How she defeated their former leader, Aren, in a duel and drove him into hiding in the Southern Hagga Basin. This <Unique>Unique</> armor is modelled after her own - reinforced to keep her enemies at bay.

This <Unique>Unique</> armor is modelled after her own - reinforced to keep her enemies at bay.

Stillsuit_Unique_Armored_02_Mask_Schemat.desc: Menol was well loved among the Kirab, known far and wide for his spice beer brewing operations. He accidentally discovered that soaking his stillsuit leathers led to a stiffer, more protective <Unique>Unique</> garment. Like his spice beer, he shared this knowledge freely, didn't help him much when he was  stabbed to death by a drunk Kirab who hallucinated he was a sandworm.

Stillsuit_Unique_Armored_02_Boots_Schema.desc: Menol was well loved among the Kirab, known far and wide for his spice beer brewing operations. He accidentally discovered that soaking his stillsuit leathers led to a stiffer, more protective <Unique>Unique</> garment. Like his spice beer, he shared this knowledge freely, didn't help him much when he was  stabbed to death by a drunk Kirab who hallucinated he was a sandworm.

Stillsuit_Unique_Armored_02_Top_Schemati.desc: Menol was well loved among the Kirab, known far and wide for his spice beer brewing operations. Like his spice beer, he shared this knowledge freely, didn't help him much when he was  stabbed to death by a drunk Kirab who hallucinated he was a sandworm.

Combat_Heavy_Unique_PowerEfficient_Glove.desc: Iri was a leader among the Kirab who became obsessed with finding a way to nullify the Holtzman effect. His tinkering led to the development of these <Unique>Unique</>  gauntlets that use a feedback loop to decrease power usage. Iri himself claimed that the gauntlets "spoke" to him and his state of mind deteriorated greatly until he threw himself from a cliff.

Combat_Light_Unique_WormThreat_Boots_02_.desc: Found abandoned throughout the former territories of the Fremen, these <Unique>Unique</> boots are made of a strange type of soft leather. Each step in these boots seems to melt into the sand, reducing the vibrations that attract the worm.

UniqueSda2_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> Maula pistol has a modified spring mechanism that automatically reloads darts without releasing trigger pressure. Rumor has it that Count Hasimir Fenring designed this modification himself, admiring the design of the maula pistol while decrying the inefficiency of its firing mechanism.

SMG_Unique_LargeMag_02_Schematic.desc: Smiley Tyg sometimes has special goods that he sells with no questions asked or answered. A few seasons ago, schematics for a <Unique>Unique</> high-capacity disruptor - a weapon focused on attacking shields - began to appear in his stock at the Anvil Tradepost. Rumors that they were plundered from a Sardaukar convoy ambushed by Zantara the Lion earned them their moniker as the Legion Tattoo - bolstered by the rhythm they make as they fire.

Kindjal_Unique_Blood_02_Schematic.desc: Scipio the warlord liked to draw blood from his enemies during torture. He created this <Unique>Unique</> kindjal based on one he had stolen in the Southern Hagga Basin. Made of more advanced materials, this kindjal works on the same principle — small grooves feed blood into the hilt which can be emptied into a waiting container.

UniqueAr_Burst_02_Schematic.desc: Nobody truly knows who Fila is or was, but it is rumored that she, for a while, was mistress to Aren, a Kirab Warlord. That may explain why this <Unique>Unique</> rifle is similar to one wielded by Aren during his final days, with the final dart of its three-round burst dealing additional damage. But did he create the rifle, or was it the work of the mysterious Fila?

SandbikeChoamBoostHeatEfficient2_Schemat.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> booster comes with an extra large air intake for better performance during the cool evening on Arrakis, though it helps very little during the superheated air of the day. Standard gear amongst the Dunemen who prefer to work by night.

SandbikeEngine_Unique_Speed_3_Schematic.desc: The Mohandis family claim their ancestry as merchant-engineers and even claim that this model of engine was crafted by an ancestor known only as Slide Rule. A <Unique>Unique</> modification allows it be fitted into sandbikes - giving increased speed at the cost of additional heat.

BuggyEngine_Unique_Accelerate_03_Schemat.desc: Tio Holtzman was patron to the nobleman Niko Bludd, who provided funding for his research. One day this would lead to the development of the Holtzman effect, but earlier experiments such as this <Unique>Unique</> engine are another result of that collaboration. The name has been corrupted over the centuries since.

BuggyMining_Unique_YieldIncrease_03_Sche.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> buggy mining laser boasts increased mining yield, albeit at the cost of heat generation.

BuggyInventory_Unique_Capacity_03_Schema.desc: Sometimes the engineers who design an interesting concept are also the ones who name it. This <Unique>Unique</> storage extension for the four man groundcar or 'buggy' allows the transport of more inventory. Just try not to snigger at the name.

HighCapacityLiterjon_03_Schematic.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> lightweight water container created by the Fremen for those going on a journey of seeking. Often carried by wali on their trial of aql, the contents were donated from the entire sietch as a sacrifice for good luck. Stores more water than ordinary literjons, and takes up less space.

DewReaper_Unique_02_Schematic.desc: Crafted to the same general standards of other Dew Reapers, this particular design was modified by Thufir Hawat to ease the lives of the Atreides pyons. This <Unique>Unique</> Dew Reaper siphons a portion of the Holtzman field that powers the collection of dew to lighten the Dew Reaper itself, allowing an easier swing, lighter load and more efficiency in the long run.

GlidePartialStabilizationBelt_03_Schemat.desc: <Unique>Unique</> Active Directional Suspensor for explorers. Activate to hover at the apex of a jump arc and drift in movement direction. Depletes power as long as it is kept activated.

StaticCompactor_Unique_Compact_03_Schema.desc: The makers of this <Unique>Unique</> static compactor prioritized reducing size, power draw, and most importantly worm attention.

BodyFluidExtractor_Unique_Water_03_Schem.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> fluid extractor has been modified with a small filter that, upon use, can separate some pure water out of blood and divert it to the appropriate containers. Developed by slavers who did not wish to risk disease but considered their cargo a portable source of water.

PowerPack_Unique_Regen_03_Schematic.desc: Sim found that if he crossed the wires in his power pack just so, he could create a <Unique>Unique</> power pack that recharged quickly - but with a slightly reduced power pool. Sim's power pack became known as 'old sparky' for its constant discharge of electrical sparks - but his technique was copied widely by those who value speed over duration.

Bloodsack_Unique_Durable_03_Schematic.desc: A whisper and a rumor, even among the slaver's themselves is the Slavelord known as the Glutton. His origins are clouded in mystery, but he has carved himself a space within the cutthroat world of the slavers - literally. His wake is littered with corpses and it is rumored that the Glutton is a cannibal. This <Unique>Unique</> bloodbag was apparently designed by him, but to what end, even the Slavers don't seem to know.

Scanner_Unique_Body_03_Schematic.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> scanner that specializes in only detecting the living.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique03_Hel.desc: Inkvine was a creeping plant native to Giedi Prime, used as a material by slavers for generations. Inkvine whips were the most common - particularly for the slow burning beet colored scars that they left on their victims. This <Unique>Unique</> light armor is dyed to look almost like inkvine, despite being made from lesser materials.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique03_Top.desc: Inkvine was a creeping plant native to Giedi Prime, used as a material by slavers for generations. Inkvine whips were the most common - particularly for the slow burning beet colored scars that they left on their victims. This <Unique>Unique</> light armor is dyed to look almost like inkvine, despite being made from lesser materials.

This <Unique>Unique</> light armor is dyed to look almost like inkvine, despite being made from lesser materials.

Inkvine whips were the most common - particularly for the slow burning beet colored scars that they left on their victims. This <Unique>Unique</> light armor is dyed to look almost like inkvine, despite being made from lesser materials.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique03_Boo.desc: Inkvine was a creeping plant native to Giedi Prime, used as a material by slavers for generations. Inkvine whips were the most common - particularly for the slow burning beet colored scars that they left on their victims. This <Unique>Unique</> light armor is dyed to look almost like inkvine, despite being made from lesser materials.

Combat_Neut_AtreidesDeserterUnique02_Hel.desc: Zaal Karak is a ruthless slavelord who runs his operation with an iron fist. This intimidating <Unique>Unique</> heavy armor was commissioned as a present for him from the na-baron of the Harkonnen, Feyd-Rautha. It is Zaal Karak and his men who supply the bulk of slaves for the building of Neo-Carthag.

Stillsuit_Unique_Armored_03_Mask_Schemat.desc: Kel is the most paranoid of the slavelords who came to Arrakis to help with the building of Neo-Carthag. He was a nervous businessman, even before he splintered with the rest of the slavers and moved his operations across the rift. Now he sleeps in this <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit he designed. He does not sleep well at night.

Stillsuit_Unique_Armored_03_Top_Schemati.desc: Kel is the most paranoid of the slavelords who came to Arrakis to help with the building of Neo-Carthag. He was a nervous businessman, even before he splintered with the rest of the slavers and moved his operations across the rift. Now he sleeps in this <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit he designed. He does not sleep well at night.

Combat_Heavy_Unique_PowerEfficient_Glove.desc: These <Unique>Unique</> gauntlets used to be attached to uncooperative slaves - shocking their palms as a punishment. One supervisor noticed that slaves equipped with the gauntlets needed to recharge their tools and power packs less frequently. The gauntlets were quickly modified to a low level current and given to all workers. Even slavers value efficiency.

Combat_Light_Unique_WormThreat_Boots_03_.desc: Found abandoned throughout the former territories of the Fremen, these <Unique>Unique</> boots are made of a strange type of soft leather. Each step in these boots seems to melt into the sand, reducing the vibrations that attract the worm. This particular set is based on a design found in the long-abandoned Sietch Ta'lab.

Combat_Light_Unique_DewReap_Gloves_03_Sc.desc: Treated with a small amount of huf-huf oil, these <Unique>Unique</> gloves repel water and prevent any additional dew from escaping while harvesting.

Combat_Light_Unique_ReduceSuspensor_Top_.desc: Used primarily by those who are called to spend long hours doing heavy activity while using suspensor belts, this <Unique>Unique</>  jacket features a series of specially designed capacitors to optimize the flow of energy through power pack and suspensor belt.

UniqueSda3_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> Maula pistol has a modified spring mechanism that automatically reloads darts without releasing trigger pressure. Integrating the modifications from Count Hasimir Fenring, this newer design also accommodates better materials for longer durability.

UniqueSword_02_Schematic.desc: During the Butlerian Jihad, pulse-swords were used to cut through the thinking machines and damage their electronics with pulses of deadly electricity. It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries. This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when parrying an enemy — offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary swords of the Butlerian Jihad.

UniqueScattergun2_Schematic.desc: Thin spikes in the barrel mean that the darts fired from this <Unique>Unique</> scattergun will break into multiple shrapnel pieces on impact, causing a bleeding effect on enemies. The slavers claim that they are the ones who designed this weapon - it is commonly used among them for crowd control.

SMG_Unique_LargeMag_03_Schematic.desc: Seb was a veteran of the Kytheria, that came down in the Hagga Rift. With a few survivors, Seb was able to escape the rift and overtake a small slaver cave near the edge of the rift. This <Unique>Unique</> high-capacity disruptor was a part of his success — though it is said that he later traded the secret of manufacturing them to Smiley Tyg at the Anvil Tradepost.

Kindjal_Unique_Blood_03_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> kindjal slurps up blood as it cuts - thoroughly suitable for the mysterious entity known only as the Glutton. Though few have claimed to see him in person, the wounds left by this knife are unmistakable.

LongRifle_Unique_Poison_03_Schematic.desc: Many in the Imperium have heard of chaumurky, poison administered through the drink, and chaumas, poison delivered through the food. This <Unique>Unique</> rifle toys with a third concept - poison delivered in a small explosive dart that explodes on contact with a shield, allowing it to waft through.

HeavyPistol_Unique_Bleed_03_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> heavy pistol borrows technology from the fast-firing disruptor submachine gun, while adding a charging mechanism to fire shield-destabilizing darts.

UniqueAr_Burst_03_Schematic.desc: Zaal Karak captured this rifle on a raid into the Vermillius Gap for fresh slaves. He admired the workmanship, particularly that the final dart of its three-round burst is more potent, but chose to reinforce it with more robust materials. Other slavers copied him and now this once-<Unique>Unique</> rifle is popular amongst the slavers of the basin.

Kindjal_Unique_Stamina_03_Schematic.desc:
During the Butlerian Jihad, pulse-blades were used to cut through the thinking machines and damage their electronics with pulses of deadly electricity. It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries.

This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when hitting an enemy — offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary weapons of the Butlerian Jihad.

Combat_Light_Unique_BiomeHeat_Top_03_Sch.desc: When they were establishing their presence in the Hagga Basin, the Slavers noticed that their slaves were often dying of heatstroke. They could not have their stock dying, so they developed this <Unique>Unique</> jacket to protect their slaves from the worst of the elements. Sometimes even the worst of people have good ideas. Just don't look too closely at the leather.

SandbikeChoamBoostHeatEfficient3_Schemat.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> booster comes with an extra large air intake for better performance during the cool evening on Arrakis, though it helps very little during the superheated air of the day. Standard gear amongst the Dunemen who prefer to work by night.

BuggyChoamBoostHeatEfficient2_Schematic.desc: Named for the cool-blooded snakes of old earth and the inevitable shaking and rattling that comes when it is engaged, this <Unique>Unique</> boost module generates less heat, but like the snake it is named for, is a little more sluggish when cool.

SandbikeEngine_Unique_Speed_4_Schematic.desc: The Mohandis family claim their ancestry as merchant-engineers and even claim that this model of engine was crafted by an ancestor known only as Slide Rule. A <Unique>Unique</> modification allows it be fitted into sandbikes - giving increased speed at the cost of additional heat.

BuggyEngine_Unique_Accelerate_04_Schemat.desc: Tio Holtzman was patron to the nobleman Niko Bludd, who provided funding for his research. One day this would lead to the development of the Holtzman effect, but earlier experiments such as this <Unique>Unique</> engine are another result of that collaboration. The name has been corrupted over the centuries since.

BuggyMining_Unique_YieldIncrease_04_Sche.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> buggy mining laser boasts increased mining yield, albeit at the cost of heat generation.

OrnithopterLightEngine_Unique_Speed_04_S.desc: While the Mohandis engine is considered premium for light vehicles, the Dyvetz atmospheric engine is optimized for environments with a gravitational field close to that of Old Terra. This <Unique>Unique</> engine is the product of years of research on a distant system.

BuggyInventory_Unique_Capacity_04_Schema.desc: Sometimes the engineers who design an interesting concept are also the ones who name it. This <Unique>Unique</> storage extension for the four man groundcar or 'buggy' allows the transport of more inventory. Just try not to snigger at the name.

HighCapacityLiterjon_04_Schematic.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> lightweight water container created by the Fremen for those going on a journey of seeking. Often carried by wali on their trial of aql, the contents were donated from the entire sietch as a sacrifice for good luck. Stores more water than ordinary literjons, and takes up less space.

DewReaper_Unique_03_Schematic.desc: Crafted to the same general standards of other Dew Reapers, this particular design was modified by Thufir Hawat to ease the lives of the Atreides pyons. This <Unique>Unique</> Dew Reaper siphons a portion of the Holtzman field that powers the collection of dew to lighten the Dew Reaper itself, allowing an easier swing, lighter load and more efficiency in the long run.

GlidePartialStabilizationBelt_04_Schemat.desc: <Unique>Unique</> Active Directional Suspensor for explorers. Activate to hover at the apex of a jump arc and drift in movement direction. Depletes power as long as it is kept activated.

StaticCompactor_Unique_Compact_04_Schema.desc: The makers of this <Unique>Unique</> static compactor prioritized reducing size, power draw, and most importantly worm attention.

BodyFluidExtractor_Unique_Water_04_Schem.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> fluid extractor has been modified with a small filter that, upon use, can separate some pure water out of blood and divert it to the appropriate containers. Developed by slavers who did not wish to risk disease but considered their cargo a portable source of water.

PowerPack_Unique_Regen_04_Schematic.desc: Sim found that if he crossed the wires in his power pack just so, he could create a <Unique>Unique</> power pack that recharged quickly - but with a slightly reduced power pool. Sim's power pack became known as 'old sparky' for its constant discharge of electrical sparks - but his technique was copied widely by those who value speed over duration.

DewReaper_1h_Unique_Compact_04_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> dew reaper can collapse down into an extremely small size, reducing the amount of space it occupies in inventories.

Bloodsack_Unique_Durable_04_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> bloodbag was symbolically named for the blood that the Sandflies shed when they rebelled against the Miner's Guild. Though the gesture is symbolic, the practicality of the blood bag is not.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique04_Hel.desc: Denira Quirth never intended to fight a war - she just wanted to survive it. When the Sandflies defected she swore not to shed the blood of her former colleagues - despite believing that the Sandflies cause was just. Her <Unique>Unique</> armor is built to withstand the ordeals of Arrakis - but not the darts of her enemies.

Combat_Neut_AtreidesDeserterUnique03_Hel.desc: Though the Sandflies have long since broken ties with the Miner's Guild, they still maintain the gear and traditions of their former life. This <Unique>Unique</> helmet is a modified duneman helmet - built for long hours in the mines.

Combat_Neut_AtreidesDeserterUnique03_Top.desc: Though the Sandflies have long since broken ties with the Miner's Guild, they still maintain the gear and traditions of their former life. This <Unique>Unique</> jacket is a modified duneman jacket - built for long hours in the mines.

Combat_Neut_AtreidesDeserterUnique03_Bot.desc: Though the Sandflies have long since broken ties with the Miner's Guild, they still maintain the gear and traditions of their former life. These <Unique>Unique</> pants are modified duneman pants - built for long hours in the mines.

Combat_Neut_AtreidesDeserterUnique03_Boo.desc: Though the Sandflies have long since broken ties with the Miner's Guild, they still maintain the gear and traditions of their former life. These <Unique>Unique</> boots are modified duneman boots - built for long hours in the mines.

Stillsuit_Unique_Armored_04_Mask_Schemat.desc: Shadrath was a Fremen warrior, who killed dozens of Sardaukar in razzia across the Shield Wall. When he was gravely wounded, he returned to a hidden cave and sealed himself in a deathstill, preserving his water for his tribe. This <Unique>Unique</> armored stillsuit is based on the design of the one found abandoned by the deathstill.

Stillsuit_Unique_Efficient_04_Boots_Sche.desc: Maraqeb, known colloquially as The Sentinel, is a rock formation that has weathered thousands of years of sandstorms. The Fremen believed it was a holy site, a place that rewards endurance. This <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit is based on the principles of Maraqeb - durability and efficiency.

Stillsuit_Unique_Efficient_04_Gloves_Sch.desc: Maraqeb, known colloquially as The Sentinel, is a rock formation that has weathered thousands of years of sandstorms. The Fremen believed it was a holy site, a place that rewards endurance. This <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit is based on the principles of Maraqeb - durability and efficiency.

Combat_Heavy_Unique_PowerEfficient_Glove.desc: These <Unique>Unique</> gauntlets were developed to help fatigued miners keep going when their tools were running low. Containing a series of capacitors within them, they help to even out the power flow and increase efficiency. The Sandflies have co-opted these gauntlets for use in their own operations.

Combat_Light_Unique_WormThreat_Boots_04_.desc: A small mechanism in the sole of these <Unique>Unique</> light armor boots emits an irregular vibration that reduces the amount of worm-attention generated by footsteps on the open sands.

Combat_Light_Unique_Stamina_Bottom_04_Sc.desc: These <Unique>Unique</> light leggings are equipped with a compression triggered mechanism which stimulates the leg muscles, reducing the stamina drain of dashing.

Stillsuit_Unique_HeatMitigation_04_Mask_.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> hood is designed to reduce the harm caused by direct sunlight. It has been soaked in the juice of the creosote bush - inhibiting sweating and reducing heat buildup.

Combat_Light_Unique_DewReap_Gloves_04_Sc.desc: Treated with a small amount of huf-huf oil, these <Unique>Unique</> gloves repel water and prevent any additional dew from escaping while harvesting.

Sandflies propaganda states that this weapon was used against them when they rebelled, though there are no records of the mining guild ever having access to such weapons.

UniqueDirk_02_Schematic.desc:
Denira Quirth ran a supply depot for the Sandflies for many years, ensuring the flow of spice and other goods to the smugglers, in return for the basic supplies they needed to survive.

This <Unique>Unique</> dirk was reportedly a gift from Esmar Tuek himself a product of black-market technology that only a smuggler could access.

UniqueAr2_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> battle rifle has been modified with a mechanism that adds a touch of explosive powder to every dart that passes down the barrel. The Sandflies use weapons like this to rapidly clear rubble filled tunnels beneath the Sentinel, hence the name.

SMG_Unique_LargeMag_04_Schematic.desc: The history of Ironwatch is tied to the fate of the great Ironworks of Vermillius Gap. When they were abandoned, so was Ironwatch. This <Unique>Unique</> disruptor is known as an Ironwatch Special because many of them were found stockpiled in the basement when the Sandflies reclaimed the base.

Kindjal_Unique_Blood_04_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> kindjal was used as an off-hand weapon by the Fremen warrior, Shadrath, in his campaign against the Sardaukar. Though a Fremen would never be far from their crysknife, a secondary blade can help to stay alive, particularly if it serves the function of capturing water during fights.

LongRifle_Unique_Poison_04_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> rifle was named for an assassin who was paid a huge sum by the Atreides to take down the Beast Rabban. Witnesses say that the shot was perfect — lodging a poison dart deep into Rabban's neck — and that he laughed and pulled it out while his bodyguard swarmed the assassin.

HeavyPistol_Unique_Bleed_04_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> heavy pistol borrows technology from the fast-firing disruptor submachine gun, while adding a charging mechanism to fire shield-destabilizing darts.

LMG_Unique_RapidFire_04_Schematic.desc: Developed in the warfare labs of House Thorvald, this <Unique>Unique</> Vulcan gun uses new materials science to strip weight and replace it with capacity. Though highly sought after, these guns are experimental and banned from CHOAM export. How this arrived on Arrakis, is a mystery.

Shotgun_Unique_Explosive_04_Schematic.desc: An increased capacity makes this <Unique>Unique</> Drillshot the anti-shield weapon of choice. An added charge mechanism was added to the base FK7, powering up devastating 2-round bursts of burrow darts.

UniqueSda_Doubleshot_04_Schematic.desc: Shadrath crafted this <Unique>Unique</> Maula pistol during his razzia against the Sardaukar bases around the Shield Wall. The double shot burst firing mechanism caused some inaccuracy in the shots, but it made up for it with the ability to puncture Sardaukar armor.

UniqueScattergun_Fire_04_Schematic.desc: The Sandflies created this <Unique>Unique</> scattergun by combining some of the principles of the cutteray with the necessities of modern warfare. The darts in this scattergun are superheated by a scalpel sized laser so that when they are fired they burst into flaming particles on impact.

UniqueAr_Burst_04_Schematic.desc:
A young Atreides engineer with a very bad stutter was routinely ridiculed by his fellows stationed at The Aegis. To reduce his stutter, he began using semuta to help calm his mind. He became an addict, hopelessly enthralled to his semuta supplier — a Harkonnen agent.

This specially modified <Unique>Unique</> rifle fires in a three-round burst, with the final dart in the burst dealing additional damage. It was the last thing many heard at The Aegis when the young man turned it upon his once-comrades and then himself.

Kindjal_Unique_Stamina_04_Schematic.desc:

This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when hitting an enemy — offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary weapons of the Butlerian Jihad.

Combat_Light_Unique_BiomeHeat_Top_04_Sch.desc: Once in a while, there is a glitch in the gigantic entity that is CHOAM and the supply chains get crossed and something is sent to the place it was never meant to be. These <Unique>Unique</> jackets, which arrived on Arrakis in very limited supply, are made of a much lighter material than the standard, which means they are cooler and more protective.

LightOrnithopterChoamBoostHeatEfficient2.desc: Though the sandstorms of Arrakis have been known to reach 700kms an hour and tear metal to shreds, still there are those who insist on trying to boost through them. This <Unique>Unique</> boost module has a larger air intake to avoid dust clogging — it keep the 'thopter cool but at a cost of overall boost speed.

OrnithopterMediumLauncher_Unique_LargeEx.desc: The rockets fired by this <Unique>Unique</> assault ornithopter rocket module have a higher payload, increasing the blast radius at the cost of fire rate.

OrnithopterLightScanner_Unique_LongRange.desc: Named for the bloodthirsty hawks of the Arrakeen desert, this <Unique>Unique</> scanner can detect ores, water and other resources from the safety of the air.

OrnithopterLightLauncher_Unique_RapidFir.desc: Sometimes it isn't enough to fire a steady stream of rockets at enemies. Sometimes what is required is an absolute barrage of rockets. This <Unique>Unique</> rocket module allows you to fire at a rapid rate. Keep an eye on your ammunition.

Often carried by wali on their trial of aql, the contents were donated from the entire sietch as a sacrifice for good luck. Stores more water than ordinary literjons, and takes up less space.

UniqueThumper_02_Schematic.desc: Modified to follow the Fremen design, this <Unique>Unique</> thumper generates a large amount of threat with the sandworm in a short amount of time. Just be sure to place it on open sand.

DewReaper_2h_Unique_YieldIncrease_05_Sch.desc: An alteration to the mechanisms in this <Unique>Unique</> dew scythe allows it to gather more moisture from plants at the cost of a reduced gathering area.

StaticCompactor_Unique_Compact_05_Schema.desc: The makers of this <Unique>Unique</> static compactor prioritized reducing size, power draw, and most importantly worm attention.

BodyFluidExtractor_Unique_Water_05_Schem.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> fluid extractor has been modified with a small filter that, upon use, can separate some pure water out of blood and divert it to the appropriate containers. Developed by slavers who did not wish to risk disease but considered their cargo a portable source of water.

BodyFluidExtractor_Unique_Poison_05_Sche.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> exsanguination tool liquefies internals of the target, allowing the wielder to extract even more fluids. In addition, any excess fluid is converted to a poison which is applied to the user's weaponry.

PowerPack_Unique_Regen_05_Schematic.desc: Sim found that if he crossed the wires in his power pack just so, he could create a <Unique>Unique</> power pack that recharged quickly — but with a slightly reduced power pool. Sim's power pack became known as 'old sparky' for its constant discharge of electrical sparks — but his technique was copied widely by those who value speed over duration.

DewReaper_1h_Unique_Compact_05_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> dew reaper can collapse down into an extremely small size, reducing the amount of space it occupies in inventories.

Bloodsack_Unique_Durable_05_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> bloodbag is used by the Mass Kharet to gather large quantities of water for sacrifice to Shai-Hulud. Though others view the cults habits as wasteful, their leader knows that sacrificing something as precious as water is a mark of power.

Stilltent_Unique_01_Schematic.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> creation. This stilltent utilizes extra seals in order to trap more moisture over time.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique05_Hel.desc: The Chosen are the elite warriors of the Maas Kharet cult, which makes its home at the old power station of Mysa Tarill. There are always four Chosen - Fire, Body, Tooth and Breath. Each is a symbolic part of the great sandworm, though this <Unique>Unique</> armor is probably just something looted from the station.

Combat_Neut_AtreidesDeserterUnique04_Hel.desc: In ancient mythology, Acheron was said to be the entrance to hell. This <Unique>Unique</> armor was retrieved from a shipwreck in the Sheol and became sought after due to its thick protective layer. Not that it helped those who died of radiation in the Sheol.

Combat_Heavy_Unique_Reinforced_Bottom_05.desc: General Mendek of the Harkonnen famously led a battlegroup during the Battle of Arrakeen that used old-world artillery to seal Atreides forces in shield wall caves. Mendek had this <Unique>Unique</> armor conditioned as a reminder of the battle, sometimes wearing it to remind himself of what it must have felt like to be trapped in those caves, with no way to escape.

Combat_Heavy_Unique_Reinforced_Gloves_05.desc: General Mendek of the Harkonnen famously led a battlegroup during the Battle of Arrakeen that used old-world artillery to seal Atreides forces in shield wall caves. Stillsuit_Unique_Armored_05_Mask_Schemat.desc: The Saturnine were a group of merc-assassins who came to Arrakis during the Fremen pogrom. The Saturnine pride themselves on hunting dangerous individuals and converting them into trophies. The Saturnine claim that this <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit bears the visage of Stilgar, a famous Fremen naib.

Stillsuit_Unique_Armored_05_Boots_Schema.desc: The Saturnine were a group of merc-assassins who came to Arrakis during the Fremen pogrom. The Saturnine pride themselves on hunting dangerous individuals and converting them into trophies. The Saturnine claim that this <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit bears the visage of Stilgar, a famous Fremen naib.

The Saturnine pride themselves on hunting dangerous individuals and converting them into trophies. The Saturnine claim that this <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit bears the visage of Stilgar, a famous Fremen naib.

Stillsuit_Unique_Efficient_05_Boots_Sche.desc: A stillsuit manufacturer from Carthag once visited Kynes the Planetologist to enlist his aid in designing a better stillsuit. This <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit was the result, and Kynes insisted that the manufacturer name it the Batigh, which the manufacturer proudly did.

Stillsuit_Unique_Efficient_05_Gloves_Sch.desc: A stillsuit manufacturer from Carthag once visited Kynes the Planetologist to enlist his aid in designing a better stillsuit. This <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit was the result, and Kynes insisted that the manufacturer name it the Batigh, which the manufacturer proudly did.

Stillsuit_Unique_Efficient_05_Mask_Schem.desc: A stillsuit manufacturer from Carthag once visited Kynes the Planetologist to enlist his aid in designing a better stillsuit. Stillsuit_Unique_Efficient_05_Top_Schema.desc: A stillsuit manufacturer from Carthag once visited Kynes the Planetologist to enlist his aid in designing a better stillsuit.
