Combat_Heavy_Unique_PowerEfficient_Glove.desc: These <Unique>Unique</> gauntlets were developed for use on the power station at Mysa Tarill. After the incident with the sandworm, the station was abandoned and boxes of these gauntlets were left lying around to be scavenged by those brave or foolish enough to approach the worm.

Combat_Light_Unique_Scanning_Helmet_05_S.desc: The electronics in this <Unique>Unique</> helmet connect to hand-held scanners, boosting their scanning range.

Combat_Light_Unique_WormThreat_Boots_05_.desc: These <Unique>Unique</> boots were taken from the rubble of Sietch Tarl after it was destroyed by the Sardaukar. Sietch Tarl was the place where Liet-Kynes made a final stand against the Sardaukar, collapsing the walls and killing dozens of them in a desperate final stand. Perhaps Liet-Kynes wore these same boots on that fateful day.

Combat_Light_Unique_Stamina_Bottom_05_Sc.desc: These <Unique>Unique</> light leggings are equipped with a compression triggered mechanism which stimulates the leg muscles, reducing the stamina drain of dashing.

Stillsuit_Unique_HeatMitigation_05_Mask_.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> hood is designed to reduce the harm caused by direct sunlight. It has been soaked in the juice of the creosote bush — inhibiting sweating and reducing heat buildup.

Combat_Light_Unique_DewReap_Gloves_05_Sc.desc: Treated with a small amount of huf-huf oil, these <Unique>Unique</> gloves repel water and prevent any additional dew from escaping while harvesting.

Combat_Light_Unique_ReduceSuspensor_Top_.desc: Used primarily by those who are called to spend long hours doing heavy activity while using suspensor belts, this <Unique>Unique</> jacket features a series of specially designed capacitors to optimize the flow of energy through power pack and suspensor belt.

UniqueSda5_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> Maula pistol has a modified spring mechanism that automatically reloads darts without releasing trigger pressure. Integrating the modifications from Count Hasimir Fenring, this newer design also accommodates better materials for longer durability.

UniqueSword_04_Schematic.desc:
During the Butlerian Jihad, pulse-swords were used to cut through the thinking machines and damage their electronics with pulses of deadly electricity. It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries.

This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when parrying an enemy — offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary swords of the Butlerian Jihad.

UniqueScattergun4_Schematic.desc: Thin spikes in the barrel mean that the darts fired from this <Unique>Unique</> scattergun will break into multiple shrapnel pieces on impact, causing a bleeding effect on enemies. Brought from offworld only by Syndicate mercenaries, these formidable scatterguns are rarely found on Arrakis.

UniqueDirk_03_Schematic.desc: Ironically, the Fremen themselves might be the origin of this knife. For moisture sealing caves, they used this <Unique>Unique</> knife to quickly seal the plastic hoods against the cave walls. And for removal, they simply reheated the dirk and sliced the melted plastic from the walls.

UniqueAr3_Schematic.desc: Another weapon liberated from the shipwrecks of the Sheol, this <Unique>Unique</> battle rifle has been modified with a mechanism that adds a touch of explosive powder to every dart that passes down the barrel. Perhaps used as protection against smuggler or pirate attacks in the interplanetary shipping lanes.

UniqueRapier_02_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> sword contains a series of toxin releasing nodules along the length of the blade. When struck with enough force, these nodules release a burst of poisonous gas — capable of passing through a shield. The Maas Kharet probably borrowed this design from the slavers — filling it with a poison of their own.

UniqueSmg2_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> disruptor has been modified to spray doubleshots of heavy darts at a slower rate. The twisted mentat advisor to Baron Harkonnen, Piter de Vries, created this modified disruptor to be used to suppress riots on Giedi Prime. In his words, 'peace through suppression'.

SMG_Unique_LargeMag_05_Schematic.desc: The Atreides base in the Hagga Basin overlooks the radiated shipwrecks of the Sheol. Sometimes, during the long watches of the night, when a soldier has time to contemplate their life on Arrakis, they take the long elevator down to the sands and disappear into the south. This <Unique>Unique</> disruptor is named as an insult to those who would desert their posts — and used against them if they are ever seen again.

Kindjal_Unique_Blood_05_Schematic.desc: Pardot Kynes first came into contact with the Fremen by killing three Harkonnen bravos who were attacking Fremen youth. Kynes lamented violence — not the act, but the loss of blood and thus, precious water, it incurred. He developed this <Unique>Unique</> kindjal simply because if he was forced to kill others, he didn't want it to be wasteful.

LongRifle_Unique_Poison_05_Schematic.desc: Piter de Vries and Thufir Hawat are both trained assassins as well as Mentats. In the few instances where their masters must meet under a sign of truce, both men are responsible for the security of their lords beneath the Guild Peace. The soldiers who oversee these meetings are equipped with this <Unique>Unique</> rifle and placed at strategic locations. They have steady hands and a calm demeanor — anything else could quickly lead to disaster.

HeavyPistol_Unique_Bleed_05_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> heavy pistol borrows technology from the fast-firing disruptor submachine gun, while adding a charging mechanism to fire shield-destabilizing darts.

LMG_Unique_RapidFire_05_Schematic.desc: A favored weapon of the Smuggler, Esmar Tuek, this <Unique>Unique</> Vulcan gun leaves a mess wherever it is fired. Tuek, it is said, is a man who likes to make sure that when he sends a message to his enemies, it is heard.

Shotgun_Unique_Explosive_05_Schematic.desc: An increased capacity makes this <Unique>Unique</> Drillshot the anti-shield weapon of choice. An added charge mechanism was added to the base FK7, powering up devastating 2-round bursts of burrow darts.

UniqueSda_Doubleshot_05_Schematic.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> maula pistol developed in the shadow of Taqwa's Watch in the O'odham. Though Fremen battles rarely rely solely upon the maula pistol, it is still prudent to carry one — especially one with the capacity to fire double-shots bursts.

UniqueScattergun_Fire_05_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> scattergun was first discovered aboard the wreck of the Euporia in the Sheol. The crew and weapons on board were Ixian, leading to speculation that the weapon was sidestepping the prohibitions of the Butlerian Jihad. However when the weapon was opened up, it was a disappointingly standard application of heat transference principles.

HeavyPistol_Unique_Headshot_05_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> pistol comes with increased accuracy and bonus damage for headshots, but with a low capacity clip.

LongRifle_Unique_LargeMag_05_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> non-scoped Spitdart Rifle was developed with increased magazine capacity and fires poison-coated darts in a horizontal tripleshot pattern.

UniqueAr_Burst_05_Schematic.desc:
General Mendek was a swordsman all his life, until he was stationed on Arrakis. When he saw the lack of shields among the Fremen, he commissioned a <Unique>Unique</> burst shot battle rifle which deals additional damage when firing the final dart in the burst.

'The first shot is for the Baron. The second is for my lady wife. And the last shot is for forcing me to be stationed on this godsforsaken dustbowl.'

Kindjal_Unique_Stamina_05_Schematic.desc:
During the Butlerian Jihad, pulse-blades were used to cut through the thinking machines and damage their electronics with pulses of deadly electricity. It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries.

This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when hitting an enemy - offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary weapons of the Butlerian Jihad.

Combat_Light_Unique_BiomeHeat_Top_05_Sch.desc: These <Unique>Unique</> jackets were designed for the workers and guard from the Mysa Tarill power station. They are a cut above the usual supplies given out to pyons — probably because the power station was manned by a crew of highly trained engineers. Like the station, these jackets have mostly been long since abandoned.

SandbikeChoamBoostHeatEfficient5_Schemat.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> booster comes with an extra large air intake for better performance during the cool evening on Arrakis, though it helps very little during the superheated air of the day. Standard gear amongst the Dunemen who prefer to work by night.

BuggyChoamBoostHeatEfficient4_Schematic.desc: Named for the cool-blooded snakes of old earth and the inevitable shaking and rattling that comes when it is engaged, this <Unique>Unique</> boost module generates less heat, but like the snake it is named for, is a little more sluggish when cool.

LightOrnithopterChoamBoostHeatEfficient3.desc: Though the sandstorms of Arrakis have been known to reach 700kms an hour and tear metal to shreds, still there are those who insist on trying to boost through them. This <Unique>Unique</> boost module has a larger air intake to avoid dust clogging - it keep the 'thopter cool but at a cost of overall boost speed.

SandbikeEngine_Unique_Speed_6_Schematic.desc: The Mohandis family claim their ancestry as merchant-engineers and even claim that this model of engine was crafted by an ancestor known only as Slide Rule. A <Unique>Unique</> modification allows it be fitted into sandbikes — giving increased speed at the cost of additional heat.

BuggyEngine_Unique_Accelerate_06_Schemat.desc: Tio Holtzman was patron to the nobleman Niko Bludd, who provided funding for his research. One day this would lead to the development of the Holtzman effect, but earlier experiments such as this <Unique>Unique</> engine are another result of that collaboration. The name has been corrupted over the centuries since.

BuggyMining_Unique_YieldIncrease_06_Sche.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> buggy mining laser boasts increased mining yield, albeit at the cost of heat generation.

OrnithopterLightEngine_Unique_Speed_06_S.desc: While the Mohandis engine is considered premium for light vehicles, the Dyvetz atmospheric engine is optimized for environments with a gravitational field close to that of Old Terra. This <Unique>Unique</> engine is the product of years of research on a distant system.

OrnithopterTransportEngine_Unique_Speed_.desc: Neither fuel efficiency, nor longevity, nor efficiency were a concern when this engine was crafted. The client requested a fast carrier engine, and the engineers of House Dyvetz were always going to deliver it. This <Unique>Unique</> engine is the product of years of research on a distant system.

SandcrawlerEngine_Unique_Speed_06_Schema.desc: When every second on the sands counts, this <Unique>Unique</> sandcrawler engine's increased speed will allow for quicker spice harvesting operations.

OrnithopterMediumLauncher_Unique_LargeEx.desc: The rockets fired by this <Unique>Unique</> assault ornithopter rocket module have a higher payload, increasing the blast radius at the cost of fire rate.

OrnithopterMediumEngine_Unique_Speed_06_.desc: While the Mohandis engine is considered premium for light vehicles, the Dyvetz atmospheric engine is optimized for environments with a gravitational field close to that of Old Terra. This <Unique>Unique</> engine is the product of years of research on a distant system.

TankEngine_Unique_Accelerate_06_Schemati.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> tank engine has been optimized to increase its acceleration rate.

BuggyInventory_Unique_Capacity_06_Schema.desc: Sometimes the engineers who design an interesting concept are also the ones who name it. This <Unique>Unique</> storage extension for the four man groundcar or 'buggy' allows the transport of more inventory. Just try not to snigger at the name.

TankDart_Unique_DmgIncrease_06_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> tank dart turret utilizes a high-pressure dart launcher, significantly increasing the damage dealt at the cost of fire rate.

OrnithopterLightLauncher_Unique_RapidFir.desc: Sometimes it isn't enough to fire a steady stream of rockets at enemies. Sometimes what is required is an absolute barrage of rockets. This <Unique>Unique</> rocket module allows you to fire at a rapid rate. Keep an eye on your ammunition.

SandcrawlerLocomotion_Unique_WormThreat_.desc: "Walk without rhythm and you won't attract the worm" is a difficult principle to apply to a vehicle that is designed to crawl around on sand sucking up spice. These <Unique>Unique</> treads apply acoustic principles to lower their overall vibration — but the sandworm will always come regardless.

OrnithopterTransportBoost_Unique_LessHea.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> boost provides a steady boost at a lower maximum speed, proving the adage "slow and steady wins the race". On Arrakis, natives tend to modify it slightly saying "only if you have enough fuel and the worm is very far away".

TankHull_Unique_ArmorIncrease_06_Schemat.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> tank body hull is reinforced with additional plating, increasing its overall combat durability.

HighCapacityLiterjon_06_Schematic.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> lightweight water container created by the Fremen for those going on a journey of seeking. Often carried by wali on their trial of aql, the contents were donated from the entire sietch as a sacrifice for good luck. Stores more water than ordinary literjons, and takes up less space.

DewReaper_Unique_05_Schematic.desc: Crafted to the same general standards of other Dew Reapers, this particular design was modified by Thufir Hawat to ease the lives of the Atreides pyons. This <Unique>Unique</> Dew Reaper siphons a portion of the Holtzman field that powers the collection of dew to lighten the Dew Reaper itself, allowing an easier swing, lighter load and more efficiency in the long run.

MiningTool_2h_Unique_04_Schematic.desc: Pardot Kynes was a driven man and single-minded in his quest to teach the Fremen the language of ecological transformation. He gave them access to the technology of the Imperium — allowing them to greatly expand their catchbasins and windtraps. Pardot was also a very hands-on type and this <Unique>Unique</> cutteray was crafted and tuned to his exacting specifications.

GlidePartialStabilizationBelt_06_Schemat.desc: <Unique>Unique</> Active Directional Suspensor for explorers. Activate to hover at the apex of a jump arc and drift in movement direction. Depletes power as long as it is kept activated.

UniqueThumper_03_Schematic.desc: Modified to follow the Fremen design, this <Unique>Unique</> thumper generates a large amount of threat with the sandworm in a short amount of time. Just be sure to place it on open sand.

BodyFluidExtractor_Unique_Water_06_Schem.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> fluid extractor has been modified with a small filter that, upon use, can separate some pure water out of blood and divert it to the appropriate containers. Developed by slavers who did not wish to risk disease but considered their cargo a portable source of water.

PowerPack_Unique_Regen_06_Schematic.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> power pack that recharges more rapidly, but has a lower power pool.

DewReaper_1h_Unique_Compact_06_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> dew reaper can collapse down into an extremely small size, reducing the amount of space it occupies in inventories.

Bloodsack_Unique_Durable_06_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> bloodbag is named for the Baron Harkonnen. During one of his infrequent visits to Arrakis, he had a group of Fremen sacrificed in Carthag, and then hung bags full of their blood in public places throughout the city — daring others to come and try to reclaim their water.

Combat_Neut_SmugglerDeserterUnique06_Hel.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> armor set uses an experimental plasmeld layer to absorb dart impacts. In the earliest versions, the darts would stick in the gel-like outer layer, leaving the wearer bristling with darts like a pincushion. Though that flaw has been perfected, the name persists.

Combat_Neut_AtreidesDeserterUnique05_Hel.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> heavy armor has internal layers of reinforced metal to protect House troops from darts, however the bulk of this armor greatly increases stamina costs.

Combat_Neut_AtreidesDeserterUnique05_Top.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> heavy armor has internal layers of reinforced metal to protect House troops from darts, however the bulk of this armor greatly increases stamina costs.

Combat_Hark_MedUnique02_Helmet_Schematic.desc: Stock armor is made of hardened plasmeld. This <Unique>Unique</> armor set is reinforced during the fabrication process - attaching minor heat dissipating components to every molecule within the plasmeld mass. This delivers increased heat resistance and a hard armor.

It is also highly armored, which makes it useful in combat. But regardless, the Imperium has never quite managed to replicate the elegant simplicity of Fremen technology.

Stillsuit_Unique_Efficient_06_Boots_Sche.desc: After his ordeal in the Deep Desert, Keif Villari became an overnight hero to the members of the Miner's Guild. Cashing in on his fame, this <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit is branded by CHOAM as 'the stillsuit to wear when you're stuck in the desert for forty days'. Villari receives a small royalty for each stillsuit purchased.

Combat_Heavy_Unique_PowerEfficient_Glove.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> heavy armor gauntlet that recon squads use to optimize power usage on connected Power Packs.

Combat_Heavy_Unique_PowerIncrease_Top_06.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> heavy chest armor comes with additional power reserves to assist House forces in mining and suspensor usage.

Combat_Light_Unique_Scanning_Helmet_06_S.desc: The electronics in this <Unique>Unique</> helmet connect to hand-held scanners, boosting their scanning range.

Combat_Light_Unique_WormThreat_Boots_06_.desc: Found abandoned throughout the former territories of the Fremen, these <Unique>Unique</> boots are made of a strange type of soft leather. Each step in these boots seems to melt into the sand, reducing the vibrations that attract the worm. Sietch Tabr was one of the Fremen sietches that put up little to no resistance during the pogrom, instead melting away quietly.

Combat_Light_Unique_Climbing_Gloves_06_S.desc: These <Unique>Unique</> light armor gloves assist House troops in climbing, making it less arduous and stamina draining.

Combat_Light_Unique_Stamina_Bottom_06_Sc.desc: These <Unique>Unique</> light leggings are equipped with a compression triggered mechanism which stimulates the leg muscles, reducing the stamina drain of dashing.

Stillsuit_Unique_HighCapacity_06_Top_Sch.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> stillsuit design was originally an extension to the Imperial stillsuit and was manufactured by sycophant in the case of a visit from the Emperor himself. With extra large thighpads and catchpockets, this stillsuit lets the wearer go for days without needing to use a toilet, something which has become a source of much amusement.

Stillsuit_Unique_HeatMitigation_06_Mask_.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> hood is designed to reduce the harm caused by direct sunlight. The famous planetologist, Pardot Kynes, designed this hood for Fremen workers who were helping with his experiments. It has been soaked in the juice of the creosote bush — inhibiting sweating and reducing heat buildup.

Combat_Light_Unique_DewReap_Gloves_06_Sc.desc: The treatment for these gloves was designed by the traitor, Dr Yueh. Originally he was searching for a way to repel blood from gloves during surgeries, but the applications of his water repellant treatment were wider than he imagined. Treated with a small amount of huf-huf oil, these <Unique>Unique</> gloves repel water and prevent any additional dew from escaping while harvesting.

Combat_Light_Unique_ReduceSuspensor_Top_.desc: This jacket was jury-rigged by Duncan Idaho to improve his suspensor power during aerial combat bouts. His famous knee charge relies on suspensors to give him additional range. This <Unique>Unique</> jacket features a series of specially designed capacitors to optimize the flow of energy through power pack and suspensor belt.

UniqueSda6_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> Maula pistol has a modified spring mechanism that automatically reloads darts without releasing trigger pressure. This model is older than any others, and seems to have been developed by the Fremen. It differs from the designs that integrate the modifications from Count Fenring.

UniqueSword_05_Schematic.desc:
During the Butlerian Jihad, pulse-swords were used to cut through the thinking machines and damage their electronics with pulses of deadly electricity. It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries.

This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when parrying an enemy - offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary swords of the Butlerian Jihad.

UniqueScattergun5_Schematic.desc: Thin spikes in the barrel mean that the darts fired from this <Unique>Unique</> scattergun will break into multiple shrapnel pieces on impact, causing a bleeding effect on enemies. Another example of Sardaukar weaponry built to intimidate and oppress.

UniqueDirk_04_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> knife is a modified surgical tool that was developed for treating field injuries. It seals injuries as it cuts using a small cutteray to superheat the blade. Mostly useful for amputations and as desperate field surgeons discovered, setting your enemy on fire.

UniqueAr4_Schematic.desc: When Salusa Secundus was reduced from a fertile planet to an irradiated wasteland of a planet, House Corrino swore vengeance on their enemies. This <Unique>Unique</> battle rifle was created as a memory of that oath and the explosive darts that it fires are reminiscent of the fires that rained down on Salusa Secundus itself.

UniqueRapier_03_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> sword contains a series of toxin releasing nodules along the length of the blade. Gurney Halleck, renowned troubadour and mercenary, kept a similar blade by his side when performing for noble audiences. When a drunken noble once asked if he felt his music was bad enough that he needed a sword to defend it, Gurney replied: 'Nay, I fear not your wrath, but when your wives and daughters rush the stage — I'll need steel to keep my trousers fastened!'

UniqueSmg3_Schematic.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> Disruptor with heavy darts doubleshots for added damage. What it lacks in rate of fire it makes up for the punches it throws.

SMG_Unique_LargeMag_06_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> disruptor has a small inscription beneath the barrel, beside the makers mark. It reads 'In honor of the Faufreluches — a dart for every man and for every man a dart.' No matter how often the schematics are modified, this inscription is always fabricated on the weapon.

Kindjal_Unique_Blood_06_Schematic.desc: Commonly used in his black-gloved main-hand during arena bouts, Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen had a small compartment designed that could deliver poison - though usually it was the white-gloved off-hand that carried the poisoned blade. Though most never knew of his treachery, this <Unique>Unique</> kindjal became popular on Arrakis for the opposite reason, it was capable of stealing blood from enemies and storing it in the compartment.

LongRifle_Unique_Poison_06_Schematic.desc: Fremen warriors modified these <Unique>Unique</> rifles and used them in their relentless guerilla campaign against the Harkonnen. A single Fremen could remain, near buried and practically invisible in the sand dunes beside a spice blow, awaiting their chance at Harkonnen prey. These warriors were called Dunewatchers.

HeavyPistol_Unique_Bleed_06_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> heavy pistol borrows technology from the fast firing-disruptor submachine gun, while adding a charging mechanism to fire shield-destabilizing darts.

LMG_Unique_RapidFire_06_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> machine gun is considered so effective at cowing the populace during wars, it is often placed on display in local population centers as a threat. However, the Sardaukar prefer not to carry such bulky weapons into conflict, and will only do so at a Bashar's Command.

Shotgun_Unique_Explosive_06_Schematic.desc: An increased capacity makes this <Unique>Unique</> Drillshot the anti-shield weapon of choice. An added charge mechanism was added to the base FK7, powering up devastating 2-round bursts of burrow darts.

RocketLauncher_Unique_Homing_06_Schemati.desc: When Holtzman shields became widely available, the use of artillery in warfare dramatically reduced. During the Battle of Arrakeen, the Baron Harkonnen brought them back, using heavy rockets to seal Atreides soldiers in caves, thus avoiding the problem of Holtzman shields entirely. Since then, these <Unique>Unique</> missile launchers have become widely sought after by Fremen and Imperial troops alike.

UniqueSda_Doubleshot_06_Schematic.desc: A too-tight spring in the magazine coupled with a too-wide barrel make this <Unique>Unique</> maula pistol fire two darts at the same time in bursts albeit with reduced accuracy. Manufacturers have labelled these obvious problems as "features".

UniqueScattergun_Fire_06_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> scattergun was used during the Battle of Arrakeen. When Harkonnen troops charged the front gates of the palace, they were dismayed to find the shields still functional, despite being assured otherwise. A group of Atreides gunners used shellburst scatterguns to spread fire and chaos among the Harkonnen ranks, breaking them.

HeavyPistol_Unique_Headshot_06_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> pistol comes with increased accuracy and bonus damage for headshots, but with a low capacity clip.

LongRifle_Unique_LargeMag_06_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> non-scoped Spitdart Rifle was developed with increased magazine capacity and fires poison-coated darts in a horizontal tripleshot pattern.

LMG_Unique_Power_06_Schematic.desc: Originally designed to fire a steady stream of blue orbs at hellish foes, this <Unique>Unique</> plasma gun tears imps to shreds and rips Arch-viles and Cacodemons apart. Oh... I've just been informed this text is for DUNE not DOOM. Ignore me then.

Shotgun_Unique_Blood_06_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> scattergun fires drilling darts which penetrate slowly through a Holtzman shield and then continue drilling — causing gaping bleeding wounds to the enemy. When the inventor was asked about the juvenile name he simply replied 'I'm all about drilling through defenses and going deep. I also design weapons. Ask your mother.'

UniqueAr_Burst_06_Schematic.desc: When the War of Assassins came to Arrakis, Indara and her husband, Ardan, were stationed at a small Atreides outpost on the shield wall. As the relentless attacks of the Harkonnens continued, Ardan forced Indara to flee into a nearby cave system with their young child. Nobody knows why this <Unique>Unique</> weapon is named for Indara - but there is speculation that she and her child still haunt the caves of the Deep Desert Shield Wall. This rifle fires a modified three-round burst, with the final dart in the burst dealing additional damage.

Kindjal_Unique_Stamina_06_Schematic.desc:
During the Butlerian Jihad, pulse-blades were used to cut through the thinking machines and damage their electronics with pulses of deadly electricity. It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries.

This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when hitting an enemy — offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary weapons of the Butlerian Jihad.

UniqueRapier_Power_06_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> rapier is utilized to shock and disrupt the power supplies of their opponents.

Combat_Light_Unique_BiomeHeat_Top_06_Sch.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> light chest armor is made with breathable material which allows one to better survive harsh desert climates.

UniqueFlameThrower_02_Schematic.desc:
While artillery weapons and projectiles became deemphasized with the invention of the Holtzman shield, the humble flamethrower saw wider adoption in the military forces of the Imperium. Holtzman shields provide very little protection against being slowly cooked from the outside.

This <Unique>Unique</> flamethrower has a higher gel capacity and more intense flame.

UniqueSword_05_Damasteel_Schematic.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> sword forged of composite materials. Traditionally, some of the iron in the damasteel alloy is supposed to come from an organic source.

Combat_Heavy_Unique_Swordmaster_Schemati.desc: A schematic set for the Swordmaster Unique Armor. Can be consumed, then crafted in a garment fabricator.

Combat_Light_Unique_BeneGeserit_Schemati.desc: A schematic set for the Bene Gesserit Unique Armor. Can be consumed, then crafted in a garment fabricator.

Combat_Light_Unique_Mentat_Schematic.desc: A schematic set for the Mentat Unique Armor. Can be consumed, then crafted in a garment fabricator.

Combat_Heavy_Unique_Trooper_Schematic.desc: A schematic set for the Trooper Unique Armor. Can be consumed, then crafted in a garment fabricator.

Stillsuit_Unique_Planetologist_Schematic.desc: A schematic set for the Planetologist Unique Light Armor. Can be consumed, then crafted in a wearables fabricator.

OrnithopterLightLocomotion_Unique_Speed_.desc: Named for the birds from old terra who could cross an ocean with a single wingbeat, these <Unique>Unique</> 'thopter wings are designed for speed, but they limit maneuverability.

OrnithopterMediumBoost_Unique_LessHeat_5.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> boost provides a steady boost at a lower maximum speed, proving the adage "slow and steady wins the race". On Arrakis, natives tend to modify it slightly saying "only if you have enough fuel and the worm is very far away".

OrnithopterMediumBoost_Unique_LessHeat_6.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> boost provides a steady boost at a lower maximum speed, proving the adage "slow and steady wins the race". On Arrakis, natives tend to modify it slightly saying "only if you have enough fuel and the worm is very far away".

OrnithopterMediumLocomotion_Unique_Straf.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> wing was developed during the Harkonnen stewardship of Arrakis, before the current War of Assassins. The Fremen were fond of raiding Harkonnen bases and stealing these Ornithopters, then using them in kamikaze attacks on harvesting operations.

OrnithopterTransportLocomotion_Unique_Sp.desc: Named for the birds from old terra who could cross an ocean with a single wingbeat, these <Unique>Unique</> 'thopter wings are designed for speed, but they limit maneuverability.

Shotgun_Unique_LargeMag_06_Schematic.desc: A unique shotgun with an ambitious design that holds two slugs in each barrel to limit the downsides of these types of weapons.

Combat_Light_Unique_MovingDmgReduction_B.desc: These unique light armor boots use the wearers kinetic energy to stimulate additional adrenaline production.

Combat_Heavy_Unique_StandStillDmgReducti.desc: This unique heavy armor is fortified with materials that become exceptionally dense when stationary.

Combat_Light_Unique_StaminaDmgIncrease_H.desc: This unique helmet assists in identifying vulnerable areas in enemies.

PowerPack_Unique_PoisRadMitigation_06_Sc.desc: This unique power pack creates an electromagnetic field around the wearer that protects against radiation and toxins.

FullStabilizationBelt_Unique_DmgReductio.desc: This unique stabilization suspensor belt enables the wearer to rapidly adjust movements to avoid incoming hits while suspended.

SandcrawlerSpiceContainer_Unique_Capacit.desc: Adds a <Unique>Unique</> container for collecting Spice Sand to the Sandcrawler. Use a Welding Torch to attach it to a Sandcrawler Chassis.

Unique_Sword_BleedyBlocky_4_Schematic.desc: This beautiful <Unique>Unique</> sword is fashioned from shock-absorbing materials that reduce the strain of blocks and parries. It also includes a cluster of integrated plasteel shards - the seven sorrows - near the hilt that can wound the blade hand of an attacker upon a successful block.

Unique_Sword_BleedyBlocky_5_Schematic.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> sword is fashioned from shock-absorbing materials that reduce the strain of blocks and parries. On Arrakis, natives tend to modify it slightly saying, "Only if you have enough fuel and the worm is very far away."

TreadwheelEngine_Unique_Speed_4_Schemati.desc: Early explorers on Arrakis quickly came to appreciate the value of speed. This <Unique>Unique</> treadwheel engine configuration grants increased speed at the cost of additional heat generation - just the thing when reaching the next outcropping of rock fast is a matter of life or death!

Stillsuit_Choam_Unique_Dashed02_Top_Sche.desc: Veteran Dune Men know the value of being able to run just a little bit faster and further than the next guy when danger threatens. Those who can afford the extra cost often invest in this <Unique>Unique</> upgraded stillsuit fashioned from lightweight materials.

Those who can afford the extra cost often invest in this <Unique>Unique</> upgraded stillsuit fashioned from lightweight materials.

Stillsuit_Choam_Unique_Dashed06_Top_Sche.desc: It takes years of hard work to reach the rank of Guild Crew Chief. Most chiefs are well into their later years when they earn their promotion, and the wear and tear of a lifetime spent spice harvesting has taken its toll on their bodies. Investing in one of these <Unique>Unique</> ultralight stillsuits is one way to make getting through a twelve hour shift a bit easier. Even those who are still strong and vigorous will benefit from wearing such a suit, as it significantly reduces the stamina cost of dashing.

Unique_MiscEquipment_FullSuspensorBelt_D.desc:
This item has additional durability.

It is said Baron Harkonnen floats into a room with the grotesque majesty of a glutinous god. He owes much of that awe to his superior suspensor belt. This <Unique>Unique</> model likewise bears the markings and fine materials designating it as a custom creation that belonged to, or was meant for, someone of high nobility.

PowerPack_Unique_Capacity_06_Schematic.desc: An Imperial Testing Station full of radiation and corpses sits in the Deep Desert. It is said the parts of lost House atomics were used to create other devices. This <Unique>Unique</> power pack is charged by a nuclear accelerator, offering a higher than normal durability for those brave enough to use it.

UniqueAr6_Electric_Schematic.desc: An old Planetologist wisdom says: “The freaks of cyclonic storms are the rules of cyclonic storms.” In their hubris to harness the Coriolis storm, a team of scientists lost their lives in an Imperial Testing Station. This <Unique>Unique</> rifle, a byproduct of those experiments, uses electrical power rather than standard ammunition. The EMP blasts disrupt shields.

Fireballer_2_Schematic.desc: The weapon’s designer had a known sadistic streak. This <Unique>Unique</> customized flamethrower fires condensed balls of ignited incendiary gel. On impact, fireballs detonate, dealing damage in a large radius. The splashing gel clings to flesh, searing and bubbling skin and fat with intense heat.

Fireballer_3_Schematic.desc: The weapon’s designer had a known sadistic streak. This <Unique>Unique</> customized flamethrower fires condensed balls of ignited incendiary gel. On impact, fireballs detonate, dealing damage in a large radius. The splashing gel clings to flesh, searing and bubbling skin and fat with intense heat.

Consumable_Buff_PoisonStackIncrease_Sche.desc: In a hidden Imperial Testing Station, experiments in hybridizing fogwood and elacca plants led to madness and death. A beneficial byproduct of these experiments, these <Unique>Unique</> pills utilize properties extracted from both plants. Said pills slows toxin absorption down to half its usual speed, allowing one to take on impressive amounts of poison before suffering ill effects.

QualityLevelTest_Schematic.desc: NA_This is a test item. Do not localize

DualBlades_1_Schematic.desc:
Holding down the attack button initiates a sequence of frenzied hits that partially bypass shields.

The slightly curved, double-edged Kindjal and the smaller Slip-tip knife form a marriage of razor-sharp mayhem. A dual-wielding fighting style has formed around these two weapons. Often, the frightful Kindjal draws the eye while the Slip-tip sneaks into one’s vitals.

T6_Augment_Acuracy1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation which increases the accuracy of any ranged weapon.

T6_Augment_Armor1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces concussive damage taken, but increases energy damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor10_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces energy damage taken, but increases poison damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor11_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces poison damage taken, but increases energy damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor12_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces dart damage taken, but increases overall volume.

T6_Augment_Armor13_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces fire damage taken, but increases poison damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor14_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces blade damage taken, but increases dart damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor16_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces radiation build up and fire damage taken, but increases blade and dart damage taken. This augmentation cannot be applied to Radiation Suits.

T6_Augment_Armor17_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces radiation build up, but increases overall volume.

T6_Augment_Armor2_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces concussive damage taken, but increases dart damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor4_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces dart damage taken, but increases blade damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor5_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces energy damage taken, but increases concussive damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor6_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which increases armor value.

T6_Augment_Armor8_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which increases heat protection, but increases overall volume.

T6_Augment_Armor9_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces poison damage taken, but increases fire damage taken.

T6_Augment_BR1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Karpov 38-specific augmentation that delays the release of fired darts in order to build up additional force, thus reducing the fire rate while increasing the damage output and accuracy.

T6_Augment_BR2_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Karpov 38-specific augmentation that opts for less power behind each dart in order to fire more darts. This reduces the overall damage of each dart fired but increases the fire rate.

T6_Augment_BR3_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Karpov 38-specific augmentation that alters the magazine to hold more powerful darts but fewer of them, thus reducing the weapon's overall volume and magazine capacity while improving damage output.

T6_Augment_BR4_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Karpov 38-specific augmentation which improves accuracy and reload times and reduces recoil, but the overall damage output is reduced.

T6_Augment_BR8_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Karpov 38-specific augmentation which focuses more on dealing critical damage to weak spots en-masse, thus increasing magazine capacity, headshot damage, and overall volume while reducing accuracy.

T6_Augment_Damage1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation which increases the damage output of any ranged weapon.

T6_Augment_DeathDurabilityOff_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation which removes the durability loss incurred when suffering defeat.

T6_Augment_Fireballer1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Pyrocket-specific augmentation that increases damage output and fire rate, but at the cost of reload time and increased volume.

T6_Augment_Fireballer2_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Pyrocket-specific augmentation that increases ammo capacity, reduces reload times and reduces overall volume, albeit at the cost of reduced accuracy and damage to shields.

T6_Augment_Flamethrower1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a flamethrower-specific augmentation that increases damage output and reduces recoil, but increases overall volume.

T6_Augment_Flamethrower2_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a flamethrower-specific augmentation that sprays out flames faster and causes more painful burns, but reduces the effective range.

T6_Augment_Flamethrower3_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a flamethrower-specific augmentation that increases the effective range and ammo capacity at the cost of increased volume and recoil.

T6_Augment_Flamethrower4_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a flamethrower-specific augmentation that reduces recoil, reload time, and overall volume at the cost of damage output.

T6_Augment_Headshotdamage1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation which increases the headshot damage of any ranged weapon.

T6_Augment_HeavyPistol1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for the Rafiq Snubnose heavy pistol which focuses on improving the stopping power of the gun, but makes it harder to handle.  This increases the damage and headshot damage of the gun at the cost of reducing the fire rate.

T6_Augment_HeavyPistol2_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Rafiq Snubnose-specific augmentation that improves the stopping power and shield disruption effect of the pistol while reducing overall volume, but at the cost of ammo capacity and reload time.

T6_Augment_HeavyPistol3_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for the Rafiq Snubnose which reduces recoil and reload time and improves accuracy but reduces overall stopping power.

T6_Augment_HeavyPistol4_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Rafiq Snubnose-specific augmentation that increases the ammo capacity of the pistol at the cost of recoil and increased overall volume.

T6_Augment_HeavyPistol5_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for the Rafiq Snubnose which increases the weapon's fire rate at the cost of shield damage.

T6_Augment_Lasgun1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Lasgun-specific augmentation which increases the beam's damaging power and reduces overall volume, however the power drain and recoil suffer.

T6_Augment_Lasgun2_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Lasgun-specific augmentation that increases the range and accuracy of the beam and reduces overall volume, but reduces overall damage output.

T6_Augment_Lasgun3_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for Lasguns which increases the rate of fire of the beam, reduces recoil, and reduces power drain, however the range of the beam and its damage output are reduced, and overall volume is increased.

T6_Augment_Lasgun4_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Lasgun-specific augmentation which increases damage output and reduces overall volume, but reduces range and increases recoil.

T6_Augment_Lmg1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a VULCAN GAU-92-specific augmentation which increases ammo capacity and improves reload times at the cost of accuracy, damage output, and overall volume.

T6_Augment_Lmg4_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for the VULCAN GAU-92 which increases range and accuracy and reduces recoil, however rate of fire is reduced.

T6_Augment_Lmg5_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a VULCAN GAU-92-specific augmentation that increases shield damage output and overall damage output, but reduces accuracy and increases recoil and reload times.

T6_Augment_Lmg6_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a VULCAN GAU-92-specific augmentation which increases rate of fire, but reduces effective range and accuracy.

T6_Augment_Magazinecapacity1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation that increases the ammo capacity of any ranged weapon, but increases overall volume.

T6_Augment_MaulaPistol1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Maula Pistol-specific augmentation which increases fire rate but reduces headshot damage.

T6_Augment_MaulaPistol2_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Maula Pistol-specific augmentation that increases damage and shield damage and reduces overall volume, but reduces ammo capacity.

T6_Augment_MaulaPistol3_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Maula Pistol-specific augmentation that expands ammo capacity and increases fire rate, but reduces accuracy and overall damage.

T6_Augment_MaulaPistol4_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for Maula Pistols that increases effective range and accuracy and reduces reload times, but reduces overall rate of fire.

T6_Augment_MaulaPistol5_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Maula Pistol-specific augmentation that reduces recoil and overall volume while also increasing accuracy and headshot damage. However, rate of fire and ammo capacity are reduced.

T6_Augment_Melee1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation which increases the damage output of any melee weapon.

T6_Augment_Melee2_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation which reduces the stamina cost to attack of any melee weapon.

T6_Augment_Melee3_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation which reduces the stamina cost to block of any melee weapon.

T6_Augment_Melee4_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a melee weapon augmentation which reduces the stamina cost to attack, but increases the stamina cost to block.

T6_Augment_Melee5_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a melee weapon augmentation which reduces the stamina cost to attack and overall volume, but reduces damage output.

T6_Augment_Melee6_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a melee weapon augmentation which increases damage, but increases stamina cost to block.

T6_Augment_Melee7_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a melee weapon augmentation which reduces the stamina cost to block, but increases the stamina cost to attack.

T6_Augment_Melee8_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a melee weapon augmentation which reduces the stamina cost to block and attack, but reduces damage.

T6_Augment_Melee9_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a melee weapon augmentation which increases damage, but increases stamina cost to attack.

T6_Augment_Range1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation which increases the effective range of any ranged weapon.

T6_Augment_Rateoffire1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation which increases the rate of fire of any ranged weapon.

T6_Augment_Recoil1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation which reduces the recoil of any ranged weapon.

T6_Augment_ReloadSpeed1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation which reduces the reload time of any ranged weapon.

T6_Augment_RocketLauncher1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for Missile Launchers which increases area of effect and reduces reload times, but reduces shield damage.

T6_Augment_RocketLauncher2_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Missile Launcher-specific augmentation which increases shield damage, but increases reload times.

T6_Augment_RocketLauncher3_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Missile Launcher-specific augmentation which reduces reload times and recoil and increases accuracy, but reduces overall damage.

T6_Augment_RocketLauncher4_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for Missile Launchers which increases their damage output, but reduces shield damage and area of effect.

T6_Augment_Scattergun2_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a GRDA 44-specific augmentation which increases headshot damage, but reduces fire rate.

T6_Augment_Scattergun4_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for the GRDA 44 which increases ammo capacity and effective range, but increases shot spread and reduces damage output.

T6_Augment_Scattergun5_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a GRDA 44-specific augmentation which increases damage output and reduces shot spread, but reduces effective range.

T6_Augment_Scattergun6_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for the GRDA 44 which increases damage output, reduces shot spread and overall volume, but at the cost of ammo capacity.

T6_Augment_Scattergun7_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a GRDA 44-specific augmentation which increases rate of fire, but reduces accuracy and increases recoil and shot spread.

T6_Augment_Scattergun8_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for the GRDA 44 which increases effective range and accuracy, and reduces recoil and overall volume, but reduces ammo capacity.

T6_Augment_Shielddamage1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation which increases the shield damage of any ranged weapon.

T6_Augment_Shotgun1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Drillshot FK7-specific augmentation which increases headshot damage, accuracy, and effective range, but reduces rate of fire.

T6_Augment_Shotgun2_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for the Drillshot FK7 which increases damage and reduces overall volume, but reduces ammo capacity.

T6_Augment_Shotgun3_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Drillshot FK7-specific augmentation which increases damage and reduces recoil, but reduces accuracy.

T6_Augment_Shotgun4_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for the Drillshot FK7 which increases rate of fire and ammo capacity, but reduces damage output and increases recoil and overall volume.

T6_Augment_Shotgun5_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Drillshot FK7-specific augmentation that reduces reload times, improves headshot damage, and reduces overall volume, but reduces accuracy and ammo capacity and increases recoil.

T6_Augment_smg1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Disruptor-specific augmentation which increases ammo capacity and accuracy, and reduces recoil, but reduces damage output.

T6_Augment_smg2_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for the Disruptor M11 which reduces reload times and increases rate of fire, but reduces damage output and accuracy, and increases overall volume.

T6_Augment_smg3_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Disruptor-specific augmentation which increases shield damage and effective range, but reduces rate of fire.

T6_Augment_smg4_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for the Disruptor M11 which increases ammo capacity and rate of fire, but increases reload times and overall volume.

T6_Augment_Smg5_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Disruptor-specific augmentation which increases damage output, but reduces rate of fire.

T6_Augment_smg7_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for the Disruptor M11 which increases damage and reduces overall volume, but reduces accuracy and ammo capacity.

T6_Augment_Spitdartrifle2_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for the JABAL Spitdart Rifle which increases headshot damage, but increases recoil.

T6_Augment_Spitdartrifle3_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a JABAL Spitdart Rifle-specific augmentation which increases accuracy and range, but increases reload times.

T6_Augment_SpitdartRifle5_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for the JABAL Spitdart Rifle which increases damage, but increases recoil.

T6_Augment_SpitdartRifle6_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a JABAL Spitdart Rifle-specific augmentation which increases shield damage, but reduces ammo capacity.

T6_Augment_SpitdartRifle7_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for JABAL Spitdart Rifles which increases ammo capacity and rate of fire, but reduces effective range, accuracy, and damage output and increases overall volume.

T6_Augment_SpitdartRifle8_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a JABAL Spitdart Rifle-specific augmentation which increases poison damage dealt, but reduces shield damage dealt.

Contract_LandsraadPowerpackComponent_Sch.desc: Power pack utilizing new cutting-edge energy storage technology, assembled from irradiated materials found in the wreck of the Tyche. Highly volatile.

Contract_LandsraadSurveillanceSensor_Sch.desc: A schematic to craft a surveillance sensor, a common form of listening device with local recording and broadcasting functionality.

Contract_LandsraadExperimentalWindTurbin.desc: A schematic for crafting the Experimental Wind Turbine, designed to withstand the Coriolis storm.

Contract_LandsraadSealedRecorder_Schemat.desc: A schematic for a sealed recorder, used to record illicit track data.

Contract_LandsraadIxianSurveillanceDevic.desc: A schematic for an Ixian Transeye equipped with automatic cloaking tuned to the Blushing Cavern frequencies, rendering it invisible and impossible to track.

T6_Augment_Armor3_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces blade damage taken, but increases poison and fire damage taken.

Radiation_Suit_T6_Unique_Armored_Schemat.desc: It is difficult enough to keep out leaks and maintain the integrity of a radiation suit under normal circumstances, let alone in the chaos of combat. This <Unique>unique</> suit is reinforced with armor and higher radiation mitigation for those unfortunate souls who find themselves fighting in an irradiated hellscape.

UniqueDualBlades_6_Schematic.desc: Designed by Masano of the Sandflies, these <Unique>unique</>, heated blades both tear and scorch flesh, leaving a screaming impression.

T6_Augment_Damage2_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an experimental augmentation provided by your Great House which increases the damage output of any ranged weapon.

Contract_LandsraadConvergence_Triangulat.desc: A schematic for an Ixian Triangulator used to find the center point of a triangle

T6_Augment_Ch5_BR1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Karpov 38-specific augmentation which increases range and accuracy but reduces reload speed.

T6_Augment_Ch5_Fireballer1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Pyrocket-specific augmentation which offers a massive bonus to shield damage but reduces magazine size and accuracy.

T6_Augment_Ch5_Flamethrower1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Flamethrower-specific augmentation which offers a massive bonus to shield damage but reduces the rate of fire.

T6_Augment_Ch5_Heavypistol1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Rafiq Snubnose-specific augmentation which grants a significant bonus to range and some added recoil control — but reduces magazine size.

T6_Augment_Ch5_Lasgun1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Lasgun-specific augmentation which increases the beam’s damaging power and accuracy but reduces the rate of fire and magazine size.

T6_Augment_Ch5_LMG1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a VULCAN GAU-92-specific augmentation which increases accuracy, recoil control, and reload speed at the cost of its shield damaging capabilities.

T6_Augment_Ch5_Maulapistol1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Maula Pistol-specific augmentation which increases damage and critical damage at the cost of shield damage, range, and recoil.

T6_Augment_Ch5_RocketLauncher1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation for Missile Launchers which increases shield damage and recoil control, but reduces accuracy.

T6_Augment_Ch5_Scattergun1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Scattergun-specific augmentation which increases damage and magazine size, at the cost of critical hit damage.

T6_Augment_Ch5_Shotgun1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a  Drillshot FK7-specific augmentation which increases reload speed and rate of fire, at the cost of range, recoil, and magazine size.

T6_Augment_Ch5_SMG1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a Disruptor M11-specific augmentation which increases critical damage and rate of fire, at the cost of shield damage, range, and recoil.

T6_Augment_Ch5_Spitdart1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for a JABAL Spitdart-specific augmentation which increases reload speed and reduces recoil, at a cost to the rate of fire.

T6_Augment_Ch5_Melee1_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation which increases the damage output of any melee weapon while greatly increasing its weight.

T6_Augment_Ch5_Melee3_Schematic.desc: A schematic for an augmentation, for any melee weapon, which reduces weight and stamina cost but reduces damage.

Contract_LandsraadMinefieldSurveyor_Sche.desc: PH_Schematics for the Minefield Surveyor that scans for subsurface hazards

B1C4_Unique_HarkAr2_Schematic.desc: Sometimes, even a minor wound can kill. This <Unique>Unique</> rifle is modified to do poison damage.

B1C4_Unique_LMG2_Schematic.desc: Peak aggression is often the enemy of precision. This <Unique>Unique</> LMG is very inaccurate but makes up for it with a 25% damage bonus.

B1C4_Unique_SmugDmr1_Schematic.desc: Necessity is the mother of modification. This <Unique>Unique</> rifle sacrifices its scope for slightly faster reload, slightly faster rate of fire, and holds 5 ammo.

Exoskeleton_Heavy06_Unique_Top_Schematic.desc:
In addition to its base stats, this <Unique>Unique</> heavy armor grants +10% melee damage to the wearer.

This advanced armor comes with a muscle memory tech system. It learns the motions of the wearer and exaggerates them, for more powerful attacks.

Assassin_Light06_Unique_Helmet_Schematic.desc:
In addition to its base stats, this <Unique>Unique</> headpiece grants a 5% detection speed reduction.

A protracted, never-ending War of Assassins makes a fertile ground for those who slay by stealth. The Phantom Whisper Tech employed in armor and garments, to dampen sound while moving, is the brainchild of Ixian inventors who saw a tremendous uptick in their wealth with the conflict on Arrakis.

Assassin_Light06_Unique_Top_Schematic.desc:
In addition to its base stats, this <Unique>Unique</> chestpiece grants a 5% detection speed reduction.

A protracted, never-ending War of Assassins makes a fertile ground for those who slay by stealth. The Phantom Whisper Tech employed in armor and garments, to dampen sound while moving, is the brainchild of Ixian inventors who saw a tremendous uptick in their wealth with the conflict on Arrakis.

B1C4_Unique_Dirk2_Schematic.desc: The best offense is a fully-charged battery. Every attack from this <Unique>Unique</> blade restores one’s power pack by 5.

B1C4_Unique_DualBlades1_Schematic.desc: A drained enemy is a helpless enemy. Every hit from these <Unique>Unique</> dual blades drains a target of power.

B1C4_Unique_Kindjal2_Schematic.desc: Intrigue amongst the Great Houses is a treacherous game. Poison often coats the blades of polite society. This <Unique>Unique</> Kindjal causes poison damage.

B1C4_Unique_Sword2_Schematic.desc: A special chemical treatment super heats the blade. Enemies who live tend to carry the scars with them forever after. This <Unique>Unique</> sword causes burn buildup with every hit.

B1C4_Unique_Rapier2_Schematic.desc: The edge of this blade is so sharp, its balance so precise, the wielder feels as if they know their opponent’s next move before they do. No attacker comes away unscathed. This <Unique>Unique</> rapier causes bleed on an opponent with every successful parry.

B1C4_Unique_SMG2_Schematic.desc: If at first your poison fails to slay — inundate, inundate, inundate. This <Unique>Unique</>, assassin-modified disruptor causes poison buildup with every hit.

B1C4_Unique_HeavyPistol2_Schematic.desc: A special cocktail of magnesium and certain other elements can produce a very nasty, burning round. This <Unique>Unique</> snub-nosed heavy pistol causes burn buildup on a hit.

Contract_LandsraadRareMetalsExtractor_Sc.desc: A compact, rare mineral extraction unit, reconstructed from a stolen Yafeng schematic from Wind Pass. This prototype confirms the design performs exactly as promised. A valuable schematic to possess, especially when preparing to ensure others receive something less reliable.

VehicleBackupTool.desc: Use it to store and restore your Sandbike, Scout Ornithopter, or Treadwheel. Can also be used to recover destroyed vehicles for a cost.

D_UniqueSword_05_Damasteel.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> sword forged of composite materials. Traditionally, some of the iron in the damasteel alloy is supposed to come from an organic source.

UniqueSword_05.desc:
During the Butlerian Jihad, pulse-swords were used to cut through the thinking machines and damage their electronics with pulses of deadly electricity. It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries.

This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when parrying an enemy - offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary swords of the Butlerian Jihad.

UniqueSword_04.desc:
During the Butlerian Jihad, pulse-swords were used to cut through the thinking machines and damage their electronics with pulses of deadly electricity. It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries.

This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when parrying an enemy — offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary swords of the Butlerian Jihad.

It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries. This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when parrying an enemy — offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary swords of the Butlerian Jihad.

It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries. This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when parrying an enemy — offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary swords of the Butlerian Jihad.

UniqueSmg3.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> Disruptor with heavy darts doubleshots for added damage. What it lacks in rate of fire it makes up for the punches it throws.

UniqueSmg2.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> disruptor has been modified to spray doubleshots of heavy darts at a slower rate. The twisted mentat advisor to Baron Harkonnen, Piter de Vries, created this modified disruptor to be used to suppress riots on Giedi Prime. In his words, 'peace through suppression'.

UniqueSmg1.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> disruptor has been modified to spray doubleshots of heavy darts at a slower rate. The name is based on a popular joke that made the rounds on Arrakis a few years ago — a comment on the Baron's preferences and the virility of his younger brother, Abulurd. Anybody who was heard making the joke in Harkonnen territory was hanged, of course.

UniqueSda6.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> Maula pistol has a modified spring mechanism that automatically reloads darts without releasing trigger pressure. This model is older than any others, and seems to have been developed by the Fremen. It differs from the designs that integrate the modifications from Count Fenring.

UniqueSda5.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> Maula pistol has a modified spring mechanism that automatically reloads darts without releasing trigger pressure. Integrating the modifications from Count Hasimir Fenring, this newer design also accommodates better materials for longer durability.

UniqueSda4.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> Maula pistol has a modified spring mechanism that automatically reloads darts without releasing trigger pressure. Integrating the modifications from Count Hasimir Fenring, this newer design also accommodates better materials for longer durability.

UniqueSda3.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> Maula pistol has a modified spring mechanism that automatically reloads darts without releasing trigger pressure. Integrating the modifications from Count Hasimir Fenring, this newer design also accommodates better materials for longer durability.

UniqueSda2.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> Maula pistol has a modified spring mechanism that automatically reloads darts without releasing trigger pressure. Integrating the modifications from Count Hasimir Fenring, this newer design also accommodates better materials for longer durability.

UniqueSda1.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> Maula pistol has a modified spring mechanism that automatically reloads darts without releasing trigger pressure. Rumor has it that Count Hasimir Fenring designed this modification himself, admiring the design of the maula pistol while decrying the inefficiency of its firing mechanism.

UniqueSda_Doubleshot_06.desc: A too-tight spring in the magazine coupled with a too-wide barrel make this <Unique>Unique</> maula pistol fire bursts of two darts at the same time, albeit with reduced accuracy. Manufacturers have labelled these obvious problems as "features".

UniqueSda_Doubleshot_05.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> maula pistol developed in the shadow of Taqwa's Watch in the O'odham. Though Fremen battles rarely rely solely upon the maula pistol, it is still prudent to carry one — especially one with the capacity to fire double-shots bursts.

UniqueSda_Doubleshot_04.desc: Shadrath crafted this <Unique>Unique</> Maula pistol during his razzia against the Sardaukar bases around the Shield Wall. The double shot burst firing mechanism caused some inaccuracy in the shots, but it made up for it with the ability to puncture Sardaukar armor.

UniqueScattergun5.desc: Thin spikes in the barrel mean that the darts fired from this <Unique>Unique</> scattergun will break into multiple shrapnel pieces on impact, causing a bleeding effect on enemies. Another example of Sardaukar weaponry built to intimidate and oppress.

UniqueScattergun4.desc: Thin spikes in the barrel mean that the darts fired from this <Unique>Unique</> scattergun will break into multiple shrapnel pieces on impact, causing a bleeding effect on enemies. Brought from offworld only by Syndicate mercenaries, these formidable scatterguns are rarely found on Arrakis.

UniqueScattergun3.desc: Thin spikes in the barrel mean that the darts fired from this <Unique>Unique</> scattergun will break into multiple shrapnel pieces on impact, causing a bleeding effect on enemies. Sandflies propaganda states that this weapon was used against them when they rebelled, though there are no records of the mining guild ever having access to such weapons.

UniqueScattergun2.desc: Thin spikes in the barrel mean that the darts fired from this <Unique>Unique</> scattergun will break into multiple shrapnel pieces on impact, causing a bleeding effect on enemies. The slavers claim that they are the ones who designed this weapon — it is commonly used among them for crowd control.

UniqueScattergun1.desc: Thin spikes in the barrel mean that the darts fired from this <Unique>Unique</> scattergun will break into multiple shrapnel pieces on impact, causing a bleeding effect on enemies. It isn't known who created such a sadistic weapon — but it is commonly used by the Kirab of Hagga Basin.

UniqueScattergun_Fire_06.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> scattergun was used during the Battle of Arrakeen. When Harkonnen troops charged the front gates of the palace, they were dismayed to find the shields still functional, despite being assured otherwise. A group of Atreides gunners used shellburst scatterguns to spread fire and chaos among the Harkonnen ranks, breaking them.

UniqueScattergun_Fire_05.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> scattergun was first discovered aboard the wreck of the Euporia in the Sheol. The crew and weapons on board were Ixian, leading to speculation that the weapon was sidestepping the prohibitions of the Butlerian Jihad. However, when the weapon was opened up, it was a disappointingly standard application of heat transference principles.

UniqueScattergun_Fire_04.desc: The Sandflies created this <Unique>Unique</> scattergun by combining some of the principles of the cutteray with the necessities of modern warfare. The darts in this scattergun are superheated by a scalpel sized laser so that when they are fired they burst into flaming particles on impact.

UniqueRapier_Power_06.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> rapier is utilized by House forces to shock and disrupt the power supplies of their opponents.

UniqueRapier_03.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> sword contains a series of toxin releasing nodules along the length of the blade. Gurney Halleck, renowned troubadour and mercenary, kept a similar blade by his side when performing for noble audiences. When a drunken noble once asked if he felt his music was bad enough that he needed a sword to defend it, Gurney replied: 'Nay, I fear not your wrath, but when your wives and daughters rush the stage — I'll need steel to keep my trousers fastened!'

UniqueRapier_02.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> sword contains a series of toxin releasing nodules along the length of the blade. When struck with enough force, these nodules release a burst of poisonous gas — capable of passing through a shield. The Maas Kharet probably borrowed this design from the slavers — filling it with a poison of their own.

UniqueRapier.desc: A lethally modified version of a slaver weapon, this <Unique>Unique</> sword contains a series of toxin releasing nodules along the length of the blade. When struck with enough force, these nodules release a burst of poisonous gas — capable of passing through a shield. The slaver version of this weapon was used to release a sedative gas for capturing the unwilling.

UniqueFlameThrower_02.desc:
While artillery weapons and projectiles became deemphasized with the invention of the Holtzman shield, the humble flamethrower saw wider adoption in the military forces of the Imperium. Holtzman shields provide very little protection against being slowly cooked from the outside.

This <Unique>Unique</> flamethrower has a higher gel capacity and more intense flame.

UniqueFlameThrower.desc:
If there was one weapon the Sardaukar used to inspire fear in the Fremen, it was the flamethrower. In the narrow corridors of the sietch warrens, a single Sardaukar could become a firestorm of death and destruction. Perhaps worse, for the Fremen, the corpses could not be recovered for their water.

This <Unique>Unique</> flamethrower has a higher gel capacity and more intense flame.

UniqueDirk_04.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> knife is a modified surgical tool that was developed for treating field injuries. It seals injuries as it cuts using a small cutteray to superheat the blade. Mostly useful for amputations and as desperate field surgeons discovered, setting your enemy on fire.

UniqueDirk_03.desc: Ironically, the Fremen themselves might be the origin of this knife. For moisture sealing caves, they used this <Unique>Unique</> knife to quickly seal the plastic hoods against the cave walls. And for removal, they simply reheated the dirk and sliced the melted plastic from the walls.

UniqueDirk_02.desc:
Denira Quirth ran a supply depot for the Sandflies for many years, ensuring the flow of spice and other goods to the smugglers, in return for the basic supplies they needed to survive.

This <Unique>Unique</> dirk was reportedly a gift from Esmar Tuek himself a product of black-market technology that only a smuggler could access.

UniqueDirk.desc: Once there was a slave called Fila. She was captured by slavers while very young and dragged to Arrakis to serve the Harkonnen as a slave. While she lay dreaming in a slaver camp in Jabal Eifrit, disturbed by the spice that she was ingesting from the air, she dreamed of a flaming dirk that could set her free. When she woke, this <Unique>Unique</> dirk was in her hand. Fila slew several of her captors, burning them with the knife, before she fled south and disappeared. Though some say, she changed her name to Mendia and her story continued.

UniqueAr4.desc: When Salusa Secundus was reduced from a fertile planet to an irradiated wasteland of a planet, House Corrino swore vengeance on their enemies. This <Unique>Unique</> battle rifle was created as a memory of that oath and the explosive darts that it fires are reminiscent of the fires that rained down on Salusa Secundus itself.

UniqueAr3.desc: Another weapon liberated from the shipwrecks of the Sheol, this <Unique>Unique</> battle rifle has been modified with a mechanism that adds a touch of explosive powder to every dart that passes down the barrel. Perhaps used as protection against smuggler or pirate attacks in the interplanetary shipping lanes.

UniqueAr2.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> battle rifle has been modified with a mechanism that adds a touch of explosive powder to every dart that passes down the barrel. The Sandflies use weapons like this to rapidly clear rubble filled tunnels beneath the Sentinel, hence the name.

UniqueAr1.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> battle rifle has been modified with a mechanism that adds a touch of explosive powder to every dart that passes down the barrel. Though ranged weapons are uncommon elsewhere in the Imperium, on Arrakis they have become more prevalent due to the deemphasis on shields.

UniqueAr_Burst_06.desc: When the War of Assassins came to Arrakis, Indara and her husband, Ardan, were stationed at a small Atreides outpost on the shield wall. As the relentless attacks of the Harkonnens continued, Ardan forced Indara to flee into a nearby cave system with their young child. Nobody knows why this <Unique>Unique</> weapon is named for Indara - but there is speculation that she and her child still haunt the caves of the Deep Desert Shield Wall. This rifle fires a modified three-round burst, with the final dart in the burst dealing additional damage.

UniqueAr_Burst_05.desc:
General Mendek was a swordsman all his life, until he was stationed on Arrakis. When he saw the lack of shields among the Fremen, he commissioned a <Unique>Unique</> burst shot battle rifle which deals additional damage when firing the final dart in the burst.

'The first shot is for the Baron. The second is for my lady wife. And the last shot is for forcing me to be stationed on this godsforsaken dustbowl.'

UniqueAr_Burst_04.desc:
A young Atreides engineer with a very bad stutter was routinely ridiculed by his fellows stationed at The Aegis. To reduce his stutter, he began using semuta to help calm his mind. He became an addict, hopelessly enthralled to his semuta supplier — a Harkonnen agent.

This specially modified <Unique>Unique</> rifle fires in a three-round burst, with the final dart in the burst dealing additional damage. It was the last thing many heard at The Aegis when the young man turned it upon his once-comrades and then himself.

UniqueAr_Burst_03.desc: Zaal Karak captured this rifle on a raid into the Vermillius Gap for fresh slaves. He admired the workmanship, particularly that the final dart of its three-round burst is more potent, but chose to reinforce it with more robust materials. Other slavers copied him and now this once-<Unique>Unique</> rifle is popular amongst the slavers of the basin.

UniqueAr_Burst_02.desc: Nobody truly knows who Fila is or was, but it is rumored that she, for a while, was mistress to Aren, a Kirab Warlord. That may explain why this <Unique>Unique</> rifle is similar to one wielded by Aren during his final days, with the final dart of its three-round burst dealing additional damage. But did he create the rifle, or was it the work of the mysterious Fila?

UniqueAr_Burst_01.desc: When Aren was ousted by the Kirab, he brought some of their technology with him into the Southern basin. This <Unique>Unique</> battle rifle is based on a similar Kirab model, with the final dart of its three-round burst dealing additional damage. Aren's intention was to eventually lead an army of scavengers north to take vengeance on his old comrades.

SurveyProbeLauncher.desc: Launch a Survey Probe from high altitude to map out worthwhile information about your surrounding area.

SurveyProbe_1.desc: "Ammunition" to be loaded into a Survey Probe Launcher. Launch one probe at a high altitude to map the local area. <Fremen>Fremen</> origin.

StaticCompactorTier6.desc: Point and shoot at a spice field to compact the spice into a clump of sand that can be picked up. Can be made from <Fremen>Fremen</> components. Depletes power from a Power Pack on use.

StaticCompactor_Unique_Compact_06.desc: The makers of this <Unique>Unique</> static compactor prioritized reducing size, power draw, and most importantly worm attention.

StaticCompactor_Unique_Compact_05.desc: The makers of this <Unique>Unique</> static compactor prioritized reducing size, power draw, and most importantly worm attention.

StaticCompactor_Unique_Compact_03.desc: The makers of this <Unique>Unique</> static compactor prioritized reducing size, power draw, and most importantly worm attention.

StakingUnit.desc: Use this device to stake out more sections of land for your existing landclaim.

SmugShot5.desc: Double barrel mid range shotgun that fires "burrow darts". When colliding with an active shield, burrow darts stick to them and penetrate them after a short time, dealing damage to the protected target.

StakingUnitVertical.desc: Use this device to extend the land of your existing base vertically.

SmugShot4.desc: Double barrel mid range shotgun that fires "burrow darts". When colliding with an active shield, burrow darts stick to them and penetrate them after a short time, dealing damage to the protected target.

SmugDmr6.desc: Another workhorse of a weapon, the JABAL Spitdart is scoped for long range engagements and fires darts capable of poisoning targets.

SmugDmr5.desc: Another workhorse of a weapon, the JABAL Spitdart is scoped for long range engagements and fires darts capable of poisoning targets.
