SMG_Unique_LargeMag_06.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> disruptor has a small inscription beneath the barrel, beside the makers mark. It reads 'In honor of the Faufreluches — a dart for every man and for every man a dart.' No matter how often the schematics are modified, this inscription is always fabricated on the weapon.

SMG_Unique_LargeMag_05.desc: The Atreides base in the Hagga Basin overlooks the radiated shipwrecks of the Sheol. Sometimes, during the long watches of the night, when a soldier has time to contemplate their life on Arrakis, they take the long elevator down to the sands and disappear into the south. This <Unique>Unique</> disruptor is named as an insult to those who would desert their posts — and used against them if they are ever seen again.

SMG_Unique_LargeMag_04.desc: The history of Ironwatch is tied to the fate of the great Ironworks of Vermillius Gap. When they were abandoned, so was Ironwatch. This <Unique>Unique</> disruptor is known as an Ironwatch Special because many of them were found stockpiled in the basement when the Sandflies reclaimed the base.

SMG_Unique_LargeMag_03.desc: Seb was a veteran of the Kytheria, that came down in the Hagga Rift. With a few survivors, Seb was able to escape the rift and overtake a small slaver cave near the edge of the rift. This <Unique>Unique</> high-capacity disruptor was a part of his success — though it is said that he later traded the secret of manufacturing them to Smiley Tyg at the Anvil Tradepost.

SMG_Unique_LargeMag_02.desc: Smiley Tyg sometimes has special goods that he sells with no questions asked or answered. A few seasons ago, schematics for a <Unique>Unique</> high-capacity disruptor — a weapon focused on attacking shields — began to appear in his stock at the Anvil Tradepost. Rumors that they were plundered from a Sardaukar convoy ambushed by Zantara the Lion earned them their moniker as the Legion Tattoo — bolstered by the rhythm they make as they fire.

Shotgun_Unique_Explosive_06.desc: An increased capacity makes this <Unique>Unique</> Drillshot the anti-shield weapon of choice. An added charge mechanism was added to the base FK7, powering up devastating 2-round bursts of burrow darts.

Shotgun_Unique_Explosive_05.desc: An increased capacity makes this <Unique>Unique</> Drillshot the anti-shield weapon of choice. An added charge mechanism was added to the base FK7, powering up devastating 2-round bursts of burrow darts.

Shotgun_Unique_Explosive_04.desc: An increased capacity makes this <Unique>Unique</> Drillshot the anti-shield weapon of choice. An added charge mechanism was added to the base FK7, powering up devastating 2-round bursts of burrow darts.

Shotgun_Unique_Blood_06.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> scattergun fires drilling darts which penetrate slowly through a Holtzman shield and then continue drilling — causing gaping bleeding wounds to the enemy. When the inventor was asked about the juvenile name he simply replied 'I'm all about drilling through defenses and going deep. I also design weapons. Ask your mother.'

ScrapMetalKnife.desc: Designed by necessity using whatever is close at hand, many resort to this melee weapon for short-range Blade Damage.

Scattergun_Prototype3.desc: Heavy for its size, it is highly recommended to hold the GRDA 44 with both hands, despite certain actors portraying its use with one in each hand.

Scattergun_Prototype2.desc: Heavy for its size, it is highly recommended to hold the GRDA 44 with both hands, despite certain actors portraying its use with one in each hand.

Scattergun_Prototype.desc: Heavy for its size, it is highly recommended to hold the GRDA 44 with both hands, despite certain actors portraying its use with one in each hand. A <GreatHouse>Great House</> item.

Scanner_Unique_Body_03.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> scanner that specializes in only detecting the living.

D_Scanner_Prototype_ProbeLauncher.desc: Scan, and it will be revealed

D_Scanner_Prototype.desc: Scan, and it will be revealed

D_Scanner_Omni_QA.desc: The combat-ready Harkonnen use scanners with a full spherical detection range

D_Scanner_Omni_1.desc: The combat-ready Harkonnen use scanners with a full spherical detection range

D_Scanner_LongRange_QA.desc: The hawk-eyed Atreides' scanner has a particularly long range, perfect for reconnaissance

D_Scanner_Efficient_QA.desc: The smugglers' reliable scanner only sips at your power, allowing near continuous operation

Scanner_Efficient_1.desc: An <Unique>Unique</> improved power-driven handheld exploration scanner that allows the user to project a scan in front of them to mark information on their map.

Scanner_Base_1.desc: A power-driven handheld exploration scanner that allows the user to project a scan in front of them to mark information on their map. Can be fabricated with <Fremen>Fremen</> components.

SardaukarBlade.desc: The Sardaukar Blade is a longer sword used for self-defense. Can penetrate shields.

RocketLauncher_Unique_Homing_06.desc: When Holtzman shields became widely available, the use of artillery in warfare dramatically reduced. During the Battle of Arrakeen, the Baron Harkonnen brought them back, using heavy rockets to seal Atreides soldiers in caves, thus avoiding the problem of Holtzman shields entirely. Since then, these <Unique>Unique</> missile launchers have become widely sought after by Fremen and Imperial troops alike.

RocketLauncher_2.desc: A launcher that shoots homing missiles.

RocketAmmo.desc: A rocket projectile with an explosive warhead and a propellant for extra thrust. Typically utilized by vehicular rocket launchers.

RepairTool5.desc: A welding torch with high-quality repair capabilities in terms of durability and longevity. Welding Wire is required for repairs. It can also be used to assemble or disassemble vehicles.

D_RepairTool4.desc: A welding torch with above-average-quality repair capabilities in terms of durability and longevity. Welding Wire is required for repairs. It can also be used to assemble or disassemble vehicles.

RepairTool3.desc: A welding torch with average-quality repair capabilities in terms of durability and longevity. Welding Wire is required for repairs. It can also be used to assemble or disassemble vehicles.

D_RepairTool2.desc: A welding torch with below-average-quality repair capabilities in terms of durability and longevity. Artisan welding material is required for repairs. It can also be used to assemble or disassemble vehicles.

RepairTool.desc: A welding torch with low-quality repair capabilities in terms of durability and longevity. Welding Wire is required for repairs. It can also be used to assemble or disassemble vehicles.

Rapier_3.desc:
Opening attacks: use the attack button to parry incoming attacks and move the character forward. Use the the aim button to parry and move the character backward.

The <GreatHouse>Great House</> Atreides Rapier is a longer sword used for self-defense by the most skilled swordmasters. The long blade allows for reach and raw damage, as well as penetrates shields. To truly master the rapier, its carrier must be quick on their feet and swift to react.

Napalm.desc: Few weapons inspire the type of fear created by fire. Use this ammunition in conjunction with incendiary weapons to instill maximum terror in your adversaries.

MiningTool_2h_Unique_04.desc: Pardot Kynes was a driven man and single-minded in his quest to teach the Fremen the language of ecological transformation. He gave them access to the technology of the Imperium — allowing them to greatly expand their catchbasins and windtraps. Pardot was also a very hands-on type and this <Unique>Unique</> cutteray was crafted and tuned to his exacting specifications.

MiningTool_2h_Unique_03.desc: When Pardot Kynes began his work with the Fremen, he brought them into the Imperial Testing Stations as laborers. He gave them access to the technology and science of the Imperium. Soon enough, cutterays began appearing in Sietchs, sculpting tunnels and windtraps to help with Pardot's long term plans. This <Unique>Unique</> cutteray has been optimized for the ores and rock deposits on the area around Sietch Tarl.

MiningTool_2h_Unique_02.desc: Optimized for the operations of the Sandflies, this <Unique>Unique</> cutteray lasts longer than a regular cutteray and delivers increased yields of aluminum.

MiningTool_2h_Unique_01.desc: Callie worked the great galleries of the rift, until the Kytheria crashed and the war escalated into the caverns. She joined the deserters, carving tunnels through the old mining galleries using her trusty buggy and her favorite tool. Callie was lost when one of the tunnels she was opening collapsed beneath her, but her <Unique>Unique</>tool was retrieved.

MiningTool_2h_Standard.desc: Heavy cutteray capable of mining aluminum. Depletes power from a Power Pack. Fabricated with <Fremen>Fremen</> parts.

MiningTool_2h_Light.desc: Robust cutteray capable of mining titanium and stravidium. Depletes power from a Power Pack. Fabricated from <Fremen>Fremen</> parts.

MiningTool_2h_Heavy.desc: Cutteray capable of mining jasmium crystals, which are a necessity to refine duraluminum. Depletes power from a Power Pack. Fabricated from <Fremen>Fremen</> parts.

MiningTool_2h_Advanced.desc: Top-of-the-line cutteray capable of mining virtually anything. Depletes power from a Power Pack. Fabricated with <Fremen>Fremen</> parts.

MiningTool_1h_Unique_02.desc: When Olef was assigned to the great ironworks in Vermillius Gap, he didn't despair. He saw opportunity amongst the spires of stone — a lot of thirsty miners and nowhere to drink. He started stealing supplies and set up his own little after-hours establishment selling spice-laced moonshine. Before long, he was so busy he had no time to fill his mining quotas. He had a drunk engineer create this <Unique>Unique</> cutteray to help him stay afloat.

MiningTool_1h_Unique_01.desc: When the mining facilities were abandoned in the Vermillius Gap, Sim and his fellow miners decided to try their luck as scavengers. Sim 'borrowed' a <Unique>Unique</> cutteray from the ironworks, discovering too late that it was tuned for increased Granite, Copper and Salvage yields and only had basic Iron yields. 'Oh the iron-y' Sim was heard to exclaim.

MiningTool_1h_Standard.desc: Harmless to humans, it is uniquely suited to extracting resources. This version works on granite, copper, metal, and doors. Analysis mode shows weak points. Depletes power from a Power Pack.

MiningTool_1h_Light.desc: Cutteray capable of mining carbon, which is a necessity to refine steel. Depletes power from a Power Pack. Fabricated from <Fremen>Fremen</> parts.

MiningTool_1h_Heavy.desc: Cutteray capable of mining iron. Depletes power from a Power Pack. Fabricated from <Fremen>Fremen</> parts.

D_MiningTool_1h_Basic.desc: Harmless to humans, the laser from a cutteray is uniquely suited to extracting resources from stone and other formations. It is the tool from which all else follows

LongRifle_Unique_Poison_06.desc: Fremen warriors modified these <Unique>Unique</> rifles and used them in their relentless guerilla campaign against the Harkonnen. A single Fremen could remain, near buried and practically invisible in the sand dunes beside a spice blow, awaiting their chance at Harkonnen prey. These warriors were called Dunewatchers.

LongRifle_Unique_Poison_05.desc: Piter de Vries and Thufir Hawat are both trained assassins as well as Mentats. In the few instances where their masters must meet under a sign of truce, both men are responsible for the security of their lords beneath the Guild Peace. The soldiers who oversee these meetings are equipped with this <Unique>Unique</> rifle and placed at strategic locations. They have steady hands and a calm demeanor — anything else could quickly lead to disaster.

LongRifle_Unique_Poison_04.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> rifle was named for an assassin who was paid a huge sum by the Atreides to take down the Beast Rabban. Witnesses say that the shot was perfect — lodging a poison dart deep into Rabban's neck — and that he laughed and pulled it out while his bodyguard swarmed the assassin.

LongRifle_Unique_Poison_03.desc: Many in the Imperium have heard of chaumurky, poison administered through the drink, and chaumas, poison delivered through the food. This <Unique>Unique</> rifle toys with a third concept — poison delivered in a small explosive dart that explodes on contact with a shield, allowing it to waft through.

LongRifle_Unique_LargeMag_06.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> non-scoped Spitdart Rifle was developed with increased magazine capacity and fires poison-coated darts in a horizontal tripleshot pattern.

LongRifle_Unique_LargeMag_05.desc: For many years, the nobles of House Wydras lived in constant fear of an assassin's dart fired by the infamous Fivefingers. In his youth, he lost his right hand and eye during a duel with a Wydras nobleman. He disappeared from public eye for a long time — then returned with this <Unique>Unique</> tripleshot rifle to wreak vengeance on those who had left him maimed.

LMG_Unique_RapidFire_06.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> machine gun is considered so effective at cowing the populace during wars, it is often placed on display in local population centers as a threat. However, the Sardaukar prefer not to carry such bulky weapons into conflict, and will only do so at a Bashar's Command.

LMG_Unique_RapidFire_05.desc: A favored weapon of the Smuggler, Esmar Tuek, this <Unique>Unique</> Vulcan gun leaves a mess wherever it is fired. Tuek, it is said, is a man who likes to make sure that when he sends a message to his enemies, it is heard.

LMG_Unique_RapidFire_04.desc: Developed in the warfare labs of House Thorvald, this <Unique>Unique</> Vulcan gun uses new materials science to strip weight and replace it with capacity. Though highly sought after, these guns are experimental and banned from CHOAM export. How this arrived on Arrakis, is a mystery.

LMG_Unique_Power_06.desc: Originally designed to fire a steady stream of blue orbs at hellish foes, this <Unique>Unique</> plasma gun tears imps to shreds and rips Arch-viles and Cacodemons apart. Oh... I've just been informed this text is for DUNE not DOOM. Ignore me then.

Kindjal_Unique_Stamina_06.desc:
During the Butlerian Jihad, pulse-blades were used to cut through the thinking machines and damage their electronics with pulses of deadly electricity. It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries.

This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when hitting an enemy — offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary weapons of the Butlerian Jihad.

Kindjal_Unique_Stamina_05.desc:
During the Butlerian Jihad, pulse-blades were used to cut through the thinking machines and damage their electronics with pulses of deadly electricity. It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries.

This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when hitting an enemy — offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary weapons of the Butlerian Jihad.

Kindjal_Unique_Stamina_03.desc:
During the Butlerian Jihad, pulse-blades were used to cut through the thinking machines and damage their electronics with pulses of deadly electricity. It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries.

This <Unique>Unique</> blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when hitting an enemy — offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary weapons of the Butlerian Jihad.

Kindjal_Unique_Blood_06.desc: Commonly used in his black-gloved main-hand during arena bouts, Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen had a small compartment designed that could deliver poison - though usually it was the white-gloved off-hand that carried the poisoned blade. Though most never knew of his treachery, this <Unique>Unique</> kindjal became popular on Arrakis for the opposite reason, it was capable of stealing blood from enemies and storing it in the compartment.

Kindjal_Unique_Blood_05.desc: Pardot Kynes first came into contact with the Fremen by killing three Harkonnen bravos who were attacking Fremen youth. Kynes lamented violence — not the act, but the loss of blood and thus, precious water, it incurred. He developed this <Unique>Unique</> kindjal simply because if he was forced to kill others, he didn't want it to be wasteful.

Kindjal_Unique_Blood_04.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> kindjal was used as an off-hand weapon by the Fremen warrior Shadrath in his campaign against the Sardaukar. Though a Fremen would never be far from their crysknife, a secondary blade can help to stay alive, particularly if it serves the function of capturing water during fights.

Kindjal_Unique_Blood_03.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> kindjal slurps up blood as it cuts — thoroughly suitable for the mysterious entity known only as the Glutton. Though few have claimed to see him in person, the wounds left by this knife are unmistakable.

Kindjal_Unique_Blood_02.desc: Scipio the warlord liked to draw blood from his enemies during torture. He created this <Unique>Unique</> kindjal based on one he had stolen in the Southern Hagga Basin. Made of more advanced materials, this kindjal works on the same  principle — small grooves feed blood into the hilt which can be emptied into a waiting container.

Kindjal_Unique_Blood_01.desc: Cornered in a cave by Sardaukar forces, Kaleff managed to stay alive for weeks without a water source, only emerging to draw blood from his enemies. When he was finally killed, the Sardaukar discovered this <Unique>Unique</> kindjal modified to include an exsanguination apparatus.

Kindjal_4.desc: A common personal weapon popular among the family members of this <GreatHouse>Great House</>, the Atreides Kindjal is styled after the particular variety that Duke Leto Atreides himself carries.

InfantryRocketAmmo.desc: A missile projectile that is typically utilized by infantry missile launchers.

HeavyPistol_Unique_Headshot_06.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> pistol comes with increased accuracy and bonus damage for headshots, but with a low capacity clip.

HeavyPistol_Unique_Headshot_05.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> pistol comes with increased accuracy and bonus damage for headshots, but with a low capacity clip.

HeavyPistol_Unique_Bleed_06.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> heavy pistol borrows technology from the fast-firing disruptor submachine gun, while adding a charging mechanism to fire shield-destabilizing darts.

HeavyPistol_Unique_Bleed_05.desc: This <Unique>Unique</> heavy pistol borrows technology from the fast-firing disruptor submachine gun, while adding a charging mechanism to fire shield-destabilizing darts.

HeavyAmmo.desc: For use in larger and more powerful weapons, Heavy Darts are standard ammunition and can pierce certain types of armor.

Heavy_Flamethrower_T2_NPC.desc: A <Unique>Unique</> item. Little known fact: Jared Garoti was a notorious pyromaniac in his early years and nearly burnt his ancestral home to the ground building one of his creations.

HarkHeavyPistol5.desc: There is a Rafiq Snubnose Pistol in the cabinet by the bed of Count Daran of Ishkal. His wife is unaware and would disapprove.

ChoamLg2.desc:
Though the Imperium has forbidden the import of lasguns without a safety mechanism, there are other alternatives for bringing a lasgun to Arrakis. The smugglers have access to an entire offworld arsenal of lasguns that do not include the safety mechanisms put in place by the Landsraad council.
Unfortunately, this <Unique>Unique</> lasgun is not one of them. It's just a regular lasgun with the serial numbers filed off.

ChoamLg1.desc:
When a lasgun contacted a hot shield in Carthag, it was a disaster. Thousands died in the ensuing nuclear blast and the city was leveled.

Due to the devastating loss of life and spice production capacity, all lasguns imported to Arrakis are now fitted with a safety mechanism that immediately shuts them off if they are targeting a Holtzman shield, including this <Unique>Unique</> model.

It also includes a cluster of integrated plasteel shards - the seven sorrows - near the hilt that can wound the blade hand of an attacker upon a successful block.

UniqueAr6_Electric.desc: An old Planetologist wisdom says: “The freaks of cyclonic storms are the rules of cyclonic storms.” In their hubris to harness the Coriolis storm, a team of scientists lost their lives in an Imperial Testing Station. This <Unique>Unique</> rifle, a byproduct of those experiments, uses electrical power rather than standard ammunition. The EMP blasts disrupt shields.

Dualblades_1.desc:
Holding down the attack button initiates a sequence of frenzied hits that partially bypass shields.

The slightly curved, double-edged Kindjal and the smaller Slip-tip knife form a marriage of razor-sharp mayhem. A dual-wielding fighting style has formed around these two weapons. Often, the frightful Kindjal draws the eye while the Slip-tip sneaks into one’s vitals.

Dualblades_2.desc:
Holding down the attack button initiates a sequence of frenzied hits that partially bypass shields.

The slightly curved, double-edged Kindjal and the smaller Slip-tip knife form a marriage of razor-sharp mayhem. A dual-wielding fighting style has formed around these two weapons. Often, the frightful Kindjal draws the eye while the Slip-tip sneaks into one’s vitals.

Minotaur_Memento.desc:
A dense, razor-edged <Unique>Unique</> weapon built to shear through armored flesh by force alone.

Tauromachy, the brutal Old Terran contest of man against beast, endured as a defining Atreides rite until Old Duke Paulus fell beneath Salusan horns. Asterion’s End lingers as a ghost of the arena, whispered as though the Minotaur’s curse still coils within it, binding valor and doom in equal measure.

DualBlades_Memento.desc: Feyd-Rautha is known to favor his own custom sets of Kindjal and Slip-tip dual blades, making deadly use of their combination. It would be a rare privileged to own such a set. How many lives have these razor edges claimed?

UniqueDualBlades_6.desc: Designed by Masano of the Sandflies, these <Unique>unique</>, heated blades both tear and scorch flesh, leaving a screaming impression.

B1C4_Unique_HarkAr2.desc: Sometimes, even a minor wound can kill. This <Unique>Unique</> rifle is modified to do poison damage.

B1C4_Unique_LMG2.desc: Peak aggression is often the enemy of precision. This <Unique>Unique</> LMG is very inaccurate but makes up for it with a 25% damage bonus.

B1C4_Unique_SmugDmr1.desc: Necessity is the mother of modification. This <Unique>Unique</> rifle sacrifices its scope for slightly faster reload, slightly faster rate of fire, and holds 5 ammo.

SardaukarSword_1.desc: In the hands of an experienced swordmaster, the perfect balance of this customized Sardaukar blade tells a grim story. The equilibrium of the sword allows the wielder to expend very little energy with each swing, suggesting a weapon designed less for single combat and more for sustained slaughter over a long period of time.

B1C4_Unique_Dirk2.desc: The best offense is a fully-charged battery. Every attack from this <Unique>Unique</> blade restores one’s power pack by 5.

B1C4_Unique_DualBlades1.desc: A drained enemy is a helpless enemy. Every hit from these <Unique>Unique</> dual blades drains a target of power.

B1C4_Unique_Kindjal2.desc: Intrigue amongst the Great Houses is a treacherous game. Poison often coats the blades of polite society. This <Unique>Unique</> Kindjal causes poison damage.

B1C4_Unique_Sword2.desc: A special chemical treatment super heats the blade. Enemies who live tend to carry the scars with them forever after. This <Unique>Unique</> sword causes burn buildup with every hit.

B1C4_TaligariPistol.desc: Due to recent, turbulent events, House Taligari saw a surge of interest in personal weapons. This handsome, little pistol has become quite popular with Taligari nobility, as well as those in their orbit.

B1C4_Unique_HeavyPistol2.desc: A special cocktail of magnesium and certain other elements can produce a very nasty, burning round. This <Unique>Unique</> snub-nosed heavy pistol causes burn buildup on a hit.

B1C4_Unique_Rapier2.desc: The edge of this blade is so sharp, its balance so precise, the wielder feels as if they know their opponent’s next move before they do. No attacker comes away unscathed. This <Unique>Unique</> rapier causes bleed on an opponent with every successful parry.

B1C4_Unique_SMG2.desc: If at first your poison fails to slay — inundate, inundate, inundate. This <Unique>Unique</>, assassin-modified disruptor causes poison buildup with every hit.

T6_Augment_Acuracy1.desc: An augmentation which increases the accuracy of any ranged weapon.

T6_Augment_Armor1.desc: An augmentation for garments which reduces concussive damage taken, but increases energy damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor10.desc: An augmentation for garments which reduces energy damage taken, but increases poison damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor11.desc: An augmentation for garments which reduces poison damage taken, but increases energy damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor12.desc: An augmentation for garments which reduces dart damage taken, but increases overall volume.

T6_Augment_Armor13.desc: An augmentation for garments which reduces fire damage taken, but increases poison damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor14.desc: An augmentation for garments which reduces blade damage taken, but increases dart damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor16.desc: An augmentation for garments which reduces radiation build up and fire damage taken, but increases blade and dart damage taken. This augmentation cannot be applied to Radiation Suits.

T6_Augment_Armor17.desc: An augmentation for garments which reduces radiation build up, but increases overall volume.

T6_Augment_Armor2.desc: An augmentation for garments which reduces concussive damage taken, but increases dart damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor4.desc: An augmentation for garments which reduces dart damage taken, but increases blade damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor5.desc: An augmentation for garments which reduces energy damage taken, but increases concussive damage taken.

T6_Augment_Armor6.desc: An augmentation for garments which increases armor value.

T6_Augment_Armor8.desc: An augmentation for garments which increases heat protection, but increases overall volume.

T6_Augment_Armor9.desc: An augmentation for garments which reduces poison damage taken, but increases fire damage taken.

T6_Augment_BR1.desc: This Karpov 38-specific augmentation delays the release of fired darts in order to build up additional force, thus reducing the fire rate while increasing the damage output and accuracy.

T6_Augment_BR2.desc: A Karpov 38-specific augmentation that opts for less power behind each dart in order to fire more darts. This reduces the overall damage of each dart fired but increases the fire rate.

T6_Augment_BR3.desc: This Karpov 38-specific augmentation alters the magazine to hold more powerful darts but fewer of them, thus reducing the weapon's overall volume and magazine capacity while improving damage output.

T6_Augment_BR4.desc: A Karpov 38-specific augmentation which improves accuracy and reload times and reduces recoil, but the overall damage output is reduced.

T6_Augment_BR8.desc: A Karpov 38-specific augmentation which focuses more on dealing critical damage to weak spots en-masse, thus increasing magazine capacity, headshot damage, and overall volume while reducing accuracy.

T6_Augment_Damage1.desc: An augmentation which increases the damage output of any ranged weapon.

T6_Augment_DeathDurabilityOff.desc: An augmentation which removes the durability loss incurred when suffering defeat.

T6_Augment_Fireballer1.desc: A Pyrocket-specific augmentation that increases damage output and fire rate, but at the cost of reload time and increased volume.

T6_Augment_Fireballer2.desc: This Pyrocket-specific augmentation increases ammo capacity, reduces reload times and reduces overall volume, albeit at the cost of reduced accuracy and damage to shields.

T6_Augment_Flamethrower1.desc: A flamethrower-specific augmentation that increases damage output and reduces recoil, but increases overall volume.

T6_Augment_Flamethrower2.desc: A flamethrower-specific augmentation that sprays out flames faster and causes more painful burns, but reduces the effective range.

T6_Augment_Flamethrower3.desc: A flamethrower-specific augmentation that increases the effective range and ammo capacity at the cost of increased volume and recoil.

T6_Augment_Flamethrower4.desc: A flamethrower-specific augmentation that reduces recoil, reload time, and overall volume at the cost of damage output.

T6_Augment_Headshotdamage1.desc: An augmentation which increases the headshot damage of any ranged weapon.

T6_Augment_HeavyPistol1.desc: An augmentation for the Rafiq Snubnose heavy pistol which focuses on improving the stopping power of the gun, but makes it harder to handle.  This increases the damage and headshot damage of the gun at the cost of reducing the fire rate.

T6_Augment_HeavyPistol2.desc: This Rafiq Snubnose-specific augmentation improves the stopping power and shield disruption effect of the pistol while reducing overall volume, but at the cost of ammo capacity and reload time.

T6_Augment_HeavyPistol3.desc: An augmentation for the Rafiq Snubnose which reduces recoil and reload time and improves accuracy but reduces overall stopping power.

T6_Augment_HeavyPistol4.desc: This Rafiq Snubnose-specific augmentation increases the ammo capacity of the pistol at the cost of recoil and increased overall volume.

T6_Augment_HeavyPistol5.desc: An augmentation for the Rafiq Snubnose which increases the weapon's fire rate at the cost of shield damage.

T6_Augment_Lasgun1.desc: A Lasgun-specific augmentation which increases the beam's damaging power and reduces overall volume, however the power drain and recoil suffer.

T6_Augment_Lasgun2.desc: This Lasgun-specific augmentation increases the range and accuracy of the beam and reduces overall volume, but reduces overall damage output.

T6_Augment_Lasgun3.desc: An augmentation for Lasguns which increases the rate of fire of the beam, reduces recoil, and reduces power drain, however the range of the beam and its damage output are reduced, and overall volume is increased.

T6_Augment_Lasgun4.desc: A Lasgun-specific augmentation which increases damage output and reduces overall volume, but reduces range and increases recoil.

T6_Augment_Lmg1.desc: A VULCAN GAU-92-specific augmentation which increases ammo capacity and improves reload times at the cost of accuracy, damage output, and overall volume.

T6_Augment_Lmg4.desc: An augmentation for the VULCAN GAU-92 which increases range and accuracy and reduces recoil, however rate of fire is reduced.

T6_Augment_Lmg5.desc: This VULCAN GAU-92-specific augmentation increases shield damage output and overall damage output, but reduces accuracy and increases recoil and reload times.

T6_Augment_Lmg6.desc: A VULCAN GAU-92-specific augmentation which increases rate of fire, but reduces effective range and accuracy.

T6_Augment_Magazinecapacity1.desc: An augmentation which increases the ammo capacity of any ranged weapon, but increases overall volume.
